jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Job Description**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.
  
  
As a Product Manager in the Product Management team, you will be responsible for the product vision and strategies to come up with innovative solutions to problems that are valuable (our users choose to use them), viable (the solution works for the business), usable (the users can figure out how to use) and feasible.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Understand client and advisor needs. Invests in a deep understanding of the business opportunity, advisor & client needs and competitive landscape. Dive into research to uncover what matters most, ensuring every feature is relevant, useful, and ahead of the curve.
* Be passionate about AI & Innovation - Bring relentless passion for AI and innovation to the Private Bank every day. Focus on delivering standout client and product experiences. Collaborate closely with developers and UX designers to create intuitive, differentiated solutions. Prioritize features that deliver client impact and business goals, within complex control requirements.
* Inspire adoption – define and track KPIs for usage & impact (both quantitative & qualitative) metrics. Focus on constantly aligning our AI powered digital solutions with user needs to maximize AI adoption and impact across the Private Bank.
* Drives the product development lifecycle - define requirements (in partnership with cross-functional teams), ensuring sprint inputs and outputs are as envisioned, and providing direction and smart trade off decisions for the scrum team. Collaborates with others across broader teams to deliver end-to-end product and experience.
* Embody true “customer-obsession”. Put customer obsession at the heart of everything—leverage user data, performance metrics, industry trends, and all forms of feedback to shape design and roadmap decisions.
* Set the standard for piloting and rolling out new capabilities - define objectives, scope, communication, training, support, and feedback/metrics to ensure successful adoption.
* Develop and maintain deep relationships with delivery partners including senior leaders, Digital, Technology, Design, Operations, Servicing, Legal, Risk & Control functions across the International Region
* Work hand-in-hand with Technology and Design, but you'll also be out front—engaging with Advisors and Business Management throughout the product lifecycle to make sure we're always building the right thing, the right way.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in Digital or financial services, with experience leading strategic or transformational change in wealth management, digital banking, or a related business.
* A proven innovator with an ability to think differently, reframe problems and uncover opportunities to turn emerging ideas into meaningful outcomes.
* Experience managing product delivery across multiple workstreams, balancing shifting priorities and complexities to successfully deliver new products to market.
* Experience in KPI frameworks such as OKRs or HEART to communicate measures of success.
* Excellent leadership skills – ability to guide teams and influence peers to build consensus.
* Strong understanding of different technological development methodologies (e.g., Agile) and design techniques with ability to successfully lead regardless of approach.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform.
  
  
Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.
  
  
**The Role**
You will own the Payments product itself: the platform capability every client bank runs on, rather than the launch of any single client. Your job is to make Payments serviceable, manageable and competitive at scale across all of our client banks, current and future, as part of normal business-as-usual operation.
  
  
You will work closely with Software Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance, and the Client Delivery team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Payments product roadmap and prioritisation.
* Own new Payments platform capability, including its timeline and delivery commitments. You will build it as reusable capability for all of our clients on the platform, including new payment rail integrations, for example NPP , PayTo and BECS bulk payments in Australia, and their equivalents in other jurisdictions.
* Own payment orchestration and routing logic, and bulk and batch payment processing.
* Build out the requirements for scheme and payment rail connectivity, and work with the Technology team in owning the technical architecture: adapter design per rail and country, gateway integrations, and how payment state is managed across the platform.
* Own the configuration model, which gathers the specifications needed to streamline implementation for each new client that joins the platform.
* Work with second line to continue to develop the fraud and risk control framework for Payments across jurisdictions, and own its implementation.
* Own the serviceability and management of Payments functionality at scale, with every process automated end to end so no manual processing is needed, supported by self-service tooling for Operations and, where appropriate, clients, and designed to work for both day-to-day operations and risk and compliance oversight.
* Own client-facing reporting that gives client banks everything they need to understand and run their own payments business, including reconciliation, settlement and transaction reporting available to all clients.
* Evolve the Payments offering to stay competitive with modern fintech payments providers, both for our current market position and as the market moves, while helping build a best-in-class Product team that values collaboration, meaningful work and impact.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with significant time on payments products.
* You have built payment rail integrations or payment platform capability, and know how scheme and rail connectivity works in practice.
* You have a background in payment processing systems, messaging standards such as ISO 20022, and API-based integrations.
* You have worked with second line to develop and implement fraud and financial crime controls for payment products.
* You have designed payment processes and tooling together with Operations and Risk and Compliance, and you understand the regulatory requirements for payments in the markets we serve.
* You have built reusable platform capability for multiple clients, supported by a configuration model that streamlines implementation for each new client.
* You have a bias toward action, a problem-solving mindset, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to solve complex challenges.
* You explain technical detail clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* You have a track record of driving alignment across technical teams, business partners and external vendors.
* You cut through ambiguity to produce strategic insight and spot opportunities.
* Startup experience is valued highly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with more than one country's payment schemes.
* Experience at a modern fintech payments provider or a payments platform serving financial institutions.
* Experience building internal operations tooling.

**Application Process**
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. Use your cover letter to introduce us to you; we want to know who you are, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a great addition to the Constantinople team.
  
  
**Inclusion**
*To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
*We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us. We will treat your request as confidentially as possible. In your email, please include your name and preferred method of contact, and we will respond as soon as possible.*

Job Description

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Function:** Enterprise Sales / Strategic Account Management

**Market Coverage:** India & Southeast Asia (SEA)

**Experience:** 5 to 9+ Years

  

**Role Purpose:**

  

The Enterprise Sales Capital Markets (Farmer / Strategic Account Management) role will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing Azentio's existing Capital Markets customer relationships across India and Southeast Asia.

  

The role will focus on understanding each customer's business priorities, technology landscape, operational challenges, and transformation roadmap, and identifying how Azentio's broader portfolio can address those evolving needs.

  

A key expectation is to identify whitespace within existing accounts and drive incremental revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Azentio's product portfolio, while protecting existing revenue, expanding account penetration, and building long-term strategic customer relationships.

  

The successful candidate must possess strong BFSI domain expertise and proven experience in managing strategic BFSI accounts, with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth, achieving sales targets, and expanding customer relationships within this segment.

The individual should bring strong business and sales acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to identify and convert opportunities into incremental revenue. Experience in managing large enterprise accounts, driving complex sales cycles, developing C-level relationships, and positioning technology solutions across the BFSI landscape will be essential. The candidate should also be comfortable operating in a dynamic and relatively unstructured environment, taking end-to-end ownership of accounts and proactively creating new business opportunities

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Account Management & Growth**

  

* Manage a portfolio of existing Capital Markets customers across India and SEA.
* Develop comprehensive account plans covering existing products, revenue, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, whitespace, competitive presence, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Own account growth and develop clear strategies for increasing Azentio's share of wallet within strategic customers.
* Identify opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, and technology environments within existing accounts.
* Build a sustainable account-level pipeline for cross-sell, upsell, renewals, extensions, and new requirements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape within each strategic account.

  

**Understanding Customer Needs & Consultative Selling**

  

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, operational model, technology landscape, and transformation priorities.
* Engage customers proactively rather than waiting for requirements or RFPs to emerge.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to uncover new requirements.
* Understand the underlying business problem and map the appropriate Azentio products and capabilities to the customer's needs.
* Develop solution propositions and business cases aligned to customer objectives.
* Position Azentio as a strategic technology partner, rather than a single-product vendor.

  

**Portfolio Selling, Cross-Sell & Upsell**

  

* Develop a strong understanding of Azentio's broader BFSI portfolio and its relevance to Capital Markets customers.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell by connecting customer business requirements with relevant Azentio solutions.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules, licenses, users, geographies, upgrades, integrations, or transformation initiatives.
* Work with Product and Pre-Sales teams to build integrated propositions where multiple Azentio capabilities can address customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain an account-level upsell and cross-sell roadmap for key customers."

  

**Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop trusted relationships with senior business, operations, technology, procurement, and leadership stakeholders.

* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), customer reviews, and strategic account discussions to assess customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive account expansion.

**Renewals, Retention & Commercial Expansion**

* Identify competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, or relationship risks early and develop appropriate retention strategies.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS

**Department:** Learning & Development

**Location:** Pune

**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications

(BCA/MCA)

  

**1. Job Purpose**

The Jr. Software Support Engineer will support the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and operational

functioning of the organisations LMS. The role includes managing user accounts and course assignments,

maintaining accurate reports, preparing and uploading digital learning content, conducting learning platform testing,

supporting system enhancements and migration activities, and resolving platform-related queries from trainers and

other stakeholders.

  

The role requires attention to detail, technical troubleshooting skills, data accuracy, and effective coordination with

internal teams to ensure reliable platform operations and continuous improvement.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Learning Platform Administration and Operational Support**

* Create and maintain user accounts, ensuring accurate user profiles, roles, locations, and project mappings.
* Manage course enrolments, programme assignments, user deactivations, and other learning platform

administrative activities.

* Monitor platform activities and screenshots as per the defined schedule.
* Track and resolve platform access and assignment-related issues within established timelines.
* Maintain records of platform activities and conduct periodic operational compliance checks.
* Ensure accurate batch and programme mapping across the platform.

**B. Reporting and Data Management**

* Extract, validate, consolidate, and maintain platform data for operational and management reporting.
* Prepare and submit weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports within defined timelines.
* Maintain trackers for user accounts, course assignments, enrolments, completions, and other platform activities.
* Verify report accuracy against source data and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain appropriate report version control and documentation.
* Provide timely and accurate data to support internal reviews and management decisions.

**C. Digital Content Development and Assessment Management**

* Convert and upload learning content in SCORM-compatible formats, where required.
* Create quizzes, assessments, and question banks aligned with course learning objectives.
* Map assessments to relevant courses and configure scoring, pass/fail criteria, and completion triggers.
* Test uploaded content for compatibility, functionality, and playback before publishing.
* Incorporate feedback and content revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain content quality standards and ensure accurate course configuration.

**D. Quality Assurance and Learning Platform Testing**

* Prepare and execute test cases for learning platform releases, updates, and enhancements.
* Identify, document, and report software defects, errors, and functional issues.
* Conduct retesting after bug fixes and validate enhancements before deployment.
* Perform regression testing to confirm that existing platform functionalities continue to work as expected.
* Validate data migration, including user records, course completions, and assessment scores, where applicable.
* Maintain test documentation, defect trackers, and quality assurance reports.
* Coordinate with developers and relevant stakeholders to support issue resolution and platform stability.

**E. Stakeholder Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical and operational support to trainers and internal stakeholders for learning platform-related

queries.

* Troubleshoot user access, course assignment, assessment, and platform usage issues.
* Maintain a query tracker documenting issue details, status, resolution, and closure.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate team and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
* Guide trainers on platform processes and the correct use of learning tools.
* Participate in mandatory internal training and undertake regular technical upskilling.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform processes, documentation, reporting, and user experience.

**F. Skills and Competencies Required**

* Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Basic understanding of SCORM content, e-learning modules, and online assessments.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to conduct functional testing, document defects, and validate fixes.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and quality assurance practices.

**Manager- Enterprise Architect in Tech and Cloud Advisory**     
  
ZS's Technology Advisory Group ensures our future information, technology and architectural landscape is built to plan and evolve as our business grows, striving to balance future-proofing our end-to-end technology stack while accelerating the speed of innovation and streamlining the delivery of business capability.- This role will be responsible for supporting the growth and development of our Technology Advisory Practice within the ZS Technology Services business.   
    
     
    
  The successful candidate will work closely with ZS practice leadership and be responsible for evolving our practice, enriching our practice assets and collaterals, building, and managing client relationships, generating new business engagements, and providing thought leadership in the Technology and Architecture Area.

jobs.title: Sales Support Representative
jobs.description:
The Sales Support Representative (SSR) delivers prompt transactional support to Account Executives (AE) and Area Sales Directors (ASD) by preparing quotes, cost proposals, pilot orders, drop shipments, and implementations via a CRM system. The SSR handles transactional tasks so AEs and ASDs can concentrate on selling and building relationships, driving revenue and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cost Proposals/Quotes**
  + Create and assist with cost proposals and quotes using the Salesforce (CRM) within the established service level agreement (SLA) timeframe.
  + Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with approval workflows with each quote.
  + Generate standard and customized quote documents for customers.
* **Implementation/Gratis, Sample Orders, and Pilots**
  + Process, monitor, and track implementation/gratis requests based on established guidelines by product, Line of Business (LoB), or unique conditions.
  + Submit and track sample orders. Provide detailed information for custom shipments and labeling.
  + Execute pilot orders following the established guidelines and directions from the HMH Pilot team.
* **Sales Operations**
  + Handle inbound requests for quotes, samples, implementation/gratis, etc., from AE and ASD teams.
  + Research product availability, pricing, and tracking information.
  + Escalate issues to management when necessary.
* **Systems Tools**
  + Develop and maintain working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP, Sales Hub, and Customer Care platforms.
  + Perform daily sales transactions via SFDC and maintain organized records of sales activities.
* **Collaboration Communication**
  + Liaise with sales support team members and internal departments to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  + Participate in process improvement initiatives and team meetings.
  + Provide clear, concise, and frequent updates related to transaction status with Sales Support manager(s), AEs, ASDs, etc.

**Core Competencies**

* **Adaptability** Maintain effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment, adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, or requirements.
* **Navigating Complexity** Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues; responding effectively to complex and ambiguous situations; communicating complicated information simply.
* **Communication** Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that helps them understand and retain the message.
* **Continuous Improvement** Originating action to improve existing conditions and processes; identifying improvement opportunities, generating ideas, and implementing solutions.
* **Time Management** Effectively manages one's time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
* **Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills** Having achieved a satisfactory level of technical and professional skill or knowledge in position-related areas; keeping up with current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** AA/BS/BA degree
* **Experience:** 3-5 years sales support experience required.
* **Skills:**
  + Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel).
  + Experience with Salesforce and SAP, NetSuite is a plus.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stationary position for a considerable time (sitting and/or standing).
* Constantly operates a computer
* Must be able to collaborate with colleagues via face-to-face, email, Teams, conference calls, and online meetings.

We are looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Marketing & Brand Leader to build and establish a premium brand from the ground up. The role will drive brand positioning, integrated marketing, performance-led growth and AI-powered digital initiatives, targeting premium and HNI consumers across multiple cities.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad (WFO)

**Responsibilities:**

1. Build the **brand strategy, positioning**, identity and communication framework from scratch, establishing a strong presence in the premium consumer segment.
2. Lead integrated digital and performance marketing across SEO, SEM, social media, paid campaigns and AI-powered marketing initiatives to drive qualified leads.
3. Drive **PR, media engagement, brand partnerships, events and community-building initiatives to strengthen brand visibility and credibility.**
4. Manage creative, digital, PR and event agencies, along with internal design resources, marketing budgets and campaign performance.
5. Leverage AI, marketing automation, CRM and analytics to optimise customer acquisition, lead nurturing, funnel conversion and overall marketing ROI.

  

**Requirements:**

1. 8-12 years of experience in **Marketing, Brand Building or Growth, with proven experience in launching or scaling premium brands.**
2. Experience in premium consumer segments, luxury, hospitality, education, premium services or other high-involvement consumer categories. **Education industry is preferred.**
3. Strong expertise in **brand strategy, performance marketing, digital campaigns, SEO, SEM and social media marketing.**
4. Hands-on understanding of AI-powered marketing tools, CRM, marketing automation, analytics and lead generation.
5. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing multiple agencies, budgets and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

  

**What's in it for you?**

* Opportunity to build a premium brand from the ground up.
* Strategic leadership role with direct exposure to senior leadership.
* Significant ownership across brand strategy, marketing and business growth.
* Opportunity to shape and scale a new venture backed by an established group.

  

**Reach Us:** If you feel this opportunity is well aligned with your career progression plans, please feel free to reach me with your updated profile at **vanika.arora@crescendogroup.in** for a confidential discussion on the role.

  

**Keywords:** Head Marketing, Head Brand, Brand Strategy, Brand Launch, Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, Growth Marketing, AI Marketing, Premium Brand, HNI Marketing, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, PR, Agency Management, Hyderabad.

Join us as Business Analyst. At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future, we create it. As a Business Analyst you will support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
To be successful Business Analyst you should have experience with:

* Requirements elicitation and analysis
* User Story creation
* BRD / FRD preparation
* Process mapping
* Gap analysis
* Impact assessment
* Data analysis and reporting
* UAT coordination
* Client Onboarding
* Broking & Trading
* Wealth Management
* Capital Markets
* Private Banking
* Client Lifecycle Management
* SQL and data analysis
* API and system integration concepts
* Understanding of application development lifecycle (SDLC)
* Agile and Scrum methodologies
* JIRA and Confluence
* Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  
  

* Private Banking or Wealth Management platforms.
* Client onboarding systems and digital onboarding journeys.
* Broking and trading platforms.
* Investment products and portfolio reporting.
End-to-end project delivery in Agile environments.  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Client Operations Delivery Analyst
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
Within the Pricing Operations team, we streamline pricing and discounting processes, leveraging exceptional data management skills, automation and tools to ensure accuracy and consistency in price and discount data. With a focus on operational excellence, we align cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Sales, Compliance, and IT to transform our policies, processes, and tool capabilities to create a simplified buying experience at scale for our partners, customers and sales.
  
  
Pricing Operations sits within the Commerce& Growth Acceleration organization, with a mission to provide frictionless commerce operations at scale for Cisco's customers, partners, sellers& renewal managers across all hardware, software, service offers and buying programs fueled by a culture where we celebrate talent& collaboration.
  
  
Your Impact
  
The Client Operations Analyst within Pricing Operations will bridge the gap between Cisco’s partner incentive discount strategy and the operational data infrastructure required to support them.
  
  
This individual will work directly with Business Units and Finance to implement and maintain Cisco’s discounting strategy across its entire portfolio of products, as well as work with Partner Incentive Owners to provide support of the strategy, setup and maintenance of high-revenue generating partner incentive offers. They will be responsible for understanding offer and sales business strategy translating it into clear data requirements to ensure correct partner prices and discounts are applied in Cisco’s commerce platform for hardware, software, service, and all subscription motions. This individual will also serve as point of contact for managing, tracking, reporting and resolving issues with the offer setups.
  
  
The Client Operations Analyst works cross-functionally to analyze business processes, identifies areas for improvement, and implements solutions that enhance productivity and drive business performance.
  
  

* Understand complex business strategies and requirements and translate into clear data requirements
* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support decision-making
* Develop, lead and participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to implement new offer setups, as well as operational changes and improvements
* Identify inefficiencies in current business processes and develop strategies to optimize workflows and operations
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product Management, and IT, to understand their operational needs and provide data-driven recommendations
* Create and maintain detailed documentation of business processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures
* Provide training and support to team members on new processes and tools

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years of relevant business analysis experience within the IT industry, including tasks such as data analysis, requirement gathering, process improvement and process automation
* Experience leading data analysis and audit projects involving large data sets, where high-level Excel skills, including the use of macros, pivots, formulas, and data slicing, were used to identify trends and insights, resulting in actional business strategies
* Demonstrate ability to analyze data from at least four different sources to identify root cause of a problem, evaluate alternative solutions, with documented success in presenting and explaining findings to cross-functional teams, leading to consensus on a strategic path forward
* Proven proficiency in process and change management, demonstrated by leading at least two change initiatives that resulted in 100% user adoption and at least 20% improvement in process efficiency
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining automated solutions that streamline sophisticated operational workflows, resulting in increased process efficiency and reduced manual intervention.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, bold, assertive and possess a sense of ownership of work you're leading
* Work independently as well as in a multi-functional team environment
* Highly organized with strong analytical and problem solving skills
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of work
* Responsive and timely in delivering on commitments

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role exists to support sustainable retail portfolio growth by making prudent, timely and consistent credit decisions for mortgage and wealth management products. The role evaluates customers’ creditworthiness, risk exposure, affordability and application quality to ensure lending decisions align with the Bank’s credit policies, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and business objectives.
  
  
The role balances risk management with customer experience by ensuring credit applications are assessed accurately, efficiently and consistently. It contributes to portfolio quality, operational effectiveness and business growth through sound underwriting judgement, risk assessment and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The role also supports the evolution of credit operations by identifying opportunities to improve turnaround times, strengthen controls, support product launches and contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service delivery and decision-making effectiveness. Where applicable, the role provides operational guidance, supports team capability development and helps maintain underwriting consistency across the function.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Credit Assessment & Underwriting**  
• Assess retail mortgage and wealth management applications to deliver prudent credit decisions that balance customer needs with portfolio risk objectives.
  
• Evaluate customer financial profiles, affordability, repayment capacity and credit history to determine appropriate lending outcomes.
  
• Apply credit policies, underwriting standards and delegated authorities consistently to support high-quality credit decision-making.
  
• Escalate complex or higher-risk cases appropriately to ensure sound risk governance and decision integrity.
  
**Credit Risk & Fraud Management**  
• Identify, assess and mitigate credit and fraud risks that may affect portfolio quality or customer outcomes.
  
• Apply regulatory requirements and internal risk controls to ensure lending decisions remain compliant and defensible.
  
• Detect indicators of potential fraud, misrepresentation or suspicious activity and initiate appropriate escalation processes.
  
• Support a strong risk culture through disciplined application of credit policies and controls.
  
**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**  
• Improve underwriting efficiency by identifying process enhancements that reduce turnaround times while maintaining control effectiveness.
  
• Contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service quality, productivity and customer experience.
  
• Support the implementation of new products, policy changes and process enhancements to ensure operational readiness.
  
• Use operational insights and performance trends to recommend improvements in credit assessment and workflow management.

**Business Support & Stakeholder Collaboration**  
**• Partner with Product, Sales, CRM, Fraud Risk, Lending Operations and support teams to facilitate effective credit assessment and application processing.**  
**• Provide underwriting expertise that supports business growth initiatives, marketing campaigns and new product introductions.**  
**• Resolve credit-related queries and exceptions by collaborating with relevant stakeholders to achieve balanced customer and risk outcomes.**  
**• Contribute operational insights to projects and initiatives that improve the effectiveness of the end-to-end lending process.**  
**Governance, Compliance & Controls**  
**• Ensure credit decisions and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements, Bank policies and internal control standards.**  
**• Maintain accurate documentation and audit readiness to support transparency and regulatory compliance.**  
**• Apply anti-money laundering and financial crime prevention requirements, escalating suspicious activities where appropriate.**  
**• Support governance activities that strengthen underwriting consistency, policy adherence and operational risk management.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Application Processing**  
**• Banking Strategy**  
**• Compliance Audit**  
**• Compliance Monitoring**  
**• Continuous Improvement**  
**• Financial Services**  
**Other skills**  
**• Create Credit Policy**  
**• Credit Administration**  
**• Credit Management**  
**• Operational Monitoring**  
**• Risk Assessment**  
**• Stakeholder Engagement**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Building trusted, long‑term relationships that deliver sustainable, risk‑adjusted growth.**

**• Aligning products, regions and stakeholders around clear strategic priorities.**  
**• Applying sector‑ and segment‑specific knowledge and judgment to solve complex client problems and create value, leveraging data and AI‑enabled insights to deepen client understanding, sharpen focus and drive commercial impact.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience in regulated financial services environments where risk, compliance and customer outcomes are closely managed.**

**• Exposure to retail lending, mortgage, wealth management or consumer banking products involving structured credit assessment frameworks.**  
**• Experience in high-volume processing environments requiring strong judgement, prioritisation and attention to detail.**  
**• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration involving Product, Sales, Operations, Risk and Control functions.**  
**• Experience supporting operational improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, service quality and control effectiveness.**  
**• Business English**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

jobs.title: Senior Associate Product
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Be at the heart of cash management transformation by improving how clients see, use, and act on reporting and liquidity insights. Join a global product team where you will turn data into product decisions and deliver enhancements that improve client outcomes. Bring your analytical mindset and collaboration skills to a role with strong career growth and mobility across product and payments.

As an Associate, Product Manager at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Liquidity and Account Solutions, you will support the ongoing delivery, commercial growth, and product management of Virtual Account Management, a cash management solution that helps clients structure and view account activity across multiple levels. You will focus on data mining and analytical work that supports product reporting objectives and drives client-facing reporting enhancements. You will partner with stakeholders across product, technology, operations, sales, implementation, and client service to support delivery execution, implementation readiness, and issue management. You will contribute to documentation and enablement materials that improve product adoption and consistent execution.

In this role, you will help connect client needs, usage data, and delivery execution to improve reporting experiences and measurable product outcomes. You will work across stakeholders to shape requirements, support release readiness, and validate that enhancements deliver expected results. You will contribute to consistent client experiences by maintaining documentation, supporting enablement, and reinforcing best practices across regions. You will also support front-office partners with inquiry handling and structured escalation support across the client lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities

* **Analyze** client usage and performance data to generate insights that inform product priorities, reporting enhancements, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own** defined analytics and reporting initiatives from concept through requirements gathering, delivery coordination, and post-release validation.
* **Define** clear business requirements and success measures, ensuring traceability from client needs to delivered functionality.
* **Coordinate** cross-functional delivery activities with technology and operations partners to support timely, high-quality releases.
* **Monitor** key performance indicators and trends to identify emerging usage, balance, and revenue patterns and escalate insights to product leadership.
* **Support** go-to-market readiness by preparing launch materials, enablement content, and adoption follow-ups to validate product performance.
* **Partner** with sales coverage, implementation, and client service teams to refine use cases, metrics, and client narratives that support product growth.
* **Advise** internal stakeholders on solution capabilities and constraints to support smooth implementations and effective responses to client inquiries or escalations.
* **Maintain** product documentation and best practices, sharing updates through established channels and contributing to periodic training.
* **Identify** risks, issues, and control gaps; track remediation actions; and participate in post-implementation reviews to strengthen governance.

Required qualifications, skills and capabilities

* 3+ years of experience in cash management, liquidity, or treasury-related product management, product delivery, or product implementation within a complex organization.
* Experience performing data mining and analysis to inform product decisions, client outcomes, or measurable business impact.
* Experience translating analysis into stakeholder-ready outputs (for example, written summaries, reporting packs, or dashboards).
* Experience documenting business requirements and coordinating delivery with technology and operations teams.
* Experience working across sales, implementation, client service, operations, technology, and control partners (risk, compliance, legal).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, track actions to closure, and meet delivery timelines.
* Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including documenting decisions, actions, risks, and issues.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience supporting digital cash management channels, client reporting tools, or reporting product enhancements.
* Familiarity with payments and reporting standards
* Experience using reporting and data tools (for example, Business Objects or Microsoft Access).
* Experience building automated reporting solutions (for example, Excel macros or comparable automation).
* Experience operating within a global product team across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience supporting formal launch readiness routines and post-release performance reviews.
* Experience with data governance practices (for example, data quality, lineage, reconciliation, and change management) in regulated environments

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
