**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).

• Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
  
• Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**  
• Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
  
• Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
  
• Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
  
• Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.
  
**Product execution and prioritisation**  
• Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
  
• Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
  
• Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
  
• Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
  
• Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.
  
**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**  
• Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
  
• Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
  
• Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**  
**• Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.**  
**• Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.**  
**• Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.**  
**People and talent**  
**• Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.**  
**• Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.**  
**• Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.**  
**Risk, controls and governance**  
**• Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.**  
**• Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.**  
**• Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.**

• Benchmark market capabilities and emerging standards, converting insights into differentiated propositions and sequenced capability increments.

• Own the catalogue of prior-day and intraday statements, debit/credit advices, balance and transaction reports, including channel availability, eligibility, formats, service levels and client-facing documentation.

**• Maintain product standards, controls, risks, dependencies, decision records and audit evidence; ensure issues are escalated and remediated with clear ownership and closure criteria.**

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)**
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Who We Are**
--------------

Within Citi’s **Analytics & Information Management (AIM)** group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative, inclusive, and forward-looking culture empowers professionals to grow and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s leading financial institutions.

The **AIM Cards & Wealth** organization acts as the strategic intelligence engine across our credit card portfolios and wealth management franchises. We power customer acquisition, card spend stimulation, portfolio deepening, and wealth advisory insights. We actively integrate **modern data architectures, customer analytics, and Generative AI productivity frameworks** into our day-to-day operations to deliver hyper-relevant business insights, actionable customer intelligence, and optimized strategies for our cardholders and affluent wealth clients.

**What the Role Is**
--------------------

We are hiring a **Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)** to join our **Cards & Wealth Analytics, Insights & Optimization** team.

In this role, you will be the analytical owner and insight lead across Credit Card products (Acquisition, Spend Stimulation, Revolving, Balance Transfer, Loyalty/Rewards) and Wealth Management offerings (Investment Products, Wealth Advisory, Mortgages, FX, Time Deposits, and Digital Banking). You will combine **core data extraction, customer analytics, experimentation, and portfolio optimization** with **applied AI enablement**—leveraging modern GenAI tools, prompt and context engineering, knowledge base setup, retrieval optimization, Text-to-SQL assistants, and NLP to uncover high-impact growth opportunities, evaluate business performance, and accelerate analytical workflows.

As a C11-level specialist, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and data platforms, maintaining rigorous data governance while championing AI-assisted productivity and analytical optimization within the team.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **AI-Augmented Data Practitioner:** You actively leverage modern GenAI tools, conversational assistants, context engineering, and prompt design to supercharge analytics, code generation, and business insights.
* **Cards & Wealth Analytical Problem Solver:** You excel at translating complex business questions into high-performance queries using **SQL, PySpark, and Python**, analyzing spend patterns, portfolio balances, and customer lifecycle journeys to maximize business ROI.
* **Experimentation & Optimization Champion:** You apply structured analytical techniques—such as customer funnel diagnostics, test-versus-control lift analysis, and cohort evaluation—to uncover performance drivers across card products and wealth tiers.
* **Workflow Innovator:** You proactively automate repetitive processes—using AI for Text-to-SQL generation, automated insight summarization, knowledge base curation, and communication variant ideation.
* **Disciplined & Version-Controlled:** You manage analytical assets, queries, and automation scripts using **Git / GitHub** for robust code collaboration and version control.
* **Process & Controls Oriented:** You uphold strict data quality standards, customer privacy regulations, and risk/compliance controls across all analytical deliverables.

**What You Do (Core Responsibilities)**
---------------------------------------

**1. Data Extraction & Analytical Pipeline Management**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with Cards and Wealth Product Managers, Marketing, and Segment teams to translate business priorities and strategy objectives into robust technical logic.
* Develop, test, and execute data extraction queries and analytical pipelines using **SQL, PySpark, and Python** to generate high-quality analytical datasets and customer segment pools across big data environments.

**2. Cards & Wealth Analytics, Experimentation & Optimization**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* **Portfolio & Customer Funnel Analytics:** Analyze customer lifecycle funnels (Acquisition ➔ Activation ➔ Spend/Investment Engagement ➔ Balance/NNA Deepening ➔ Retention) across Card and Wealth portfolios to diagnose drop-offs and identify revenue-generating opportunities.
* **Experimentation & Lift Measurement:** Design and execute test-versus-control experimental frameworks and A/B test splits to isolate incremental product conversion, spend lift, revolving behavior, and Net New Assets (NNA).
* **Spend, Balance & Channel Optimization:** Analyze transactional patterns, merchant categories, revolving balances, and channel touchpoints (Mobile App, Online Banking, Direct, RM outreach) to recommend strategy refinements and targeting optimization.
* **Interactive Visualizations:** Build and maintain interactive performance tracking dashboards and diagnostic tools in **Tableau / Power BI** with automated underlying data aggregation feeds.

**3. GenAI Enablement, Context Engineering & Workflow Automation**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Context Engineering & Knowledge Base Setup:** Organize, structure, and curate internal analytics rules, data dictionaries, card/wealth product taxonomies, and strategy playbooks into searchable knowledge bases to enable high-accuracy AI retrieval and team knowledge sharing.
* **Retrieval Optimization:** Optimize data retrieval contexts and prompt structures to ensure conversational AI and retrieval-augmented tools deliver precise, hallucination-free analytical outputs and code.
* **Text-to-SQL & Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Apply Text-to-SQL interfaces and NLP techniques to accelerate ad-hoc data exploration, query generation, and unstructured client feedback/interaction analysis.
* **AI-Assisted Code Acceleration:** Utilize GenAI coding tools to rapidly draft, optimize, and debug complex SQL queries, PySpark data transformations, and Python scripts.
* **Automated Insights Summarization:** Leverage GenAI pipelines to generate executive narrative summaries, performance commentary, and anomaly explanations from card and wealth portfolio data.
* **Content & Message Variant Ideation:** Assist business partners by using Generative AI to generate personalized messaging copy variations, email subject lines, and client engagement talking points tailored to specific cards and wealth tiers.

**4. Code Collaboration, QA & Data Governance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Manage and version-control all analytical scripts, SQL queries, and configuration files using **Git / GitHub**.
* Perform thorough Quality Assurance (QA) validations—such as row count reconciliations, schema validations, null checks, and deduplication—before delivering datasets and insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data definitions, analytical assumptions, and data lineage.

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* **Analytical Datasets & Customer Segments:** Validated, high-precision datasets and customer target pools structured for business strategy and product analysis.
* **Cards & Wealth Optimization Decks:** Analytical insight decks isolating incremental lift, spend trends, revolving behavior, Net New Assets (NNA), and channel efficiency.
* **Interactive Analytics Dashboards:** Automated Tableau / Power BI dashboards for product funnel monitoring, portfolio KPIs, and stakeholder self-service.

**VP of Product, Tokenized Deposits**

Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each
* Decide what is standard product and what is customization, and hold that line with clients
* Define our standard implementation approach with banks, from first workshop to pilot to production
* Turn what we learn at each client into product, with one prioritized backlog across all projects
* Work with engineering and partners to deliver, and take responsibility for acceptance

**What you bring**

* Tokenized money shipped to production (tokenized deposits, stablecoins or DLT-based settlement) in a regulated setting
* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews
* Strong command of payments infrastructure and ISO 20022
* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects
* Fluent English; based in the UAE or willing to travel

**Nice to have**

* MENA or African market experience, Arabic
* Familiarity with interbank ledger initiatives (Swift, regional networks) and EVM chains
* Product experience under SOC 2 or ISO 27001/27017/27018
* Public speaking or published work on tokenization

**What we offer**

* Real ownership of the product of a company bringing tokenized deposits to banks in new markets
* A competitive package for a senior hire
* A seat in decisions about what we build and who we build it for.

**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to lead design for Krak and help us build a neobank people trust with their everyday money.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role with responsibility for design across the product. You’ll set the direction for the Krak experience, influence product strategy, and stay close to the details through execution.
  
  
We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.
  
  
Building a neobank means earning people’s trust in the moments that matter: getting started, moving money, making a payment, or understanding what’s happened when something goes wrong. You’ll help make those experiences clear and reliable, bringing the same care to everyday interactions as you do to the overall product vision.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Own the design direction for Krak, connecting onboarding, accounts, payments, and spending into one coherent experience.
* Make everyday banking clear and intuitive, from understanding balances and fees to tracking payments and resolving problems.
* Shape product strategy and roadmap decisions with product, engineering, and leadership.
* Lead hands-on design and prototyping, setting the standard for interaction design, visual craft, and accessibility.
* Work with compliance, risk, and operations to make verification, security, and account recovery straightforward for customers.
* Evolve Krak’s design system and align teams around consistent patterns.
* Use research and data to improve the product, and mentor designers through critique and collaboration.What You’ll Bring

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped consumer mobile experiences.
* Experience operating at Staff level or above, leading design across a product or several connected teams.
* Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to work through complex financial journeys and their edge cases.
* Advanced prototyping skills and experience building or evolving design systems.
* Evidence of influencing product strategy, resolving competing priorities, and guiding work through delivery.
* Clear communication, sound design judgment, and experience mentoring other designers.
* Experience designing banking, payments, or personal finance products is a strong plus.

* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners

* Optimize registration completion, KYC approval and client activation rates
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers on intuitive, accessible onboarding experiences
* Define and monitor onboarding KPIs, dashboards and operational performance metrics
* Run experiments and evaluate improvements using quantitative and qualitative data
* Balance conversion optimization with regulatory compliance and risk management

* Experience owning digital registration, authentication, KYC or client onboarding products

* Familiarity with KYC, AML, sanctions screening, client classification and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements
* Experience integrating third-party services and working with APIs
* Strong understanding of web and mobile product development
* Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into clear technical specifications and user stories
* Experience in Agile environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.
  + Identify resource and specialist requirements, including technology, cybersecurity and financial crime expertise.
* Operational and regulatory assurance
  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.
  + Assess customer fund safeguarding, float management, reconciliations, liquidity, applicable capital and guarantee requirements, and regulatory reporting.
  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.
  + Review consumer protection, customer disclosures, complaints handling, fraud controls and compliance with licence conditions.
  + Assess technology governance, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, outsourcing, business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Partner products and distribution
  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.
  + Review partner due diligence, contractual responsibilities, regulatory permissions, service standards, audit rights and ongoing oversight.
  + Assess customer journeys, disclosures, consent, fees, commissions, complaints ownership and escalation arrangements.
  + Examine controls over relevant money flows, including loan disbursements and repayments, investment subscriptions and withdrawals, and insurance premiums and refunds.
  + Evaluate whether du Pay’s activities remain within its permitted role and whether responsibilities between du Pay and each partner are clearly allocated.
  + Provide independent observations on material launches and changes without assuming management responsibility for product approval or control design.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, MENA Treasury
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The role**
------------

We are looking for an analytical and organised Senior Analyst to help deliver the MENA Treasury team’s safeguarding and operational responsibilities. Working closely with the Senior Associate, you will take ownership of defined daily processes, including safeguarding calculations and reconciliations, payment and funding activity, exception investigation, and management information. You will use your judgement to resolve routine issues, identify emerging risks, and escalate material or complex matters promptly.

This is a hands-on role in a regulated payments environment, with scope to improve the quality and resilience of Treasury processes. You will apply a strong control mindset and sound technical skills across safeguarding, cash management, liquidity, and Treasury operations, while helping translate policies into consistent day-to-day execution.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the preparation and review of daily safeguarding calculations and reconciliations for assigned MENA merchant funds, ensuring they follow regulations, approved policies, account structures, and controls.
* Analyse balances and supporting data, investigate breaks and aged reconciling items, coordinate resolution with relevant teams, and escalate potential shortfalls, control failures, or unusual activity promptly to the Senior Associate.
* Instruct and monitor approved safeguarding, funding, settlement, and intercompany transfers within delegated authority; perform appropriate checks and maintain clear evidence in line with control requirements.
* Monitor bank accounts, payment flows, and funding positions; analyse variances and follow through on operational queries with internal teams and banking partners.
* Produce and maintain accurate daily Treasury records, reconciliations, trackers, and management information; investigate data-quality issues and highlight meaningful trends or exceptions.
* Prepare recurring reporting and analysis for Treasury management and governance forums, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and clearly explained.
* Maintain procedures, process maps, control evidence, and supporting documentation for assigned processes; identify control gaps and recommend practical process improvements or automation.
* Coordinate evidence and responses for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and information requests; track actions to closure and escalate matters requiring interpretation or management input.
* Analyse payment flows and assess potential safeguarding and operational impacts of product, market, or regulatory changes; document findings and recommendations for review.
* Build effective working relationships with Treasury colleagues and partner teams across Finance, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Legal to resolve issues and deliver reliable execution.
* Provide cover for other MENA Treasury activities when required, operating within documented controls and delegated authority.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in Treasury, payments, banking, finance operations, or a related financial-services role; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Experience with reconciliations, payment operations, cash movements, or financial controls in a high-volume or regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of safeguarding and customer-funds protection, including segregation, reconciliations, fund flows, and escalation of exceptions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, investigate discrepancies, explain findings, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and confidence working with operational systems and reporting tools; experience with a Treasury management system is an advantage.
* A control-minded, organised approach and the confidence to raise a concern when something does not look right.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work constructively across teams and manage competing daily priorities.
* Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**It would be useful if you also have**
---------------------------------------

* Exposure to a regulated payments provider, Electronic Money Institution, bank, or similar financial institution.
* Familiarity with UAE payments or safeguarding requirements, including the CBUAE framework.
* Exposure to cash management, liquidity monitoring, FX, or Treasury systems such as Kyriba or FXall.
* Experience documenting procedures, supporting audits, or improving and automating operational processes.

**How you will contribute**
---------------------------

You will deliver accurate and timely Treasury processes, provide dependable analysis and control evidence, and ensure exceptions are understood and acted on promptly. You will bring ownership to defined areas of activity and help strengthen the team’s operational resilience across MENA safeguarding and Treasury.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

In this customer-facing role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to end users, consultants, system integrators, and channel partners, helping them design and deploy secure, scalable, and innovative access control solutions.

You will play a key role throughout the customer journey, from solution design and technical validation to PoCs, partner enablement, and deployment support. This position offers the opportunity to work on strategic projects across all sectors throughout the region.

  

**Who are we?**

  

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees.

  

**Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS):**

  

HID PACS, located in multiple development locations across the world, is recognized as the global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of access control security technology. HID Global, the provider of trusted identities to the world's people, places and things. A leader in the commercial security industry, this established company designs and manufactures physical access control systems.

  

**As our Pre-Sales Engineer- Access Control Biometrics , you’ll support HID’s success by:**

  

* Provide technical presales support for biometric access control opportunities across the MEA region.
* Gather customer requirements and design biometric access control solutions tailored to business, operational, and security needs.
* Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and PoC evaluations.
* Support RFIs, RFPs, tenders, compliance requirements, and technical proposals.
* Advise customers on biometric authentication, enrollment workflows, liveness detection, template storage options, privacy, and cybersecurity best practices.
* Support integrations with Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), identity management platforms, Time & Attendance and visitor management systems.
* Deliver technical training and enablement programs to consultants, partners, and customers.
* Provide remote and on-site technical support during evaluations, deployments, and customer engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Technical Support teams.

* Work closely with Engineering on customer-specific product customizations (CPOs), feature requests, and solution development initiatives.
* Maintain accurate records of customer engagements, technical activities, and opportunity progress, with regular reporting to stakeholders

* Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive insights to support business growth and product strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies, industry verticals, and market trends.

* Ability to interpret technical specifications, integration guides, and industry standards to support solution design and customer engagements
* Represent the company at customer meetings, exhibitions, conferences, and industry events.
* Support customers and partners across the MEA region remotely, extending beyond your primary territory as business needs require.
* Ability to travel extensively throughout the MEA region

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in Presales Engineering, Solution Engineering, Technical Consulting, Professional Services, or Technical Support within the Physical Security, Access Control, Identity Management, or Security Technology industry.
* Proven experience supporting biometric, identity, credential, or access control projects from design through deployment and go-live.
* Demonstrated experience working with customers, consultants, channel partners, and system integrators in a technical advisory capacity.
* Strong presentation, communication, public speaking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, including IT, Security, Facilities, and Executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Able to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional, geographically dispersed teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Strong knowledge of the Middle East & Africa (MEA) market, including experience engaging with key end users, consultants, system integrators, and strategic verticals such as government, critical infrastructure, transportation, banking, smart cities, healthcare, and oil & gas.

* Hands-on experience with Facial Recognition and Fingerprint Authentication technologies, including biometric enrolment, 1:1 verification, 1:N identification, FAR/FRR optimization, liveness detection, and biometric performance evaluation.
* Experience supporting biometric evaluations, POCs, and large-scale customer deployments.

Job Description

  

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

**JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION**

To support the Global Treasury, Trade & Tokenization Client Solutions team in originating, structuring and delivering transaction banking solutions for Wholesale Banking Group clients, with primary focus on Real Estate & Hospitality clients. The role will partner with Coverage, Product and control functions to analyze client needs, prepare and execute Cash Management, Liquidity, Trade Finance and digital-channel solutions, and contribute to revenue, CASA, wallet-share and client-experience objectives within First Abu Dhabi Bank’s risk appetite and governance framework.
  
The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Client and opportunity analysis: Analyze client business models, project and operating cash flows, transaction journeys, working-capital cycles, existing bank utilization and competitor positioning to identify Cash, Trade, Liquidity and digital opportunities.
* Sector-focused origination: Support calling plans and account strategies for Real Estate & Hospitality clients, including developers, contractors, property managers, hotel owners and operators, within the assigned Real Estate & Hospitality portfolio.
* Solution development: Work with Coverage and Product teams to design customer-focused solutions across payments, collections, virtual accounts, escrow and project accounts, liquidity and liabilities, host-to-host/API connectivity, cards, core trade, guarantees, open-account trade, Supply Chain Finance and Receivables Finance.
* Client engagement: Prepare client briefs, presentations, proposals, product comparisons, meeting materials and call reports; participate in client meetings, product demonstrations and solution workshops, and maintain disciplined follow-up on agreed actions.
* RFP and proposal management: Coordinate timely, accurate and commercially compelling responses to RFPs, service enquiries and pricing requests, ensuring that solution design, operational readiness, legal terms, economics and implementation requirements are aligned.
* Pipeline and portfolio discipline: Maintain opportunity pipelines, client activity records and management information; track mandates, revenue, CASA, facility utilization, digital penetration, implementation progress and outstanding actions, escalating gaps or delays.
* Transaction execution: Coordinate credit, pricing and product approvals, documentation, implementation readiness and hand-offs with Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Onboarding and service delivery: Support account opening, KYC and due-diligence requirements, documentation follow-up, implementation and resolution of client issues to deliver a timely and high-quality client experience.
* Commercial outcomes: Contribute to growth in transaction banking revenue, CASA and operating balances, trade utilisation, fee income, digital adoption and overall GTx wallet share, with appropriate attention to risk-adjusted returns and pricing discipline.
* Risk and control: Comply with applicable Credit, Compliance, AML, sanctions, fraud, operational-risk, conduct, data-privacy and information-security requirements; identify and escalate exceptions, control issues and client concerns promptly.
* Market and product insight: Monitor sector developments, competitor activity and client trends; share practical insights and identify opportunities for new products, improved structures and better client journeys.
Process improvement and learning: Build strong technical and sector knowledge, support improvements to workflows and reporting, and complete required learning, coaching and on-the-job development activities.  

**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Transaction banking knowledge: Basic understanding of cash management, payments, collections, liquidity management, trade finance and digital banking solutions, with the ability and commitment to develop deeper technical knowledge. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Client orientation: Professional, responsive and service-focused, with the confidence to support client meetings and follow through with reliably on commitments.
* Communication and presentation: Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to prepare concise proposals, presentations and management updates.
* Stakeholder management: Collaborative and able to coordinate effectively across Coverage, Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external client stakeholders.
* Execution discipline: Organised, attentive to detail and able to prioritise multiple tasks, maintain accurate records and deliver against deadlines in a controlled environment.
* Digital and systems capability: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM, workflow, digital-banking, pipeline and reporting systems. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Curious, accountable, adaptable and commercially minded, with a willingness to learn and operate under pressure while maintaining strong conduct and control standards.
* Must be a strong team player who is eager to learn and has good communication skills.
Must be organized, reliable, and able to work under a manager's guidance.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience: Graduate or early career profile; 0-2 years of relevant experience in banking, transaction banking, client service, sales support, operations or a related area is preferred.
* Arabic capability is advantageous.

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

  

**Life at FAB:**

  

Working at FAB means being part of a team of talented and passionate individuals with a shared vision to support the ambitions of our stakeholders to "Grow Stronger." We embrace the needs of our customers across the globe with a sense of responsibility and confidence driven by extensive expertise that can only be delivered by an ambitious world-class organization

  

**Career Development:**

  

FAB offers unique career choices, a chance to innovate, craft solutions for the future, and express yourself in a performance-based culture that will unleash the best in you. Whether you are an experienced professional or just starting your career, FAB provides a range of learning and development initiatives to support all employees through training and skill development.

  

**Our Values:**

  

At FAB, we place our customers at the core of our activities, live our values each day in every way, celebrate achievements, and empower each other to deliver leading solutions. We have structured plans for the recruitment and career progression of Emirati talent to enable them to make a mark in the financial and banking sector both regionally and globaly that rewards your hard work and dedication.

  

Join our team and be part of a journey to shape the future of banking.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
You will run Capital.com's day-to-day social presence across the Middle East and North Africa. Social is often the first place a trader in the region meets our brand, so the work you publish shapes how people understand trading, risk and the platform before they ever open an account. You will sit in the MENA marketing team in Dubai, working with content, performance, compliance and product to turn market moments into clear, useful posts in Arabic and English. Our mission is to give traders clarity and technology they can rely on, and this role carries that into the feed every day.

### **What you will do:**

* Own the weekly content calendar for MENA channels: Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat and Telegram.
* Write and publish posts, captions, stories and short-form scripts in Arabic and English that explain markets plainly.
* React to market events (rate decisions, oil moves, earnings, gold) with timely, accurate content within agreed turnaround times.
* Brief the Video Editor and designers, review drafts and keep output on brand.
* Route every post through financial promotions review and keep required risk warnings in place.
* Manage community replies and DMs, escalating client issues to Customer Support and complaints to Compliance.
* Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth and social-sourced registrations, and act on what the numbers show.
* Work with the performance team so organic content supports paid campaigns and regional launches.

### **What you bring:**

* 3+ years managing brand social channels, or an equivalent portfolio that shows you grew an audience.
* Native-level Arabic and fluent English, with the judgment to write for Gulf and wider MENA audiences.
* Hands-on experience with native platform analytics and a scheduling tool such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite or Later.
* Comfort editing short-form video and graphics in CapCut, Canva or Adobe Express.
* Accuracy under time pressure: you check facts and figures before anything goes live.
Clear written communication and the ability to take feedback from Compliance without losing pace.  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of financial promotion rules (SCA, FCA COBS 4 or CySEC).
* Familiarity with UAE Media Council advertising and influencer requirements.
* Interest in markets and trading, and an understanding of CFDs.
* Experience with creator or influencer partnerships in the GCC.

### **What you will get in return:**

* **Competitive Salary:** We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* **Work-Life Harmony:** Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* **Generous Time Off:** Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* **Employee Referral Program:** Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* **Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits:** From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* **Workation Wonderland:** Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* **Volunteer Days:** Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

------------------------

jobs.description:
**About Firstsource**
Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a commercially astute and technically visionary Director to own and scale Firstsource's AI & Cloud product portfolio across multiple product lines. You will set product strategy, engineering standards, and investment priorities across the portfolio, while mentoring a team of Associate Directors and engineering leaders. With 18+ years of experience, you bring deep Python and Generative AI expertise, enterprise cloud architecture mastery, and the executive presence to shape AI product strategy at the CXO level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Strategy & Architecture**

* Define multi-year product strategy and investment roadmap across the AI product portfolio.
* Set enterprise architecture standards and reference patterns embedding Generative AI and agentic workflows across all product lines.
* Approve major architecture decisions and technology bets across product engineering teams.
* Represent product strategy to executive leadership and, where relevant, the board.

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. The company’s philosophy prioritizes planning before execution and places client interests first, combining professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.
* The company is expanding its advisory footprint and seeks a leader to build and scale its Wealth Advisory business in Bengaluru, translating its strong foundation (₹5,000+ Cr Assets Under Tracking, ₹1,000+ Cr Assets Under Advisory, 2,300+ Paid Customers) into a scalable, sustainable, and profitable business.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the Bengaluru business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy, and profitability.
* Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting affluent professionals, HNI clients, and other relevant segments through referrals, professional networks, chartered accountants, corporate relationships, and strategic alliances.
* Personally lead key client conversations, business negotiations, and high-value conversions; manage the full customer journey from prospecting to long-term advisory.
* Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios, and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.
* Champion a planning-led, fiduciary, and client-first advisory approach; understand clients’ goals, income, liabilities, risk profiles, liquidity needs, and investment horizons to support comprehensive financial planning.
* Ensure recommendations are appropriate to clients’ circumstances, supported by suitable documentation and disclosures; drive holistic financial planning over transactional, product-led selling.
* Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking, and proactive client engagement in collaboration with research, investment, product, and technology teams.
* Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention, and deeper advisory engagement; convert paid financial planning customers into ongoing advisory relationships.
* Improve renewals, referrals, customer lifetime value, and relationship longevity through consistent service and demonstrable advisory value.
* Establish client segmentation, engagement frequency, review, and escalation frameworks; personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects.
* Lead an initial team of six professionals across advisory, relationship management, and business development; set clear KRAs, revenue goals, productivity benchmarks, and accountability mechanisms.
* Recruit, coach, and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation, and commercial acumen; build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and capability-building initiatives; identify and develop future leaders; scale the team in line with approved budgets and performance.
* Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans; track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention, and individual productivity.
* Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions; balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity, and profitability; build dashboards and repeatable processes for scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience, and advisor productivity; use digital tools, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice scalable and accessible.
* Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education, and lead generation; work with operations, finance, and compliance teams for efficient execution and robust governance.
* Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.
* Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based, and client-first advisory philosophy; ensure compliance with SEBI requirements, internal policies, and ethical standards; maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures, and transparency.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in BFSI / Wealth Management, including at least 4 years in business development and team leadership.
* Proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients, and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation, and relationship management.
* Experience working with affluent professionals and HNI clients, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships.
* Commercial judgment, analytical ability, and ownership of business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate, and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Both NISM Series X-A and Series X-B certifications are mandatory.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.
* Deep understanding of digital tools and technology-enabled advisory workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.
* Culture that values ownership, ethical advice, and measurable outcomes.
* Support to develop a capable team and build operating systems that support the next stage of expansion.

* Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.

* Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
* Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
* Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
* Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You:**

* Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space

* A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
* A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
* Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
* Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
* Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Specialist
jobs.description:
**Senior Accountant US Accounting (Sage Intacct)**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Experience: 4 to 7 Years**

**Qualification: Qualified CA**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Work Mode: Work from Home / Hybrid (as applicable)**

**Shift: US Shift Eastern Time Zone**

**Software: Sage Intacct, Ramp, MS Excel**

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a competent and experienced accounting professional to join our US Accounting Services team.

The selected candidate will be responsible for independently managing the complete accounting operations of multiple US-based legal entities belonging to a leading renewable energy company engaged in distributed generation, commercial and industrial solarenergy, community solar and energy storage projects.

This is an end-to-end accounting ownership role involving transaction processing,general ledger management, reconciliations, month-end closing, financial reporting and direct coordination with the client's US finance team.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. End-to-End Accounting and General Ledger**

* Independently manage day-to-day accounting operations for assigned US legal

entities.

* Record and review accounting transactions in Sage Intacct.
* Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses and

other adjustments.

* Ensure appropriate accounting classification and accurate maintenance of general ledger accounts.
* Manage intercompany accounting and reconciliations across multiple legal entities.
* Preparing, compiling, and processing journal entries and other financial transactions and performing account reconciliations to ensure the accuracy of account balances and the proper accounting treatment of various transactions as per US GAAP.

  

**2. Accounts Payable and Vendor Management**

* Review and process vendor invoices through Ramp.
* Perform appropriate GL coding, cost allocation and expense classification.
* Record approved invoices in Sage Intacct.
* Monitor vendor balances, outstanding bills and AP ageing.
* Investigate and resolve invoice-related discrepancies.

  

**3. Bank and Balance Sheet Reconciliations**

* Independently perform monthly bank reconciliations.
* Investigate and resolve unreconciled transactions and bank differences.
* Prepare monthly balance sheet account reconciliations.
* Ensure all ledger balances are supported by appropriate schedules and documentation.

  

**4. Community Solar Accounting**

* Record community solar-related receipts and collections.
* Reconcile customer/subscriber collections with bank statements and accounting records.
* Identify unapplied receipts and investigate reconciliation differences.
* Maintain accurate accounting records for community solar-related transactions.

  

**5. Month-end and Year-end Closing**

* Independently manage monthly closing activities for assigned entities.
* Prepare and post necessary month-end journal entries.
* Review accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, intercompany balances and other ledger accounts.
* Prepare and review trial balances.
* Ensure timely closure of books and adherence to reporting timelines.

  

**6. Financial Reporting**

* Prepare entity-level Profit & Loss statements and Balance Sheets.
* Prepare supporting schedules and management reporting packages.
* Analyse significant movements and investigate unusual balances.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial statements.
* Coordinate with the client for financial reporting and closing requirements.
* Assisting in preparation of various consolidated financial statements.

**7. Client Coordination and Audit Support**

* Directly interact with the client's US-based finance and accounting team.
* Participate in periodic accounting and month-end review meetings.
* Respond to accounting queries and resolve issues independently.
* Coordinate with the client for accounting inputs, approvals and supporting

documents.

* Support annual audits and provide necessary schedules, reconciliations and explanations.
* Assisting with various compliance/due diligence work for operating projects, acquisition, or for project financing
* Prepare tax return work papers for submission to corporate tax return preparer.
* Partner with FinOps team to ensure compliance with DSCR and waterfall

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA / CMA
* 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in accounting, preferably with US-based clients.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and US GAAP.
* Hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, reconciliations and month-

end closing.

* Experience in preparing financial statements and balance sheet schedules.
* Good understanding of intercompany accounting and multi-entity accounting.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Sequoia/Sage Intacct : Hands-on experience will be strongly preferred.
* Ramp: Experience with AP automation and invoice processing tools is desirable.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Familiarity with US accounting practices and financial reporting requirements.
* Knowledge of fixed asset accounting, project accounting and Construction in progress (CIP) will be an added advantage.
* Proven ability to manage multiple reporting timelines and complex fund structures

  

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Must be willing to work in US shift timings (Eastern Time Zone).
* Must be comfortable working directly with international clients.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage accounting operations for multiple legal entities.
* Strong ownership, analytical ability and attention to detail.
* Ability to meet strict month-end closing and reporting deadlines.

  

**Preferred Industry Experience candidates with experience in the following sectors will be preferred:**

* Renewable Energy / Solar Energy
* Infrastructure and Project Accounting
* Energy and Utilities
* Real Estate
* US Accounting and Outsourcing Services
* Individual needs to know hoe to use Claude / any other AI tool for efficiencies

  

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes along withcurrent CTC, expected CTC, notice period and experience with Sage Intacct.**
