jobs.title: Principal - SAP RTR
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

We are seeking an experienced Principal Record to Report (RTR) to join our Global Capability Center (GCC) and provide functional leadership for SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions supporting enterprise transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and continuous business process improvement.

This offshore leadership role will serve as the primary SAP Record to Report functional expert within the GCC, partnering closely with global Finance, Business Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and System Integration partners. The Principal will play a key role in the BD integration program while establishing scalable global finance solutions and standards for future acquisitions.

The role is responsible for delivering end-to-end SAP Finance solutions across the Record to Report landscape, supporting global design, solution configuration, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement. The Principal will drive standardization using SAP best practices while ensuring compliance with global accounting standards and local statutory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Finance Solution Leadership

* Serve as the Global Capability Center functional lead for SAP Record to Report (RTR).
* Support the Finance Solution Lead and Business Process Owners in delivering SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities.
* Lead functional design activities for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, ERP modernization, and business integration programs.
* Drive global process harmonization while minimizing customizations and maximizing SAP standard functionality.
* Recommend SAP best practices and future-state finance processes.

SAP Functional Expertise

* Lead solution design, configuration, and support for SAP S/4HANA Finance including: General Ledger (Universal Journal), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Margin Analysis (COPA), Intercompany Accounting, Parallel Ledgers, Financial Close, Group Reporting.
* Lead the design, configuration, and support of SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions to enable electronic invoicing (eInvoicing), statutory reporting, tax reporting, and country-specific regulatory compliance across global operations.
* Own configuration and process design for SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), ensuring accurate revenue recognition per ASC 606/IFRS 15 across performance obligations and contract structures
* Own integration architecture between S/4HANA and adjacent systems

M&A Integration

* Support finance integration activities for acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs, including the BD integration program.
* Perform fit-gap analysis between acquired company ERP processes and Waters' SAP S/4HANA global template.
* Support legal entity integration, organizational structure design, chart of accounts mapping, ledger design, fiscal calendar alignment, and financial reporting harmonization.
* Collaborate with Data Migration teams on historical data conversion, opening balances, reconciliation, and financial validation.
* Support deployment and cutover planning to ensure business continuity during integration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Treasury, Tax, Planning, Reporting, and Master Data teams.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP Finance and boundary applications.
* Support interface design and integration using SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, and middleware technologies.
* Participate in architecture reviews, solution workshops, and design governance activities.

Delivery & Continuous Improvement

* Lead functional configuration, testing, defect resolution, and deployment activities.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and Hypercare.
* Develop functional specifications and support technical development where required.
* Identify automation and process improvement opportunities across global finance operations.
* Mentor analysts and consultants within the GCC and promote SAP S/4HANA best practices.

Qualifications

* 10+ years of SAP Finance implementation experience with at least 5 years supporting SAP S/4HANA.
* Deep functional expertise across SAP Record to Report processes.
* Strong hands-on experience with: Universal Journal, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Material Ledger, Product Costing, Margin Analysis (COPA), Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Parallel Ledgers, Intercompany Accounting, Financial Close, Group Reporting, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), RAR
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA 2023 or later releases.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), including electronic invoicing (eInvoicing), statutory reporting, and digital tax compliance. Experience implementing country-specific DRC requirements and integrating with indirect tax processes is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience including direct configuration or functional ownership of Revenue Account Recognition (RAR)
* Experience supporting ERP integrations during mergers, acquisitions, or large-scale transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of legal entities, organizational structures, fiscal year variants, ledgers, currencies, accounting principles, and financial master data.
* Experience with finance data migration, reconciliation, and cutover planning.
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, and finance integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of SOX controls, audit requirements, IFRS, US GAAP, and statutory reporting.
* Experience working in a Global Capability Center or offshore delivery organization supporting global stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline.

Success Factors in Year One

* Successfully support the Record to Report workstream for the BD integration and future M&A initiatives.
* Deliver high-quality SAP Finance solutions aligned with the Waters global template.
* Lead finance configuration, testing, data migration, and deployment activities with minimal business disruption.
* Establish strong partnerships with global Finance teams, Business Technology, and implementation partners.
* Improve standardization and adoption of SAP S/4HANA Finance best practices across the enterprise.
* Mentor GCC team members and contribute to building a high-performing SAP Finance Center of Excellence.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:

* Knowledge of ‘Micro-Service’ driven approach to design, build, test and deployment of a major system.
* Experience in Software development consisting of the languages and technologies like Spring, Springboot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, React and Node.js
* Recognising, selecting and applying appropriate Design patterns, frameworks according to business benefit, maintainability and delivery priorities and constrains.

This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**

**Job Description**

You will turn business priorities into practical, well-governed delivery plans and roadmaps, guide multi-disciplinary software squads through design, build, test, release and transition into service, and mentor the Product and Project Managers who deliver alongside you. This is a senior, visible role with the opportunity to influence how delivery is done across the portfolio.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead the delivery of multiple strategic software initiatives across the Engineering portfolio, covering new products, platform builds, enhancements and sustain, and keep teams focused on business priorities, value and achievable plans.
* Lead and support squad members through effective line management, ensuring appropriate assignments, continuous development, wellbeing and strong performance.

* More than 10 years experience in software delivery, programme or project management, leading the delivery of software products and digital change of increasing scope and complexity.
* Significant experience in digital service management or a related field, leading the delivery and sustain of IT or digital technology.
* Significant experience in software deployment on a large scale into multiple sites on challenging timeframes
* A proven track record of managing large-scale, multi-team software deliveries, including custom-built applications, platforms, integrations and SaaS solutions, while navigating organizational complexity.
* Expertise in delivery approaches such as Agile, Lean, waterfall and scaling frameworks, and the judgement to use what fits the work.

* A solid understanding of modern software engineering, including DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native architecture, APIs and quality engineering, so you can engage credibly with software engineering teams.

**Useful, but not crucial**

**How You Will Lead**
You will lead through ownership, collaboration and influence as well as line leadership. Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

jobs.title: Head of Product – Distribution & Revenue Generation
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution & Revenue Product Strategy**

* Own the regional product vision, strategy and roadmap for Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity and Revenue Management Systems, aligned to APAC commercial priorities and the global Accommodation platform direction
* Define a coherent distribution and revenue product architecture that enhances our customers positioning whilst maximising visibility and yield across the channels that matter in APAC markets
* Set prioritisation frameworks that balance direct booking growth, channel partner breadth, rate/revenue optimisation and customer retention
* Lead product investment decisions in partnership with engineering and finance, grounded in commercial impact – distribution cost reduction, RevPAR/ADR uplift and channel yield
* Monitor the competitive OTA, channel management and revenue management landscape across APAC (including region-specific players and metasearch/OTA dynamics) to continuously sharpen product positioning

**AI-Native Distribution & Revenue Capabilities**

* Work with engineering leadership to ensure AI/agentic features sit on a scalable, interoperable data foundation and connect cleanly into the global Accommodation platform migration
* Define packaging, pricing and migration pathways so customers can adopt new distribution and revenue capability with confidence

* Partner with the GM APAC, the Head of Product UK, Head of Engineering APAC and regional commercial leadership to ensure the roadmap directly supports direct booking mix growth, distribution cost reduction and NRR/GRR performance

* Engage directly with key hotel and hotel-group customers across APAC to validate roadmap direction, and directly with OTA, GDS and channel partners to maintain and extend commercial relationships built under STAAH's founder-led model
* Support pricing and packaging strategy across the distribution and revenue product portfolio, including tiering for digital marketing services and RMS capability

**Product Delivery & Quality**

* Lead a regional product management team, setting clear standards for discovery, prioritisation, delivery and iteration across the distribution and revenue product lines
* Work in close partnership with the STAAH and SHR engineering organisations to ensure delivery velocity, quality and alignment with the broader platform vision
* Establish product governance rhythms consistent with the HCC's Service Catalogue / SLA and Communities of Practice model, including roadmap reviews and launch readiness criteria
* Ensure product releases are accompanied by strong GTM readiness, including partner and sales enablement, documentation and customer communication

**Cross-functional & Regional Leadership**

* Partner with regional Go-to-Market and commercial teams to translate distribution and revenue product capability into propositions that resonate with APAC hoteliers
* Collaborate with the Hospitality CPO and global Accommodation product leadership to align the regional roadmap with the broader platform strategy and 2027 migration
* Work with STAAH's product engineering leadership to ensure technical foundations support the distribution and revenue roadmap, and act as the connective product leader across engineering sites

* Experience operating across APAC hospitality markets, with credibility to engage OTA, GDS and channel partners directly

You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery: architecture-to-production execution, operational excellence, reliability, security/compliance, and an automation-first quality strategy. - Establish and communicate technical direction in partnership with Product Management and Architecture to ensure the platform meets business goals and non-functional requirements.
  
2) Low-Latency, Reliability, and Performance (NFR-First)
  
- Drive performance and latency engineering: define latency/throughput SLOs, performance budgets, regression testing, and capacity planning to maintain predictable low-latency behavior under load.
  
- Build “always-on” operational readiness: observability (logs/metrics/traces), runbooks, safe rollouts (feature flags, progressive delivery), and rapid rollback practices.
  
- Partner with Platform/SRE functions to ensure Kubernetes runtime reliability patterns (HA, scaling, and operational tooling) are built into the product delivery lifecycle. ,
  
3) DevOps / Platform Engineering Ownership
  
- Lead the team’s cloud-native delivery model on Kubernetes (including GitOps-based deployment and configuration-as-code). ,
  
- Own and evolve CI/CD and artifact practices using technologies such as Ansible, Nexus, Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller), and Kubernetes-native release workflows.
  
- Ensure secure, repeatable environment provisioning and reliable deployments across dev/test/stage/prod with automation as the default.
  
4) Quality Engineering & Test Automation (Shift-Left)
  
- Build a “quality-first” culture with an automated testing strategy across unit/integration/e2e, with strong coverage targets and non-negotiable quality gates.
  
- Implement and operationalize modern test orchestration and automation tooling, including Testkube, and enforce reliable, maintainable CI test execution.
  
- Drive security and compliance testing as part of CI/CD (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning), ensuring regulated-workload readiness and auditability. ,
  
5) AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)
  
- Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions: 1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
  
2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability. ,
  
  
- Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging.
  
- Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.
  
6) People Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
- Coach engineers, DevOps, and QE leads; build career plans, performance feedback loops, and hiring strategies to raise the talent bar.
  
- Collaborate with Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations leaders to deliver outcomes with transparency, predictable execution, and clear metrics.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
- 15+ years in software engineering building distributed systems; 5+ years leading teams (engineering + DevOps and/or QE leadership experience strongly preferred).
  
- Proven experience building and operating low-latency, high-throughput systems in banking, payments, or other regulated transaction platforms.
  
- Hands-on expertise with: - Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures (microservices, containerization, orchestration)
  
- Java backend development (high-performance, concurrent, resilient services)
  
- Angular (modern web UI, performance-minded frontend engineering)
  
- Ansible (automation/configuration management)
  
- Nexus (artifact repository and dependency management)
  
- Cloud Infrastructure ( Familiarity with deployment and development on public and private cloud Azure , AWS, OpenShift)
  
- Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller) for packaging/config/deploy workflows
  
- Testkube for test orchestration and automation
  
  
- Demonstrated delivery of AI projects implemented in real environments (production or production-like), such as: - GenAI-assisted developer workflows with measurable outcomes (quality/velocity/defect reduction), and/or
  
- AI/ML capabilities embedded into product or operations (e.g., automated diagnostics, anomaly detection, intelligent triage, or similar).
  
  
- Strong engineering excellence mindset: automated testing, security-by-design, observability, and disciplined release practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Experience with GitOps and Kubernetes platform components (policy-as-code, secrets management, progressive delivery). ,
  
- Experience with regulated environments and compliance constraints (PCI/GDPR/SOC2) and integrating security controls into CI/CD. ,
  
- Experience scaling test automation and implementing testing pyramids and coverage standards across multiple teams.
  
- Familiarity with internal developer platform concepts (“golden paths”, self-service, reduced cognitive load).
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

jobs.title: Senior z/OS Unix & zLinux Integration Enginee
jobs.description:
**Your role:** *As a Senior z/OS UNIX & zLinux Integration Engineer, you will spearhead efforts to modernize and integrate our mainframe with contemporary platforms and tools.* Were seeking an **experienced z/OS Systems Engineer** with **expertise in z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** and **IBM zLinux** (Linux on IBM Z) to drive innovation in bridging mainframe and distributed systems. In this role, you will:

**Design and implement enhancements** to our **z/OS UNIX and zLinux environments** – ensuring robust, secure, and scalable UNIX system services on z/OS and optimizing Linux on IBM Z for enterprise workloads. You will apply best-in-class engineering practices to develop new features, automate manual tasks, and improve the developer experience on the mainframe.

* **Accelerate Modernization** – **Leverage modern interfaces** like **z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF)**, the **Zowe** framework, and **IBM Wazi** to integrate mainframe systems into **contemporary DevOps and cloud environments**. This includes enabling REST APIs and CLI tools that allow distributed teams and modern applications to seamlessly interact with z/OS resources. You will play a key role in making the mainframe a more **open and agile platform**, bridging the gap between legacy systems and modern development practices.
* **Implement DevOps and CI/CD practices** for mainframe – Work on integrating z/OS with enterprise **DevOps pipelines**, enabling efficient use of mainframe capabilities in continuous integration and delivery processes. Introduce and support tools such as **Git or Ansible** for z/OS automation, and promote the adoption of modern mainframe development environments (e.g., using **Zowe CLI and APIs** for automation; exploring containerized dev/test frameworks like **IBM Wazi** for z/OS).
* **Ensure system interoperability** – Develop and maintain **interfaces between z/OS and distributed (Linux/Unix) systems**, enabling smooth data exchange and process integration. This may involve building secure API layers, cross-platform file sharing (e.g. via NFS or Zowe API Mediation Layer), and connecting mainframe services to cloud or hybrid environments.
* **Operational Excellence** – Integrate advanced **observability** and **monitoring** for USS and zLinux processes, using tools like system logs, **SMF data**, and modern monitoring dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, etc.) to ensure performance and reliability. You will also **provide third-level support** for complex UNIX and Linux-related issues on the mainframe, employing deep problem analysis to identify root causes and permanent fixes.
* **Technical leadership** – As a senior engineer, you will make high-impact decisions regarding our mainframe integration strategy. You’ll present solution designs and roadmaps to **stakeholders and technical leadership**, advocating for improvements that enhance agility and align with business needs. You will collaborate with architects and other senior engineers to design hybrid solutions that leverage mainframe strengths in a modern IT landscape. Furthermore, you will contribute to our culture by **mentoring colleagues** (e.g., in using new tools or approaches) and by sharing expertise in internal forums and guilds.

**Your team:** You’ll be part of the **Mainframe Platform Core Services** crew, working within a specialized **zSoftware** pod. This cross-functional team focuses on evolving the mainframe to support **new interfaces and hybrid-cloud connectivity**. You will closely partner with team members in **Core z/OS Engineering, Middleware (CICS/MQ) Integration, Security, and Cloud Enablement** to develop end-to-end solutions that connect mainframe services with modern platforms. The team operates globally, so you’ll collaborate with colleagues across different regions and time zones, bringing together a variety of skills to modernize our mainframe environment. The working model is agile, emphasizing iterative improvements, quick feedback loops, and continuous learning as we adopt new technologies in the mainframe context.

**Your expertise:** You are a *seasoned mainframe engineer (8–10+ years of experience)* with a blend of **traditional mainframe skills and modern tooling knowledge**. Key qualifications include:

* **z/OS UNIX System Services (USS)** – Advanced knowledge of **UNIX on z/OS** (shell environment, POSIX interfaces, zFS file system management, Unix security model) and the ability to develop and debug programs or scripts running under USS. Experience porting or integrating open-source tools (e.g., Git, Python) onto USS is an advantage.
* **Linux on IBM Z** – **In-depth understanding of zLinux** (Linux running in KVM or LPAR on IBM Z hardware), including system installation, networking, and performance tuning in a mainframe environment. Familiarity with virtualization via **KVM** and concepts like IFL processors, CPU management, and resource sharing on IBM Z is expected.
* **Modernization Tools** – Hands-on experience with or strong knowledge of **modern mainframe tools** such as **z/OSMF** (IBM z/OS Management Facility) for web-based system management, **Zowe** (Open Mainframe Project’s framework for mainframe integration) — e.g., usage of Zowe CLI/Explorer and API mediation for connecting mainframe services with cloud – and **IBM Wazi** for cloud-based mainframe development/testing. Your ability to utilize these tools and frameworks is critical for enabling an **API-driven, cloud-integrated mainframe** environment.
* **Systems Programming & Scripting** – Proficiency in **shell scripting**, REXX, and programming languages like **Python or C/C++** on z/OS or Linux, enabling you to create automation scripts, API endpoints, and system utilities bridging z/OS with distributed systems. Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (e.g., **Ansible on z/OS**) is a plus, emphasizing code-driven system management.
* **Software Maintenance & Configuration** – Solid knowledge of SMP/E, with proven experience in installing, configuring, and migrating new product versions.
* **Networks & Security** – Good grasp of mainframe networking (TCP/IP on z/OS) and **cross-platform security protocols**. Understanding how to manage secure APIs and connectivity between z/OS and external systems (e.g., leveraging encryption, RACF rules for cross-platform access, etc.) is important for safe integration.
* **Performance & Reliability** – Experience optimizing the performance of USS workloads and zLinux instances, including resource allocation, workload balancing, and monitoring of key metrics (like CPU, memory usage on IFLs, network throughput) to ensure stable operations. Familiarity with **mainframe performance tools** and logs (SMF, RMF) is expected.
* **Strategic & Innovative Mindset** – Passion for **modernizing mainframe usage** and staying updated on industry trends (for example, containerization on zLinux, cloud integration, DevOps practices for mainframe). Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and incorporate them into the mainframe environment when beneficial.
* **Communication & Collaboration** – **Excellent English communication skills** are **essential**, enabling you to collaborate effectively with global teams and to clearly present modernization plans to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable in a leadership capacity, coordinating initiatives across different groups, and nurturing a culture where mainframe and distributed teams collaborate seamlessly on hybrid solutions.

**By joining our team as a senior mainframe engineer in any of these roles, you will be empowered to work independently, make critical technical decisions, and visibly shape the future of our mainframe platform** in a dynamic, agile environment. You’ll leverage your deep specialty—be it base z/OS systems, workload automation, or mainframe Unix/Linux integration—to drive high-impact improvements that keep our mainframe systems robust, modern, and aligned with business needs. We value proactive

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

HR ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** Head People & Culture  
**Role:** Asst. Manager HR

**Performance Allocation:**

* **70% – Talent Acquisition & Onboarding**
* **30% – HR Operations**

1. End-to-End Recruitment & Talent Acquisition – 70%

The HR professional will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower requisition to successful candidate onboarding.

**A. Manpower Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate with Department Heads, Reporting Managers and HRBP to understand manpower requirements.
* Collect and validate approved manpower requisitions.
* Understand job descriptions, experience requirements, salary budgets and expected joining timelines.
* Maintain a vacancy tracker with position-wise hiring status and recruitment TAT.

**B. Sourcing & Candidate Screening**

* Source candidates through Naukri.com, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, consultants and other recruitment channels.
* Actively utilize assigned recruitment portal credentials and maintain sourcing productivity.
* Screen resumes based on job specifications, experience, qualifications and salary expectations.
* Conduct initial HR screening and assess candidate suitability, communication and joining availability.
* Maintain a qualified and relevant candidate pipeline for all assigned vacancies.

**C. Interview Management**

* Schedule and coordinate interviews with respective Department Heads and Hiring Managers.
* Ensure a minimum required interview pipeline for each assigned vacancy.
* Follow up with candidates and interview panels for timely feedback.
* Maintain interview trackers with selection, rejection and pending feedback status.
* Coordinate subsequent interview rounds wherever required.

**D. Offer Management & Closure**

* Discuss salary expectations and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.
* Coordinate management approvals before releasing offers.
* Release Offer Letters / LOIs to selected candidates.
* Follow up for offer acceptance and required pre-joining documents.
* Maintain regular communication with offered candidates to minimize offer dropouts.
* Ensure positions are closed within the assigned recruitment TAT.

2. Employee Onboarding & Joining Formalities

* Coordinate pre-joining communication and joining confirmations.
* Collect and verify candidate documents, including Aadhaar, PAN, educational certificates, previous employment records and bank details.
* Obtain previous employers' official email IDs wherever required for Background Verification (BGV).
* Coordinate employee registration and onboarding formalities in Keka HRMS.
* Ensure appointment letters, employee documentation and joining checklists are completed.
* Coordinate induction, departmental introductions and reporting-manager alignment.
* Ensure asset issuance, ID cards and other joining requirements are completed.
* Coordinate training schedules, travel, lodging and boarding arrangements for outstation employees wherever applicable.
* Maintain accurate employee master data and onboarding records.

3. HR Operations – 30%

**A. Attendance & Leave Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, login/logout records and employee absenteeism through Keka.
* Track leave applications, approvals, rejections and attendance regularizations.
* Follow up on missing punches and attendance discrepancies.
* Maintain daily attendance and absenteeism reports.
* Coordinate with managers for attendance-related clarifications.

**B. Employee Documentation & HR Records**

* Maintain employee personal files and confidential HR documentation.
* Manage appointment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters and other employee correspondence.
* Maintain employee databases, department-wise manpower reports and employee movement records.
* Ensure timely updating of employee records in Keka HRMS.

**C. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Coordinate probation reviews, confirmation processes and employee status updates.
* Support employee engagement and grievance coordination.
* Manage employee exit formalities, resignation documentation and notice-period tracking.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, company asset recovery and departmental clearance.
* Process Full & Final (F&F) documentation in coordination with Finance.

**D. HR MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly HR MIS reports.
* Maintain recruitment, onboarding, attendance and employee movement trackers.
* Submit daily work reports (DWR) and recruitment progress updates.
* Highlight recruitment delays, pending approvals and operational concerns to the reporting manager.
* Maintain accurate and updated HR records for management reviews.

4. Key Performance Expectations (KPIs)

1. Timely closure of assigned vacancies within approved recruitment TAT.
2. Quality and relevance of candidates shortlisted.
3. Consistent sourcing productivity through assigned recruitment platforms.
4. Interview scheduling and timely feedback coordination.
5. Offer-to-joining conversion ratio.
6. Completion of joining documentation and onboarding formalities.
7. Accuracy of attendance, leave and employee records.
8. Timely submission of HR MIS and daily work reports.
9. Compliance with company HR policies and procedures.
10. Ownership, accountability and timely execution of assigned responsibilities.

5. Reporting & Accountability

* The employee will directly report to the assigned HRBP / Head – People & Culture.
* Recruitment priorities and vacancy assignments will be communicated by the reporting manager.
* Daily recruitment progress and HR operational updates must be shared in the prescribed reporting format.
* All assigned vacancies must be actively tracked until successful joining.
* Any hiring challenges, candidate dropouts, delays or operational deviations must be escalated promptly.
* The employee will be accountable for the timely and accurate execution of all assigned responsibilities.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

jobs.title: MRGR Review Lead - Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
* Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
* Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
* Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
* Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
* Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
* Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
* Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.
* Contribute to model risk governance and review priorities and initiatives.
* Stay informed about changes in consumer banking, artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques (including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence), products, markets, models, risk practices, and industry standards; use this knowledge to guide review priorities and identify emerging risks.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a strong quantitative background (PhD, Master's degree, or equivalent) in Statistics, Economics (with Econometrics), Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a quantitative science.
* Knowledge of both statistical/econometric methodologies and machine learning modeling methodologies.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, SAS, or R.
* Working knowledge of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques, including large language models, generative artificial intelligence, and agentic artificial intelligence systems, including key risks and limitations.
* Ability to challenge model design, assumptions, and testing approaches for advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models.
* Product domain expertise in consumer banking/retail banking, including ability to understand the business and knowledge of regulation surrounding the business.
* Extensive experience and familiarity in model development or model validation in financial institutions.
* 12+ years of work experience in model development or model validation.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to interface with stakeholders on model-related issues.
* Risk and control mindset: ask incisive questions, assess materiality of issues, and escalate as required.
* Sound project management and organizational skills; flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities, and able to work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Input Zone
jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

**Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance**

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.
  

**Requirements:** -

**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:** 4-6 years

**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping.

* Experience writing or working from specifications in a spec-driven or specification-first delivery mod

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

========================

* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning

* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.

* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.
* Create sustainable banker engagement and referral generation mechanisms.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

• Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
  
• Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  
• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**  
• Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  
• Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

  

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.

  

At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve.
