Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. **Who You'll Be Joining**

We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**

As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.
* Corridor & Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership and banking network expansion opportunities across emerging and developed APAC markets.
* Launch & Market Optimization: Lead end-to-end market entry and expansion strategies, integrating local real-time payment rails and partner networks to maximize transaction speed, cost efficiency, and customer experience.
* Commercial FX & Margin Strategy: Partner closely with internal Pricing, FX Trading, and Treasury teams to continuously optimize corridor pricing models. Drive regional FX spread margins, ensure competitive liquidity across high-volume APAC currency pairs, and maximize overall revenue margins.

Team Leadership & Matrix Governance

* Direct Regional Management: Lead and manage the regional commercial team, driving accountability, setting KPIs, and mentoring direct reports including:
* Regional Managers
* Business Development Managers
* Commercial Managers
* Cross-Functional Matrix Leadership: Manage and Collaborate across indirect reporting lines and work streams that filter into regional Business Partners, aligning multi-disciplinary teams around expansion and revenue goals:
* Launch & Product Teams (market readiness, feature rollouts, rails integration)
* Marketing Teams (multi-channel acquisition and localized growth campaigns)
* Payment Operations Teams (route efficiency, settlement, scaling infrastructure)
* Pricing Teams (dynamic rate management and corridor margins)
* FX Traders (underlying liquidity support and panel coordination)
* Country Directorship & Governance: Concurrently serve as, or oversee, Country Director roles based on business needs, managing local regulatory relationships and government interactions to facilitate seamless market launches.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Report performance metrics, expansion milestones, and revenue updates directly to the ExCo and senior leadership.

Infrastructure, Launch Execution & Risk

* Cross-Functional Delivery: Lead the alignment between Business Development, Launch, Product, and Tech teams to ensure new market rails, APIs, and commercial features are brought to market at pace.
* Operational Scalability: Automate cross-border and operational processes to scale corridor capacity without increasing overhead friction.
* Risk & Regulatory Oversight: Oversee regional commercial and exposure risks, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory standards across all operating entities.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven Business Development Leader: Track record of driving rapid revenue growth, expanding complex markets, and consistently hitting Volume, Revenue, and PnL targets.
* Expansion & Launch Expertise: Demonstrated experience entering new geographies, launching cross-border payment corridors, and building strategic financial or distribution partnerships across APAC.
* Matrix Leadership: Proven ability to manage direct commercial teams while effectively leading indirect, multi-functional partner teams (Product, Marketing, Operations, Pricing, FX) to execute cross-company initiatives.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Monetization
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
  
YallaPlay is a venture-backed mobile games studio of about 25 people, headquartered in Abu Dhabi with team members in Brazil and Europe. We build and operate card games: our flagship, Spades Masters, has grown consistently for years and is played by millions. We are building toward a portfolio of card games, including Arabic-first titles for the MENA region, operated on one shared technology and LiveOps platform.
  
  
We reinvent classic card and board games with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that bring people together. Small team, big ambition, direct communication.
  
  
Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for a
**Head of Product & Monetization**
to lead the performance, roadmap, execution, and player experience of YallaPlay’s game portfolio.
  
  
You will be the most senior product leader in the company, reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with him on every major product bet. You own what we build and why: product strategy, roadmap, monetization, economy, LiveOps strategy, product requirements, and KPI outcomes across our live games.
  
  
You will lead the Product function and manage the Producer and Art Lead, ensuring Product, Production, and Art are aligned around the right roadmap, clear priorities, strong execution, high quality standards, and measurable game outcomes.
  
  
This is a high-autonomy role. We are looking for someone who forms their own conclusions from data and arrives with proposals, not questions. You will not be judged by the number of documents you produce. You will be judged by the quality of your decisions, the speed of execution, the clarity of priorities, and the measurable improvement of our games.
  
  
This position is based at our offices in Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Remote will be considered for the right candidate with Gulf-hours overlap.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the product roadmap and KPI outcomes for our live titles: revenue, ARPDAU, retention, LTV, conversion, engagement, and economy health.
* Own product discovery, prioritization logic, product requirements, feature rationale, success metrics, and post-launch decisions for major game changes.
* Lead monetization and economy strategy: IAP catalog and pricing, offer segmentation, season passes, VIP programs, collection systems, ad monetization, and the balance between ads and IAP.
* Own the LiveOps strategy across events, offers, seasonal content, player segmentation, and content cadence, ensuring LiveOps is measured and connected to retention, monetization, and long-term game health.
* Guide game systems and product design: progression, rewards, player journeys, UX, economy changes, and monetization experiments, using dashboards, A/B tests, player behavior, and competitor analysis to decide what to build, cut, scale, or rework.
* Manage the Producer and Art Lead, ensuring Product, Production, and Art are aligned with clear ownership, realistic roadmaps, on-time delivery, strong execution, and visual quality that matches the bar of the genre.
* Establish lightweight product discipline: assumption documentation before build, design review gates, KPI reviews after launch, and post-mortems.
* Build the operating rhythm across Product, Production, Art, Engineering, BI, UA, VIP Support, and AdMon: roadmap reviews, LiveOps planning, prioritization, trade-off decisions, and performance follow-ups.
* Identify team gaps, quality issues, process weaknesses, and resourcing needs, and drive practical fixes.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
**What You Need To Have**

* 10+ years in mobile free-to-play games, the majority in product roles on live titles.
* Hands-on monetization systems experience: you have personally designed offer systems, passes, VIP economies, IAP catalogs, or similar systems and can reason about their math in detail.
* Ownership of revenue or retention targets for a live game, with results you can speak to.
* Strong analytical fluency: comfortable in dashboards, cohorts, funnels, and A/B results, and able to pull your own numbers when needed.
* Strong product judgment across game systems, player journeys, progression, rewards, UX, LiveOps, economy, and monetization.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across product, production, design, and art, including managing experienced leads without absorbing their jobs.
* Clear, direct communication in English, and comfort working with a multicultural remote team across time zones.
* Strong execution judgment: able to simplify roadmaps, cut low-value work, resolve trade-offs, and push teams toward measurable outcomes.

**Strong Advantage**

* Depth in card, board, casual, or real-time multiplayer games.
* Experience managing both product and creative/art functions.
* VIP and whale engagement, segmentation, and personalized monetization.
* Ad mediation, placement strategy, and ad revenue optimization.
* Taking games from soft launch to global launch and live operations.
* Familiarity with MENA markets or Arabic.
* Unity and mobile production pipelines; SQL or similar data skills.

The Person Who Will Succeed in This Role
  
  
You are not only a strategist. You are an operator.
  
  
You can look at a dashboard and spot what matters. You can review a roadmap and immediately see what is bloated, weak, or missing. You can sit with artists and discuss visual quality, then move to a KPI review and challenge monetization assumptions. You can tell the CEO what is working, what is not, and what needs to happen next, in two minutes.
  
  
You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. You move fast, but not blindly. You are direct, practical, and accountable. You do not wait for the perfect process before acting.
  
  
Why YallaPlay
  
  
**What You Get**

* A senior compensation package.
* Relocation support and UAE visa sponsorship for Abu Dhabi; remote flexibility for the right candidate.
* Direct partnership with the CEO and genuine decision authority.
* A funded company with multi-year runway and a profitable flagship game.
* The chance to shape a multi-game studio's product practice from the ground up.
* Generous paid time off, your birthday off, and a learning budget.

How We Hire
  
  
Intro conversation, then a product craft deep-dive, then a short practical exercise based on real anonymized product data, then team conversations, references, and offer. We move quickly and tell you where you stand at every step.
  
  
When you apply, please include your CV and, where possible, examples of games, features, LiveOps, monetization systems, or performance improvements you have led.
  
  
*YallaPlay is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and nationalities.*

**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.

* **Data & Analytics:** Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.
* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

The Middle East and Africa Compliance team is seeking a Vice President, based in Dubai and reporting to the Head of Middle East and Africa Compliance. This broad regional role supports Compliance advisory, Operational Risk and Regulatory Relations priorities, with specialist investment management expertise as a core capability. The Vice President will provide entity-level oversight, including potential registered Compliance Officer or other controlled-function responsibilities as the regional footprint expands, while delivering specialist coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities across GCC jurisdictions.

  

**About Morgan Stanley and the DIFC Branch:**

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm and has served clients in the Middle East and Africa since the early 1970s. From offices in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and Johannesburg, the Firm provides investment banking, capital markets, sales and trading, asset management and private wealth management services. Our success is underpinned by integrity, excellence and a strong team ethic, providing an environment in which people can learn, achieve and grow.

Morgan Stanley provides a strong foundation for building a professional career and a place for people to learn, achieve and grow.

  
  

**Department Overview:**

Compliance advises Business Units and staff on applicable laws, regulations, exchange requirements and Firm policies. The Department implements Compliance and Global Financial Crimes policies and procedures, delivers training, undertakes monitoring and surveillance, and partners with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and other control functions to maintain a robust second line of defence.

* Experience in regulatory engagement and change, including submissions, inspections and remediation; prior controlled-function experience, or the credibility to assume such responsibilities subject to regulatory approval, is desirable.
* Excellent analytical, drafting and communion skills.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

* **Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.**
* **Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.**
* **Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.**
* **Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).**
* **Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.**

**Business**

* **Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.**
* **Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.**
* **Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.**
* **Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.**
* **Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.**

**Processes**

**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* **Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.**

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

***www.KanzPay.com***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you sold credit cards, POS machines, ERP systems, Accounting systems, other Payment instruments.

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)
* POS: 3 years (Preferred)
* Key Account Management: 3 years (Required)

Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave , driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.
  
  
**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners , always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners , treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**  
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**  
As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.
* Corridor & Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership and banking network expansion opportunities across emerging and developed APAC markets.
* Launch & Market Optimization: Lead end-to-end market entry and expansion strategies, integrating local real-time payment rails and partner networks to maximize transaction speed, cost efficiency, and customer experience.
* Commercial FX & Margin Strategy: Partner closely with internal Pricing, FX Trading, and Treasury teams to continuously optimize corridor pricing models. Drive regional FX spread margins, ensure competitive liquidity across high-volume APAC currency pairs, and maximize overall revenue margins.

Team Leadership & Matrix Governance

* Direct Regional Management: Lead and manage the regional commercial team, driving accountability, setting KPIs, and mentoring direct reports including:

  + Business Development Managers
  + Commercial Managers
* Cross-Functional Matrix Leadership: Manage and Collaborate across indirect reporting lines and work streams that filter into regional Business Partners, aligning multi-disciplinary teams around expansion and revenue goals:
  + Launch & Product Teams (market readiness, feature rollouts, rails integration)
  + Marketing Teams (multi-channel acquisition and localized growth campaigns)
  + Payment Operations Teams (route efficiency, settlement, scaling infrastructure)
  + Pricing Teams (dynamic rate management and corridor margins)
  + FX Traders (underlying liquidity support and panel coordination)
* Country Directorship & Governance: Concurrently serve as, or oversee, Country Director roles based on business needs, managing local regulatory relationships and government interactions to facilitate seamless market launches.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Report performance metrics, expansion milestones, and revenue updates directly to the ExCo and senior leadership.

Infrastructure, Launch Execution & Risk

* Cross-Functional Delivery: Lead the alignment between Business Development, Launch, Product, and Tech teams to ensure new market rails, APIs, and commercial features are brought to market at pace.
* Operational Scalability: Automate cross-border and operational processes to scale corridor capacity without increasing overhead friction.
* Risk & Regulatory Oversight: Oversee regional commercial and exposure risks, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory standards across all operating entities.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven Business Development Leader: Track record of driving rapid revenue growth, expanding complex markets, and consistently hitting Volume, Revenue, and PnL targets.
* Expansion & Launch Expertise: Demonstrated experience entering new geographies, launching cross-border payment corridors, and building strategic financial or distribution partnerships across APAC.
* Matrix Leadership: Proven ability to manage direct commercial teams while effectively leading indirect, multi-functional partner teams (Product, Marketing, Operations, Pricing, FX) to execute cross-company initiatives.
* APAC Market Mastery: In-depth knowledge of APAC financial markets, payment infrastructure, local regulatory environments, and consumer payment preferences.
* Dealmaking & Negotiation: Exceptional skills in sourcing, structuring, and closing complex, first-in-kind commercial agreements.
* Strategic Drive: An autonomous, highly energetic self-starter with a bias for action and the strategic vision to build a dominant market presence in high-volume corridors.
* Cross-Border & FX Commercial Knowledge: Solid understanding of FX mechanics, cross-border payment rails, and currency spread optimization across APAC corridors.

**AI Literacy & Tools**  
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  

* A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
* Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
* Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.

Dubai, AE, PO Box 506

**1. Purpose of the role**
--------------------------

This role sits across both the EMEA Technology Risk Management group and the EMEA Cyber Governance, Risk and Control group. It is a first line regional role responsible for broad technology and cyber risk and control activity across the Middle East, while contributing to the wider EMEA operating model.

The role supports the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment and monitoring of technology and cyber risks. It also supports the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidence and remediation of controls. Reporting and management information are important enabling activities, but they are not the primary focus of the role.

The post holder will work as part of the established regional team and in close partnership with existing Technology Risk Management, Cyber GRC, Information Security and Technology colleagues. The role is intended to complement existing individuals in the region by adding capacity, coordination and specialist risk and control capability. It does not create parallel ownership or replace established accountabilities. The role reports locally to the Head of IT for the Middle East and maintains functional alignment with both the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.

**2. Background**
-----------------

* Operates within the first line Technology and Cyber organisation, reporting locally to the Head of IT for Dubai, with functional alignment to the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.
* Provides a clear Middle East regional presence from Dubai and connects regional requirements, risks and control matters into the wider EMEA framework.
* Supports a strong, consistent and transparent technology and cyber risk and control environment aligned to internal frameworks, risk appetite and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Works with regional and global stakeholders to improve consistency while preserving local ownership, expertise and decision rights.

**3. Principal accountabilities and responsibilities**
------------------------------------------------------

**Unless specifically stated otherwise, each responsibility below applies across both technology and cyber risk, controls, governance and assurance.**

**First line technology and cyber risk management**
---------------------------------------------------

* Support the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment, acceptance, monitoring and evidence based closure of technology and cyber risks and issues across EMEA.
* Maintain an integrated, decision ready view of material risks, control gaps, issues, exceptions, actions, decisions, milestones, dependencies and remediation activity, linked to business impact, risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Embed practical risk management within day to day Technology and Cyber activities, programmes, projects, services and material change initiatives.
* Ensure risks and issues are clearly articulated, consistently assessed, linked to relevant work and assigned to accountable owners.
* Provide constructive first line challenge on risk assessments, treatment plans, evidence and closure proposals without assuming ownership held by service or control owners.

**Technology and cyber risk and control management**
----------------------------------------------------

* Support the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidencing, validation and improvement of proportionate technology and cyber controls.
* Help define clear control objectives, ownership, frequency, evidence requirements, performance measures, quality gates and escalation triggers.
* Identify recurring weaknesses and thematic issues, and support sustainable improvements to control design, operation and evidence quality.
* Help owners address overdue or Red and Amber items through practical recovery plans with clear owners, dates, blockers, escalation routes and closure criteria.

**Regulatory compliance and assurance**
---------------------------------------

* Coordinate first line responses to regulatory requirements, including DORA, EBA guidance, relevant Middle East expectations and entity or Head Office requests.
* Translate regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes, evidence and accountable actions.
* Maintain a controlled record of commitments, owners, inputs, dates, evidence, blockers, dependencies and escalation status.
* Maintain traceability between obligations, policies, standards, controls, risks, evidence, findings and remediation.
* Coordinate input from subject matter experts and control owners so submissions are accurate, complete, consistent, reviewed and evidence based while preserving their accountability.

**Technology and cyber policy and standards governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Support policy owners with the review, update, approval and governance of technology and cyber policies and standards, maintaining alignment with regulation, internal frameworks and control obligations.
* Coordinate owners, reviewers and approvers through the policy lifecycle and annual approval cycle.
* Manage policy exceptions through documented justification, risk assessment, compensating controls, approval and review dates.
* Support technology and cyber policy improvement activity, including ECB related requirements, cyber skills framework operationalisation and associated process governance.

**Technology and cyber metrics, KRIs and management information**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate the monthly technology and cyber metrics cycle with accountable data and metric owners.
* Help owners define and review KRIs, KCIs and KPIs, including thresholds, data sources, ownership and data quality controls.
* Coordinate action where performance is outside tolerance or evidence is incomplete.
* Provide clear analysis of trends, service health, control effectiveness, risks, issues, remediation progress and regulatory commitments.
* Support controlled automation of reporting processes using approved tooling, with clear ownership, testing, auditability and traceability.

**Technology and cyber committee and executive reporting**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Support and coordinate technology and cyber reporting for the Security and Technology Risk Committee and provide reviewed Technology Risk Management and Cyber GRC input to other executive, entity and Head Office forums.
* Prepare concise, accurate papers covering material risks, controls, actions, service health and decisions.
* Maintain consistency and traceability across submissions while respecting forum ownership and approval routes.
* Coordinate contributors to meet deadlines, resolve data or evidence gaps and maintain clear records of decisions and actions.

**Technology and cyber audit and remediation management**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a senior first line coordination contact for technology and cyber Internal and External Audit activity, supporting accountable owners and clarifying ownership where responsibility is shared or unclear.
* Coordinate audit engagement, document requests, evidence, stakeholder responses, management responses and governance updates.
* Support agreement of practical remediation actions with accountable owners, milestones, due dates, closure criteria and validation requirements.
* Track findings and actions through to evidence based closure, reporting progress and escalating overdue or off track items through agreed routes.
* Identify recurring themes and use audit outcomes to improve controls, evidence quality and the wider risk and control environment.

**Technology and cyber stakeholder leadership and engagement**
--------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The UAE Services Business Execution & Strategy Analyst / Associate plays a central role in driving the growth, governance, and operational execution of Citi’s Services franchise in the United Arab Emirates.

  
  

This role blends strategic commercial enablement, product P&L analytics, and sales pipeline optimization with proactive oversight of country governance, regulatory affairs, technology enhancement asks, and executive reporting for UAE leadership.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy Execution:** Execute the comprehensive UAE Services strategy established by Country Management to accelerate business momentum across the franchise.

**Franchise Expansion:** Support growth initiatives across revenue, transaction volume, and balance sheet/asset dimensions across all UAE cash management, payments, and trade lines.

--------------------------------------------------------------

**Variance & Trend Analysis:** Extract and evaluate financial and balance sheet data from Citi internal systems; compare actual performance against plan and prior periods, pinpointing drivers, growth trends, and outliers.

**Financial Forecasting:** Partner with finance and business managers to assist in quarterly forecasting, annual budget formulation, and productivity reviews.

  
  

**C. Country Governance, Regulatory Affairs & Infrastructure**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**D. Sales Pipeline & Commercial Enablement**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, data modeling) and MS Word; aptitude for quickly learning internal core banking and CRM platforms
* Fluent written and verbal English communication skills; confident in liaising with cross-functional internal stakeholders and senior management

**Education:**

**Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for the global markets division.
* Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.
* Training and mentoring of junior colleagues.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation’s products, services and processes within the function.

***Ready to strengthen risk oversight across UAE Wealth products and distribution?***

  

**Why HSBC**

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

As Senior Wealth Risk Manager in the UAE you’ll support the Head of Wealth Risk and MENAT IWPB CRO to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risks across the market Wealth business. The role provides focused second-line oversight across investment and wealth products, their distribution journeys, risk governance and the implementation of the Risk Management Framework.

  

Working closely with first-line product, distribution and business teams and with specialist second-line Risk Stewards you’ll provide practical advice and independent oversight to inform key decisions. You’ll help ensure material risks and issues are understood, escalated and addressed in a timely way.

  

Success means clear governance, decision-useful risk reporting and sustained improvements in controls, issue management and customer outcomes.

  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Support the launch and ongoing oversight of investment and wealth products, services and distribution journeys including due diligence, governance, controls and risk assessment
* Review committee papers and prepare concise briefings for senior risk leaders ahead of product, distribution and risk governance forums
* Oversee product due-diligence processes and the risk oversight of internal and external third-party providers
* Monitor distribution framework changes, risk indicators and issues and ensure appropriate read-across across products, channels, customer segments and other markets
* Embed the Risk Management Framework, Group Risk Policies and local procedures across the Wealth business
* Apply the Non-Financial Risk framework and relevant systems to key control identification and monitoring, issue management, risk indicators and action tracking
* Maintain the market Wealth risk profile including risk maps, risk appetite metrics, top and emerging risks, issues and mitigating actions including contributions to stress testing and scenario analysis where relevant
* Escalate material product, distribution, control, conduct and regulatory risk concerns promptly to the Head of Wealth Risk and relevant stakeholders
* Undertake targeted reviews with product and distribution teams to evaluate whether key procedures and controls are designed and operating effectively
* Coordinate Wealth risk governance including agendas, submissions, minutes, decisions and action tracking and produce timely, accurate risk reporting for market, regional and global stakeholders
  

**What we're looking for**

  

* A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory
* Relevant risk management experience from private banking, wealth management or another regulated financial services business is essential.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of investment and wealth products alongside product governance and distribution frameworks
* Working knowledge of risk governance, risk appetite, the Risk Management Framework and non-financial risk management is required.

* Experience supporting governance forums including preparing senior-level papers and briefings and tracking issues and actions is required.
* Operate effectively in a regulated environment with a strong understanding of the regulatory environment for Wealth business
* Use structured approaches to interpret complex information, identify connections and emerging risks and communicate practical conclusions clearly
* Provide effective independent challenge across stakeholders at different levels of seniority, using clear and professional judgement
* Work effectively in a complex matrix environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail
  

**Strengthening Wealth risk governance**

  

This is a role with real influence on how Wealth products are governed, distributed and monitored in market. You’ll help senior decision-makers see risk clearly and act early on issues that matter to customers, regulators and the business. If you’re looking to build deeper second-line oversight across investment and wealth products and shape practical improvements in controls and governance this role offers breadth, scale and visibility. Join HSBC and help keep the UAE Wealth business safe, well-governed and ready for growth.

  

For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number.

  

We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  

Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
