jobs.title: Vice President - International Gaming Compliance & MLRO
jobs.description:
About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.

About the Position:

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a **Vice President – Gaming Compliance & Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)** to join the resort’s **Gaming Compliance team** in Ras Al Khaimah. The role reports directly to the Chief Global Compliance Officer, Wynn Resorts, and administratively to the SVP, General Counsel, WMI.

As MLRO and a senior leader within Gaming Compliance, you will direct the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of WMI’s risk-based Anti-Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) Compliance Program. You will oversee suspicious activity investigations and reporting to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit (UAE FIU) through goAML, set risk appetite and control standards, lead training, and provide strategic direction to Gaming Compliance teams and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents. The program covers applicable UAE Federal AML laws, Cabinet Decisions, Chapter 12 of the GCGRA Executive Regulations, and FATF standards applicable to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs).

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

* Act as WMI’s MLRO, reviewing and determining Suspicious Activity Incident Reports (SAIRs), escalating and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), ensuring continuity through an appropriately qualified Deputy MLRO during any absence, and serving as Secretary of the WMI AML Compliance Committee.
* Provide strategic leadership and direction to Gaming Compliance, setting objectives, policies, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and business goals.
* Oversee AML/CFT obligations and maintain effective compliance systems, controls, and governance to minimize exposure to money laundering and terrorism financing.
* Direct and review suspicious activity investigations, analysis, and escalation, with direct reporting to the WMI AML Compliance Committee and governing body. Make timely, documented reporting or non-reporting decisions, prioritize cases by risk, and maintain confidentiality and independence.
* Oversee timely SAR filing with the UAE FIU through goAML, no later than 30 calendar days from initial detection, and ensure the GCGRA is notified of the FIU reference number immediately following submission.
* Oversee Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), source of funds and source of wealth verification, and risk scoring for potentially high-risk patrons and Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), approving risk-based decisions.
* Develop and maintain quality assurance (QA) policies, procedures, and review standards for SARs, CDD and EDD files, transaction monitoring alerts, and investigations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with GCGRA requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive QA testing to identify trends, gaps, and errors, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to strengthen the AML Compliance Program.
* Prepare QA reports, metrics, analytical findings, and enhancement updates for leadership, the WMI AML Compliance Committee, and the Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Maintain robust AML/CFT recordkeeping and storage for a minimum of five years, in accordance with the GCGRA Executive Regulations, with records immediately available to the GCGRA or UAE authorities upon request.
* Oversee regular screening of persons reported in SAIRs/SARs, currency exchanges, and third-party wire transfers, and review the monthly PEP checklist prepared for Global Compliance Investigations.
* Work closely with Wynn Resorts Global Compliance Investigations to prepare and review reports for the WMI AML Compliance Committee and Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Lead GCGRA examinations, internal audits, and annual independent AML Compliance Program testing; act as a primary regulatory contact and oversee remediation of deficiencies.
* Cooperate with the GCGRA, UAE FIU, Police, and Courts, managing responses to investigation inquiries and regulatory or law enforcement information requests.
* Oversee ongoing sanctions screening of players, transactions, and vendors against UAE and relevant UN Security Council sanctions lists, including match handling, escalation, freezing measures, reporting, and recordkeeping; ensure Targeted Financial Sanctions are applied when a match is identified.
* Oversee daily transaction monitoring, transaction logs, and Electronic Multiple Transaction Logs (e-MTLs), ensuring loggable and reportable transactions at or above AED 11,000 are accurately recorded and structuring or other suspicious activity is identified and escalated.
* Design and implement monitored risk scenarios and typologies, overseeing alert handling, escalation, investigation, system tuning, and transaction monitoring effectiveness.
* Enforce the prohibition on anonymous, alias/AKA, fictitious-name, and nominee Player Accounts, and ensure identification and account-opening due diligence requirements are met.
* Enforce strict confidentiality of SARs and suspicious activity investigations and the prohibition on tipping off, sharing SAR information only on a need-to-know basis in accordance with UAE law.
* Direct WMI’s annual money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risk assessment, using results to enhance policies, procedures, systems, and controls.
* Report clearly and promptly to senior management and governing bodies on AML/CFT/CPF program effectiveness, maintaining governance that upholds confidentiality and independence.
* Keep the Compliance Program current with evolving risks, typologies, legislation, regulatory guidance, sanctions requirements, products, services, and emerging technologies.
* Develop, deliver, and maintain AML/CFT/CPF training, including role-targeted programs, materials, and records; coach managers, staff, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents on regulatory obligations.
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage Gaming Compliance managers and team members.
* Build professional, positive relationships with department heads, team members, regulators, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents.
* Attend and lead departmental and interdepartmental meetings and share relevant information.
* Adhere to Company policies, procedures, and the Code of Conduct.
* Maintain professional conduct and grooming in line with Department and Company standards.
* Follow health and safety standards and pursue continuous improvement to prevent health and injury hazards.
* Undertake other duties and responsibilities typical of a VP-level role at WMI.

About You:

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* **Experience:** At least 10 years of experience in AML/CFT/CPF compliance, gaming compliance, or a related field, including at least five years in senior management or a director-level role, with sufficient authority, direct access to governing bodies, and the independence to challenge business decisions.
* **Operational MLRO experience:** Advanced, senior-level operational MLRO experience in a large, complex, cash- and/or value-intensive environment, relevant to WMI’s land-based casino business model, transaction profile, customer base, and ML/TF/PF risks.
* **Preferred experience:** Experience in UAE financial institutions or regulated entities, goAML and UAE FIU reporting, GCGRA requirements, the UAE AML/CFT/CPF framework and regulatory environment, and commercial gaming.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Fina

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insigh

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Dostt )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)
* **Astrology Guidance**  - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* **Edutainment Skill Learning**  - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* **Matrimonial Matchmaking**  - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* **Agri Consulting**  - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* **Local Jobs**  - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* **Social Community**  - Place to find post social updates (Lokal app)
* **Advisory Services**  - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

**About the Team:**  The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our house of apps model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. Youll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy-working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

**Responsibilities:**

+ **Drive product strategy**  to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
+ **Own and enhance payment systems**  by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
+ **Design and run pricing experiments**  including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
+ **Collaborate with Marketing**  to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
+ **Strengthen trust and user satisfaction**  by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
+ **Partner cross-functionally**  with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
+ **Own the product roadmap**  , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
+ **Conduct market research**  to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
+ **Develop retention strategies**  to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
+ **Analyze user behavior**  and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

**What We re Looking For:**

+ 5 - 9 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
+ Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
+ Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
+ Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
+ Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. Were outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

  
  
This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves
  
  
Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Front End Developer - Manager
jobs.description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on senior development role**
. You'll build data-heavy, real-time ReactJS/TypeScript applications that replace legacy desktop and web UIs. You'll own front-end integration with back-end services over
**REST APIs, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE)**
. You'll also set front-end standards and tooling for the team, and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday work.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Front-end development**

* Design and build complex ReactJS/TypeScript applications for trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations monitoring users.
* Build high-performance, data-heavy UIs: large grids (e.g. AG Grid), virtualised lists, filtering, dashboards and live status views.
* Design reusable component libraries, state management (e.g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) and accessible, consistent UI patterns.
* Write clean, modern JavaScript (ES6+) and strongly typed TypeScript, and keep API contracts type-safe.
* You will have decent experience of understanding and changing Java backend code

**Real-time and API integration**

* Integrate with server-side services over REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, caching, retries and error handling.
* Build robust WebSocket clients (native WebSocket, STOMP or Socket.IO) for two-way, low-latency updates. Handle reconnects, heartbeats, back-pressure, message ordering and subscription management.
* Implement SSE streams for one-way server push (e.g. job status, cycle progress, alerts), including reconnection and event replay.
* Choose the right pattern (REST, WebSocket or SSE) for each use case, working with back-end engineers on message design and contracts.
* Make real-time screens perform well under heavy update volumes: batched rendering, memoisation and throttling.

**Build tooling and quality**

* Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm/pnpm and Vite, including workspaces/monorepos, dependency management, environment configuration and bundle optimisation.
* Work with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) for front-end build, test and deployment.
* Write unit, component and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), and use mock servers for REST, WebSocket and SSE testing.
* Handle front-end security: SSO/MFA integration, token handling, XSS/CSRF protection and dependency vulnerability scanning.

**AI-assisted development**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to speed up component building, refactoring, test generation and legacy UI analysis.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, accessibility, performance and security before merging.

**Leadership**

* Set front-end standards, review code and mentor other developers.
* Work with business analysts and users to turn legacy screens and workflows into modern, usable interfaces.
* Support releases, cutovers and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years in software development, with 5+ years building production ReactJS applications.
* ReactJS: expert in hooks, context, component design, performance tuning and state management.
* TypeScript/JavaScript: strong in TypeScript (generics, typing API contracts) and modern JavaScript, including async patterns.
* Build tooling: practical experience with npm, pnpm and Vite (including migrating from Webpack or similar).
* WebSockets: strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery.
* SSE: practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates.
* REST APIs: strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Decent Java knowledge
* Testing: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework.
* Git, CI/CD and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery.

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e.g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams.
* Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways.
* Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications).
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring.
* Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets).

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users.
* Shared component library and front-end standards adopted across the team.
* Faster, smaller builds and good test coverage, measured against a baseline.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools, with no drop in quality.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorganChase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide. The Legal Department provides legal services to the Corporation and is organized by practice groups that generally conform to the Corporation's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and fixed asset accounting.
* Drive finance process improvements, automation, and effective ERP utilization, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Prepare financial dashboards, management reports, and business performance insights.
* Lead, coach, and develop the regional finance team to achieve operational excellence.
* Collaborate with sales, service, operations, procurement, HR, and global finance teams.
* Ensure accurate intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and compliance with transfer pricing requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce costs, and optimize resource utilization.
Monitor changes in UAE tax laws and implement necessary compliance and process updates.  

**Main KPI’s / Metrics that the role has an impact on**

* Financial Performance: Monitor revenue, gross margin, operating profit, EBITDA (where applicable), and achievement against budget.
* Financial Reporting: Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Closing and Reconciliation: Complete month-end closing on time, ensure balance sheet reconciliations, and resolve outstanding items.
* Budgeting and Forecasting: Maintain forecast accuracy, ensure budget adherence, and deliver high-quality financial analysis.
* Cash Flow and Working Capital: Improve cash flow forecasting, monitor overdue receivables and debtor days, optimise working capital, and manage bad debt exposure.
* Tax and Statutory Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate VAT and Corporate Tax filings, statutory submissions, and tax payments.
* Internal Controls and Audit: Minimise audit findings, close corrective actions, strengthen internal controls, and ensure compliance with group policies.
* Commercial Finance: Improve gross margins, control costs, support pricing decisions, and monitor the profitability of key customers, contracts, and projects.
* Process Improvement: Drive automation, reduce manual reporting, improve process efficiency, and enhance reporting timelines.
* Team Development: Enhance team performance, develop capabilities, support succession planning, and improve stakeholder satisfaction.

**Minimum Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA, or an equivalent recognized accounting qualification is strongly preferred. • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role, with at least 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounting (F&A).
* Demonstrated experience managing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, tax compliance, internal controls, and statutory audits.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical experience applying accounting standards in a multinational or international business environment.
* Practical knowledge of UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, statutory reporting, and applicable local compliance requirements.
* Experience working with regional or multinational finance teams and reporting to group or headquarters finance functions.
* Experience in commercial finance, business partnering, profitability analysis, and working capital management.
* Proven experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365, and advanced Excel.
* Fluent written and spoken English. Arabic is an advantage.

**Essential Criteria: Qualifications, Experience, Skills, Competencies Financial and Technical Expertise**

* Strong technical accounting knowledge, with the ability to oversee complex accounting matters and ensure accurate financial reporting.
* In-depth understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, management reporting, and performance analysis.
* Practical understanding of UAE tax compliance, statutory reporting, financial controls, and audit requirements.
* Ability to interpret financial data, identify business trends, and translate financial analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Strong knowledge of cash flow management, credit control, working capital optimization, and financial risk management. Leadership and Commercial Acumen
* Ability to lead a regional finance function and influence senior stakeholders.
* Commercially minded, with the ability to challenge assumptions and support profitable business decisions.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to balance financial control and compliance with business growth and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within tight deadlines. Governance and Integrity.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and discretion when handling confidential financial information.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, delegation of authority, risk mitigation, and financial governance.
* Ability to identify control weaknesses, investigate discrepancies, and drive corrective actions. Systems and Communication
* Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling, pivot tables, lookup functions, data analysis, and reporting automation. • Experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to senior management.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

* Experience in a multinational organization with regional reporting responsibilities.

**About Us**
------------

Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.

We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.

  

**If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.**

  

**About Wealth and Retail Banking**

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.

**About the Job**
-----------------

To become a strategic and managing client relations professional within our team, while utilizing your experience in building hips, across the region. Your focus will be on developing new relationships, to onboard new clients while maintaining and servicing a portfolio, through excellent communication, negotiation and customer service.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Creation of strategic plans for revenue generation and business development while driving the Digital Agenda.
* Generate new business to achieve defined targets in terms of the number of customers, volumes and revenue, including product mix, active/ passive ratio, liability targetsAbo, transactions.
* Induction of all (NTB) new customers brought in by the Branches & Direct Sales team.
* Creation of sales call plans to acquire large prospective customers through referrals.
* Update & maintain all Sales MIS (Calls, Prospects, Attritions, Business done, etc.)
* Effectively meeting customer expectations and handling/ reduction of customer complaints while providing professional customer service to achieve a high percentage of customer satisfaction and retention.
* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations for your team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure KYC/AML updates, proper zero error documentation.
* To be able to detect any suspicious transactions, Money laundering, forgeries etc.
* Highest compliance with reference to Anti Bribery, Anti Money Laundering & Combating Financial Crime Risk procedures.
* Obtain Security & Commodity Authority (SCA) license and timely completion of Continuous Program Development (CPD) requirement post SCA licensing. This is a mandatory requirement for the role.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

* Experienced Sales and Relationship Manager with background in handling all Banking & Investment Products. Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes.
* Networking ability to manage interdepartmental deliverables.
* Strong inter-personal skills and leadership ability, which encourages and promotes enthusiasm and team spirit.
* Good understanding of the business environment in UAE preferably with direct contacts with the local HNI community.
* Adapting to multi-cultural environment.
* In-depth knowledge of capital markets and financial planning
* SCA certified

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.description:
**Vice President – Wealth Operations Analytics (People Manager)**
**Shape the Future of Wealth Operations**
**Be a Problem Solver. Enable AI Transformation. Lead with Impact.**
**Job Description**
Are you a results-oriented analytics leader with a strong ability to partner with business teams and translate complex operational problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions?
  
  
Join our Analytics & Information Management (AIM) organization as a
**Vice President – Wealth Operations Analytics**
, and play a key role in enabling operational excellence across Wealth Management.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of
**business, analytics, and next-generation AI technologies**
, including
**Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks**
. You will partner closely with Wealth Operations stakeholders to understand business priorities, design analytical and AI-driven solutions, and deliver measurable impact.
  
  
**A critical success factor in this role is the ability to deeply understand business problems and translate them into structured analytics and AI solutions with measurable impact.**
As a people leader, you will manage and grow a high-performing team while fostering a culture of innovation, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business Partnership & Problem Translation**

* Build strong partnerships with Wealth Operations, Risk, Product, and Technology stakeholders
* Develop deep understanding of Wealth Operations processes and priorities
* Translate business needs into structured analytics problems and AI solution frameworks
* Act as a bridge between business and analytics/AI teams, ensuring clarity, alignment, and impact
* Proactively identify opportunities where analytics and AI can solve business challenges

**Analytics & AI Solution Delivery**

* Lead delivery of advanced analytics and AI initiatives across Wealth Operations
* Design and implement Generative AI use cases (e.g., document intelligence, knowledge copilots, workflow assistants)
* Build or drive development of Agentic AI solutions for workflow automation and decisioning
* Own end-to-end lifecycle: problem framing, solution design, execution, and deployment
* Measure and communicate business impact (efficiency, cost savings, risk reduction, client experience)

**AI Enablement & Innovation**

* Drive execution and adoption of scalable analytics and AI solutions aligned to business priorities
* Apply LLM-based approaches including prompt engineering and retrieval-based frameworks
* Collaborate with Technology teams to productionize AI solutions
* Ensure adherence to responsible AI practices and governance standards

**Execution Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Deliver analytically rigorous and business-relevant solutions with clear linkage to measurable outcomes
* Balance multiple priorities across stakeholders and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Drive standardization and reusability across analytics and AI solutions

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Independently manage communication with global stakeholders
* Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership clearly and effectively
* Act as a trusted advisor, influencing adoption of analytics and AI-driven decision-making

**Team Leadership**

* Manage and develop a team of analytics and AI professionals (typically 15–30 members)
* Coach and mentor team members on analytics techniques, AI tools, and business context
* Build capability in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and modern analytics practices
* Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning
* Build next-level leadership within the team (AVP/Lead pipeline)
* Drive high standards on delivery quality, stakeholder engagement, and business impact

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 13–14 years of experience in Analytics, Data Science, or AI
* 3–6 years of people management experience
* Experience in Financial Services or Wealth Operations analytics preferred
* Mandatory: Proven experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and/or Agentic AI solutions, including problem framing, model/application design, and measurable business impact realization
* Experience working with enterprise constraints such as data privacy, latency, and model governance in AI deployments

**Industry & Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of operations analytics and process optimization
* Exposure to Wealth Management domains such as client lifecycle, KYC, servicing, or trade lifecycle preferred

**Analytical & Technical Skills**

* Strong problem structuring and hypothesis-driven analysis
* Experience in statistical techniques, segmentation, and predictive analytics
* Proficiency in SQL and Python (or R/SAS)
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI

**AI & Data Skills (Critical)**

* Hands-on experience with:

+ Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-based frameworks)
+ Agentic AI (multi-step workflows, orchestration frameworks)

* Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle, APIs, and deployment architectures
* Experience driving AI-led automation and transformation initiatives

**Leadership & Professional Skills**

* Exceptional ability to understand business problems and translate them into analytics and AI solutions
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Excellent communication and storytelling ability
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed organization
* High ownership mindset with strong execution focus

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science)
* Master’s degree (MBA/MS) preferred

**Success Metrics**

* Measurable business impact (cost savings, productivity improvement, risk reduction)
* Adoption of analytics and AI solutions within Wealth Operations workflows
* Stakeholder satisfaction and influence
* Team capability uplift, particularly in Generative AI and advanced analytics
* Quality, timeliness, and scalability of delivery

**Why This Role Matters**
This role is critical in transforming Wealth Operations into an AI-enabled, insight-driven function. You will directly influence how business problems are solved using data, analytics, and next-generation AI, driving improvements in efficiency, scalability, and client experience.
  
  
**This role provides a unique opportunity to shape the adoption of AI within Wealth Operations while working closely with global stakeholders on high-impact transformation initiatives.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
  
  
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of trading services? At JPMorganChase, we offer an exciting opportunity for career growth and development as a Trading Services Manager. Join us to leverage your skills in automation and data analysis and be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.  
  
As a Trading Services Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in our team, leveraging your deep knowledge of trade activities and market products to ensure seamless order execution and settlement. Your role will involve managing a diverse team, interpreting customer needs, and identifying trends to generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for end-to-end trade processing control, monitoring asset and cash levels, and driving continuous improvement in our operating platform. Your advanced understanding of automation technologies and data literacy will be crucial in optimizing our systems and making data-driven decisions. As a recognized expert in your field, you will use your strong presentation skills and influence to communicate insights, manage internal stakeholders, and lead your team through change. Your work will have a wide-ranging impact on our operations, financial management, and service delivery, contributing to the overall success of our firm.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end trade processing control, ensuring accurate order entry, trade execution, and settlement in line with operational policies and precedents.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of market products to monitor and manage asset and cash levels, identifying trends and potential risks.
* Implement automation technologies and data analysis techniques to optimize trading systems, enhance efficiency, and inform strategic decisions.
* Lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in our trading services.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, leveraging strong presentation skills to communicate insights, drive change, and align operations with the firm's strategic objectives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 7+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in trading services, specifically in order execution, trade execution, and settlement.
* Demonstrated advanced skills in using automation technologies to optimize trading systems and processes.
* Advanced knowledge of market products, including their definitions, operating procedures, and relevant industry regulations.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a diverse team, with a focus on fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
* Expertise in data analysis techniques, with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to inform strategic decisions.
* Expertise to create presentations across various levels. Ability to deliver in person & virtual presentations to senior management and stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Skilled in leveraging digital literacy to adopt and integrate innovative technologies, enhancing trade services and operational efficiency.
* Capable of utilizing AI and machine learning to enhance trade service processes and improve decision-making, driving data-driven insights and outcomes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Platform Engineering – Middleware – Data Transport SRE - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**

The State Street Middleware Data Transport Team supports enterprise Managed File Transfer (MFT) platforms across the Bank.

We are seeking an experienced **IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM) Engineer** with strong hands-on expertise in engineering, implementation, production support, troubleshooting, upgrades, security, automation, and optimization of enterprise Connect:Direct environments.

**This is a hands-on technical engineering role, not a managerial or administration-only position.** The candidate must be capable of independently troubleshooting complex production issues across Connect:Direct, operating systems, networks, authentication, certificates, and file-transfer workflows.

Experience with **IBM Sterling Connect:Direct 6.x** , including recent versions such as **6.3, 6.4 and 6.5** , is highly preferred.

**What you will be responsible for**

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, maintain, and troubleshoot **IBM Sterling Connect:Direct (NDM)** on Linux/UNIX and Windows; z/OS exposure is preferred.
* Provide **Level 3 engineering and production support** for business-critical Connect:Direct services and file-transfer workflows.
* Troubleshoot **PNODE/SNODE connectivity, Process failures, Netmap, authentication, permissions, TCP/IP/network, firewall, certificates, Secure+, TLS and performance issues** .
* Develop and troubleshoot Connect:Direct **Processes** , including COPY, RUN TASK/RUN JOB, symbolic parameters, conditional processing, checkpoint/restart, and Process dependencies.
* Analyze Connect:Direct **statistics, logs, return codes, message IDs, queues and session failures** to perform root-cause analysis.
* Configure and support **Netmap, functional authorities, user proxies, Secure+, TLS certificates and cipher configuration** .
* Perform **Connect:Direct upgrades, migrations, patching, vulnerability remediation, server refreshes, HA/DR and failover/failback exercises** .
* Work extensively with **IBM Sterling Control Center Monitor/Director** for node monitoring, alerts, SLA/SLC monitoring, configuration management, audit, inventory, and centralized management.
* Troubleshoot end-to-end file-transfer issues involving application, Linux/Windows, network, firewall, security, storage, and external partner teams.
* Integrate Connect:Direct workflows with **AutoSys** and other enterprise scheduling solutions.
* Develop automation using **Bash/Shell, PowerShell, Python or Ansible** for monitoring, health checks and operational activities.
* Participate in Incident, Problem, Change and Capacity Management and lead technical troubleshooting/RCA for complex production incidents.

**Required skills**

* **8+ years of enterprise file-transfer/MFT experience** , with strong hands-on experience in **IBM Sterling Connect:Direct / NDM** .
* Strong knowledge of **Connect:Direct architecture, PNODE/SNODE, Netmap, Processes, queues, sessions, statistics and troubleshooting** .
* Experience supporting **Connect:Direct 6.x** , preferably 6.3/6.4/6.5.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Secure+, TLS/SSL certificates, cipher configuration and node authentication** .
* Experience with **IBM Sterling Control Center Monitor and/or Control Center Director** .
* Strong **Linux/UNIX and Windows troubleshooting** skills.
* Strong understanding of **SFTP, SSH, TCP/IP, firewalls, DNS, routing, authentication and file permissions** .
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform detailed **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** .
* Experience with enterprise scheduling, preferably **AutoSys** .
* Scripting/automation experience using **Shell/Bash, PowerShell, Python or Ansible** .
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

**Good to have**

Additional experience with enterprise MFT technologies is desirable:

* Axway B2Bi / Interchange / Sentinel
* Primeur Data One / MFX / Spazio
* IBM Sterling Secure Proxy
* SFTP / FTPS / HTTPS / SSH
* PGP encryption/decryption and key management
* AWS / Azure and hybrid-cloud environments
* Splunk / Dynatrace / Grafana
* MFT platform modernization and migrations

**Education**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience supporting MFT/Connect:Direct in a **large-scale financial-services or regulated enterprise environment** is preferred.

**Work Schedule**

* **Work model:** Fully Work from Office; no hybrid working.
* **Schedule:** APAC, 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM or EMEA, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
* **Location:** Bangalore or Hyderabad. Candidates unwilling to relocate need not apply.

**Important:** We are looking for a **strong hands-on NDM/Connect:Direct troubleshooting engineer** , not someone whose experience is limited to routine administration, monitoring, Process submission, or operational support.

  

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

  

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

  

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers
