Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Lead the ESG & Sustainable Finance Research Centre of Excellence in Bangalore, setting its strategic direction, operating model and research agenda, and building a scalable team that supports senior decision-making, client engagement and business development across the Bank.

• Own delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, quality assurance and capability development for ESG and sustainable-finance research, ensuring outputs are commercially relevant, evidence-based, consistent and suitable for senior internal and external audiences.
  
• Act as a senior adviser to Coverage, Sustainable Finance, product and regional teams, translating complex sustainability, transition, regulatory and market developments into sector perspectives, financing implications and actionable client opportunities.
  
• Combine deep ESG and sustainable-finance expertise with strong corporate finance, valuation and analytical judgement to connect material sustainability factors with business strategy, financial performance, capital allocation, risk and financing requirements.
  
• Lead collaboration across markets and time zones, prioritising the COE portfolio, allocating resources and ensuring effective delivery against agreed service standards and strategic priorities.
  
• Drive innovation in research methodologies, ESG data, knowledge management and responsible use of AI-enabled tools while maintaining appropriate controls for confidentiality, accuracy, attribution, bias and human review.
  
• Build a high-performing and inclusive team, with clear accountability, coaching, succession planning and structured development pathways for Band 6 managers and research professionals.
  
• The role is expected to operate flexibly across India, Singapore, UK, UAE and other relevant markets to support global stakeholders and priority deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Set the COE strategy, annual plan, thematic research agenda and measures of success in alignment with CIB, Coverage and Sustainable Finance priorities.

• Lead a multidisciplinary team delivering ESG and sustainable-finance market intelligence, sector research, transition-pathway analysis, company perspectives and client-ready insights.
  
• Own senior stakeholder engagement and demand governance, converting business priorities into a transparent delivery portfolio and resolving competing requirements across markets and products.
  
• Provide senior review and challenge of sustainable, transition and sustainability-linked finance frameworks, including use-of-proceeds, KPI selection, targets, credibility considerations and market comparability.
  
• Ensure ESG analysis is integrated with corporate finance, valuation, credit and capital-structure considerations to support differentiated client dialogue and commercially relevant recommendations.
  
• Oversee executive briefings, sector outlooks, thematic papers, client materials and thought leadership, with accountability for quality, balance, traceability and timely delivery.
  
• Establish and maintain robust standards for research methodology, source validation, ESG data use, citations, peer review, sign-off, confidentiality and records management.
  
• Identify and manage greenwashing, reputational, conduct, data, methodology and operational risks, escalating material concerns and ensuring assumptions and limitations are transparent.
  
• Build partnerships with internal experts and approved external data and research providers to strengthen sector knowledge, market coverage and analytical depth.
  
• Drive technology enablement, automation, reusable content and responsible AI adoption to improve productivity, consistency and scalability of the COE.

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Controls

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000138160

  

Join Barclays as AVP - Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

  
  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking & Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include below:

  
  

* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. * Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

This AVP3 position is a senior individual-contributor role focused on consistent, risk-based application security assurance across a large application estate. It covers application discovery and classification, proportionate security reviews, evidence quality, exceptions and a clear view of coverage and residual risk.

Although the posting title is Jr AppSec Engineer, the management level requires mature judgement, credible stakeholder leadership and the ability to quality-review assurance decisions. The role remains technically grounded and must recognise when manual testing or specialist review is required.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead application and API discovery campaigns with technology, business and governance stakeholders; reconcile inventories, identify ownership gaps and define the population requiring AppSec oversight.

* Apply and improve risk-classification criteria using criticality, data, exposure, users, transactions, technology, regulatory relevance, threat and change to determine assurance depth and cadence.

* Review existing security evidence for control intent, scope, recency, testing method and applicability; reuse credible evidence and identify requirements that still need review or testing.

* Create proportionate assurance plans that combine existing evidence, questionnaires, design review, threat modelling, automated control results and specialist testing based on risk.

* Direct proportionate application security reviews, track completion and quality-review decisions with explicit conditions, assumptions and validity periods.

* Coordinate with AppSec testing, Red Team and DevSecOps colleagues when technical depth is required; ensure their output is incorporated into the assurance decision.

* Collaborate with architecture teams on security requirements and risk challenge without taking ownership of target architecture, solution design or design-authority decisions.

* Support threat-modelling and secure-design discussions, ensuring actions have owners and are reflected in delivery plans and acceptance criteria.

* Govern exceptions and risk acceptance: confirm accountable ownership, rationale, risk statement, compensating controls, remediation plan, expiry and required approval.

* Challenge weak or incomplete evidence and prevent administrative completion from being treated as security effectiveness.

* Maintain clear review records, decision logs and evidence traceability for governance, audit and regulatory review.

* Define metrics for population coverage, risk tiers, assessment status, evidence reuse, gaps, findings, remediation, exceptions and overdue decisions; explain trends and limitations.

* Prepare concise governance reporting and facilitate decisions with application owners, engineering leaders, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Audit.

Coach junior assurance staff, calibrate decisions across reviewers and improve standards, templates and playbooks using lessons from delivery.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in application security assurance, technology risk, product security, security governance or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience delivering risk-based application security assurance across multiple applications and stakeholder groups.

* Strong judgement in evidence sufficiency, control effectiveness, risk classification, exception quality and review conditions.

* Working knowledge of application architectures, web and API risk, threat modelling, secure development and automated security testing.

* Ability to translate between technical findings, control requirements, business impact and accountable risk decisions.

* Experience producing governance metrics and evidence that can withstand audit or regulatory challenge.

* Confident stakeholder facilitation and escalation, including the ability to challenge senior owners constructively.

* Strong written documentation, attention to traceability and ability to manage a sizeable portfolio.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated global organisation.

* Familiarity with control frameworks and secure development standards such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, ASVS, ISO 27001 or similar.

* Experience with GRC platforms, application inventories, work-management tools or evidence automation.

* Evidence of practical capability improving application security assurance or secure development practices.

Experience improving an assurance operating model or rationalising duplicate controls.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Be rigorous about evidence while making assurance proportionate to actual risk.

* Do not confuse process completion with an effective security outcome.

* State assumptions, gaps, conditions and decision ownership clearly; avoid ambiguous conclusions.

* Use metrics to support decisions and improvement, not to create false precision.

* Build trusted relationships and lead governance activity from the Hyderabad office.

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer

  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).

This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.

  
  

You'll also be:

  
  

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.

  

To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.

  
  

You'll also demonstrate:

  
  

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments

* Design controlled bypass and exception mechanisms with expiry, approval, rationale, compensating controls and complete audit trails; do not allow silent bypasses.

* Automate dashboards and evidence for coverage, policy outcomes, blocked builds, ageing findings, exceptions and adoption while protecting sensitive finding data.

* Lead structured tool evaluations and proofs of concept covering detection efficacy, language and platform coverage, API quality, deployment model, usability, scalability, security and cost.

* Provide developer-facing documentation, reference pipelines, troubleshooting guides and enablement; use feedback to reduce friction without weakening risk controls.

Coach DevSecOps and AppSec engineers, review changes, and apply secure engineering practices to the security automation itself.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in DevOps, platform engineering, software engineering or security engineering, including substantial ownership of CI/CD security controls.

* Deep practical experience with Azure DevOps repos and pipelines, YAML templates, service connections, agents, permissions and branch or pull-request policies.

* Hands-on integration experience across several of SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security capabilities.

* Strong scripting or programming skills and experience building maintainable automation using APIs, version control, testing and peer review.

* Understanding of software supply-chain risk, dependency and licence risk, secrets handling, artefact integrity, container security and cloud infrastructure definitions.

* Experience tuning tools and designing risk-based gates that developers can understand and operations teams can support.

* Ability to diagnose pipeline failures across network, identity, agent, tool and configuration layers.

* Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to lead adoption across multiple engineering teams.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, registries, signing or attestation, SBOMs and software supply-chain frameworks.

* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Helm or similar.

* Experience with commercial AppSec platforms, vulnerability-management integrations or enterprise developer portals.

* Hands-on experience operating Azure DevOps, cloud or Kubernetes security controls at enterprise scale.

Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-availability environment.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Optimise for reliable controls and developer adoption, not tool deployment alone.

* Use data and pilots before introducing blocking changes that could disrupt delivery.

* Engineer explicit, expiring exception paths rather than informal workarounds.

* Treat security automation as production software with tests, monitoring, change control and support ownership.

* Lead hands-on from the Hyderabad office and build strong partnerships across global engineering teams.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description-**

Citi operates through five major business divisions — Services, Markets, Banking and International, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking. Each of these generates complex financial data and transactions that require robust technology infrastructure. Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. Finance Technology lives within T&BE, making it a truly enterprise-wide function, delivering technology solutions for Finance, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, and Treasury across all Citi businesses globally.

**Responsibilities**:

The Finance Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities. It is a Techno-functional hands-on role with experience building products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.

Key responsibility will be to define Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

* Ownership of the Product backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.

* Participate in day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results

* Leada culture of innovation, “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase customer value. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.

* Defines and measures the KPIs for a platform product

* Is able to make trade-off decisions on multiple platform products in a portfolio

* Develop solution proposals, business cases, and budget requests

* Work in an agile environment, continuously reviewing the business needs, refining priorities, outlining milestones and deliverables, and identifying opportunities and risks

* Drive stakeholder alignment and iterative product delivery

* Lead business process redesign, operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, regulatory and risk alignment, user adoption and change management.

* Work with Data: Data analysis to document business requirements at the right level, draw meaningful insights, and visualize conceptual and logical data models and flows. Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.

* Stay ahead of AI. This space moves fast. We need someone who follows it seriously, brings new ideas back to the team, and actively applies what they're learning to the products we build. If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.

* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.

* Communicate like it matters. We're distributed across three continents. Clear, direct, proactive communication isn't a soft skill here. It's how the work gets done.

* Keep safety non-negotiable. We're building AI systems inside a global bank. Security, compliance, and AI safety aren't afterthoughts. You'll build with all of it in mind from the start. Report control gaps with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.

**Must-have skills:**

* Demonstrated experience in Product Management and/or Product Development discipline

* Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and financial close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting

* Strong working knowledge of Agentic AI, ML, LLM, A2A concepts, Intelligent rule engine and their practical applications in business processes across financial services.

* Solid Experience with Data pipelines/ integrations and consumption patterns, Modelling, Data Lineage, Quality & Governance

* Ability to apply ingenuity, creativity and analytical thinking to problem analysis and resolution in complicated and/or novel situations

* Build consensus and communicate the value proposition to key partners and stakeholders across the organization, ask right questions and challenge current ways of working to identify root-cause of problems.

* Highly self-motivated, effective communication and decision management skills, and has the willingness to learn and adapt in an agile environment.

To assess the integrity and effectiveness of the banks internal control framework to support the mitigation of risk and protection of the banks operational, financial, and reputational risk.

The role of Director Strategy and Chief of Staff would be a leadership role at Medtronic Engineering Innovation Center (MEIC) reporting to VP, MEIC. The role would involve driving governance and review for VP creating more comprehensive strategic utilisation and optimisation of site capabilities and impact.
  
  
The individual would also be responsible for special projects/ engagements as assigned by the VP MEIC and on his behalf as applicable for relationship with government and confederation of Industry in close partnership with Finance leadership at Site. The individual would partner closely with communications leader at MEIC for Site for matters related to both internal and external communications by VP MEIC.

The role of **Director Strategy and Chief of Staff** to VP MEIC would strengthen strategy, governance, prioritization, and alignment across the site in partnerships with the OUs and enterprise functions. In addition, the role will evolve to be accountable for external eco-system partnerships.

**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Drive the development of the FAB Asset Management product range across all asset classes and product types, grounded in market analysis, client demand and competitive positioning.
* Own product ideation and design - investment proposition, target segment, vehicle and share class design, fee structure and commercial positioning - with legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation executed by the relevant departments.
* Own product pricing and economics, including fee grids, margins, distribution economics and profitability, ensuring products are competitive in the market and commercially viable for FAB AM.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Bridge investment capabilities and client needs by translating market intelligence, competitor insight and distribution feedback into clear product priorities and commercial opportunities.

* Contribute directly to revenue growth through RFPs, due diligence questionnaires, client proposals, pitches and market-entry initiatives.
* Build systematic market intelligence and product analytics that inform management decisions, sales priorities and the mediumterm product roadmap.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market intelligence and competitive analysis: Monitor market trends, industry flows, client demand, regulatory developments and competitor activity across relevant asset classes, products and client segments; maintain structured benchmarking of product ranges, performance, fees, positioning and distribution models.
* Product strategy and roadmap: Convert market and client insight into product priorities, business cases and roadmap recommendations, highlighting addressable opportunities, capability gaps and commercial implications.
* Product proposition and positioning: Work with investment and product teams to shape investment propositions, target segments, differentiators, fee positioning and go-to-market narratives, while specialist functions retain ownership of legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation.

* RFPs, DDQs and proposals: Lead or contribute to the product, strategy, market and competitive sections of RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and client proposals; coordinate inputs and maintain a reusable library of approved content and Q&A.
* Client and distribution engagement: Support institutional and distribution sales in client meetings, product pitches, product education and follow-up, providing credible technical and market context.
* Go-to-market and market entry: Develop market-entry assessments and go-to-market plans, including opportunity sizing, targetclient mapping, competitor analysis, positioning, pricing considerations and recommended actions.
* Product analytics and management reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, peer groups and analytical tools covering flows, performance, fees, ratings, market share and competitive positioning; produce clear management reporting and actionable recommendations.
* Cross-functional delivery: Coordinate multi-stakeholder initiatives across Investments, Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, managing dependencies and delivery timelines.

* Experience: Typically 7+ years in asset management, product strategy, product specialist, market intelligence, business development or a closely related role within regulated financial services.

* Market intelligence: Demonstrated experience using industry databases and analytical tools to assess market size, flows, competitor ranges, performance, fees, ratings and positioning.

* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA, AMF or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

Credit & Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

We are currently seeking an ambitious professional to join the team as an Assistant Vice President who will provide credit advisory and support services to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage. This includes facilitating client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process

  

**In this role, you will:-**

* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds
* Drive continuous improvement in productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recommendations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators

**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**

  

* Proven expertise in corporate lending with strong analytical skills
* Must possess sound credit knowledge with proven skills of writing credit proposals
* Strong understanding of financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Tenacious with numbers – aptitude for analyzing and interpreting data.
* A trust earner – can listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* Committed to quality – high standards for work, solve problems so they are fixed and stay fixed.
* A critical thinker – can operate independently and use judgement in a dynamic environment.
* Attentive to detail and can apply professional skepticism – not afraid to challenge the status quo.
* Degree in Business, Finance or related field is highly desirable
* A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and/or work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.This engineering leader for India will oversee the newly established WhatsApp Services team, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. * Champion engineering craft and quality standards across teams, fostering a self-reinforcing culture of continuous improvement.
* Monitor and act on organizational health signals to maintain high engagement, low attrition and effective team dynamics across reporting lines.
* Develop a leadership bench through both external hiring and internal growth, and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives including recruiting, mentorship and technical standards.

* 10+ years of technical industry experience in software engineering
* 7+ years of engineering management experience, including managing other engineering managers
* Track record of building and scaling engineering organizations, including recruiting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers
* Proven track record of delivering and operating large-scale production systems
* Experience establishing technical strategy and organizational roadmaps across multiple teams, with demonstrated ability to drive execution against them
* Experience forming cross-functional partnerships across product, design and data science to deliver large-scale engineering outcomes

* Experience building and operating payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry

* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple sites

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

jobs.description:
**About Payfinia**

Payfinia is a SaaS payment hub powering community banks and credit unions across the United States. Our flagship product,
**IPX (Instant Payment Exchange)**
, enables real-time payment processing across major payment rails including
**FedNow**
and
**RTP**
. We build secure, scalable, cloud-native financial infrastructure that empowers smaller financial institutions to compete at the highest level.

We are a fast-growing engineering organization with deep roots in AWS, microservices, and payment compliance. We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to join our leadership team at our
**India development center**
.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**Engineering Manager**
based in India who is as comfortable reviewing a system design as they are running a sprint planning session. You will lead one of our core engineering teams, take full ownership of feature delivery, and work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps — as well as our US-based leadership, client teams, and financial institution partners.

This is a
**hands-on leadership role**
. You will operate through 2–3 tech leads and senior engineers while personally engaging in architecture reviews, critical-path technical decisions, and AI-SDLC adoption — not just managing timelines. You will be expected to drive autonomous decision-making during India business hours and maintain proactive communication across a 10–15 hour time zone gap.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People & Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 10–15 engineers across Java, Node.js, and React.js stacks, operating through 2–3 tech leads
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations
* Drive hiring — own technical interviews and build a high-quality engineering pipeline
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, engineering pride, and AI-augmented productivity
* Manage and coordinate with QA team, and external contractors

**Technical Leadership**

* Actively participate in architecture, design, and code reviews across the stack
* Make or guide key technical decisions on microservices design, API contracts, data modeling, and integration patterns
* Ensure adherence to engineering best practices: code quality, security-by-design, observability, and documentation
* Own technical quality gates for multi-tenant SaaS releases

**AI-SDLC Leadership**

* **AI-Assisted Development**
  - Drive adoption of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalents) across the team; establish usage guidelines, measure productivity impact, and share best practices
* **AI Across the SDLC**
  - Integrate AI into the full development lifecycle: AI-driven test case generation, automated code review augmentation, design document drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and documentation generation
* **Measurement & Governance**
  - Define and track AI productivity metrics (AI-assisted code coverage, review cycle time reduction, defect escape rates); ensure AI tooling usage complies with PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and data residency requirements; establish prompt engineering standards and reusable context libraries for the team

**Delivery & Execution**

* Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for your team's domain - from planning and sprint execution to production deployment and post-go-live support
* Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate effort, and translate roadmap into executable plans
* Drive risk identification and mitigation - proactively surface blockers and manage dependencies across teams
* Support multi-tenant SaaS releases including customer onboarding, integration certification, and go-live events
* Own deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate improvements for your team's domain

**Security & Compliance**

* Participate in threat modeling and secure SDLC practices for payment processing workflows
* Ensure team adherence to PCI-DSS, SOC 2 compliance requirements as operational realities, not checkboxes
* Support security incident response - coordinate remediation, produce root-cause analyses, and drive hardening initiatives
* Maintain audit-ready engineering practices: code review documentation, change management records, access control hygiene

**Stakeholder & Client Engagement**

* Represent engineering in scoping, discovery, and integration discussions with US-based financial institution partners and third-party vendors (expect periodic evening IST calls)
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with internal and external stakeholders across time zones — default to over-communication given the distributed model
* Provide regular engineering status, risk, and delivery updates to US-based leadership without requiring prompting

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* **12+ years of total software engineering experience**
  , with at least
  **1–2 years in an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead Manager role**
* Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (10+) in a SaaS or product-based environment
* Strong background in
  **full-stack development**
  — hands-on expertise across at least two of:
  **Node.js**
  ,
  **React.js**
  ,
  **Java/Spring Boot**
* Experience managing distributed/remote teams across time zones, including vendor and contractor coordination
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI development tools and driving engineering productivity improvements

**Technical Skills**

* **Node.js**
  — REST API design, async/event-driven patterns, Express/Fastify, NPM ecosystem
* **React.js**
  — Component architecture, state management (Redux/Zustand/Context), modern hooks, performance optimization
* **Java / Spring Boot**
  — Microservices, Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Maven/Gradle, multi-threading
* **Cloud & Infrastructure**
  — AWS (EKS, RDS, API Gateway, Lambda, SQS/SNS, KMS, or equivalents), Docker, Kubernetes
* **Databases**
  — PostgreSQL/MySQL (relational modeling, query optimization), Redis (caching, pub/sub)
* **API Security**
  — OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS, API Gateway patterns, WAF concepts
* **CI/CD & DevOps**
  — GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar pipelines; familiarity with GitOps principles
* **AI Development Tools**
  — Working proficiency with at least one AI coding assistant (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor); understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations in software engineering workflows

**Domain Knowledge (Strongly Preferred)**

* Experience in
  **fintech, banking, or payment systems**
  — understanding of payment rails (ACH, FedNow, RTP, Wire) and payment message lifecycles
* Familiarity with
  **PCI-DSS, SOC 2**
  , or other financial compliance/security frameworks
* Exposure to
  **IBM MQ**
  ,
  **Salesforce**
  , core banking systems (Symitar, Corelation, DNA, XP2), or multi-tenant FI onboarding patterns

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders and communicate clearly in writing.
* High ownership mindset with a bias for action and autonomous decision-making
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast-paced, distributed environment
* Collaborative leader who can balance empathy with accountability
* Proactive communicator who defaults to transparency — doesn't wait to be asked for updates
