jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and applicable industry requirements.
* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly production performance and present operational reports to senior management.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management would be an added advantage.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
* Significant hands-on experience in forging operations and production management, preferably in a steel manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale manufacturing operations, production teams, and shop-floor activities.
* Strong understanding of forging processes, tooling, metallurgy, heat treatment, quality systems, and manufacturing technologies, as applicable.
* Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, cost control, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and deliver operational targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Production output and achievement of production targets.
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and machine utilization.
* Rejection, rework, and scrap reduction.
* Manufacturing cost and energy consumption per unit.
* On-time delivery and adherence to production schedules.
* Workplace safety performance and compliance.
* Implementation of productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

Appwork IT Solutions is a technology-driven company focused on building innovative software solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and accelerate digital transformation.

We are looking for a driven and strategically minded Enterprise Sales Development Representative / Manager to spearhead outbound sales development for our AI-powered solutions, with a primary focus on the BFSI, NBFC, banking, and fintech sectors.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, researching, and engaging potential enterprise clients, building a strong sales pipeline, and generating qualified business opportunities through strategic outbound outreach.

### **What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

* Get exposure to AI-powered solutions and real-world enterprise use cases.
* Participate in actual enterprise sales conversations and product demonstrations.

Candidates with experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, NBFC technology, lending technology, KYC solutions, collections technology, conversational AI, or customer experience platforms will be preferred.

jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will build and manage a growth system based on data, AI, and user intent, transforming marketing from a communication function into a real-time decision layer. We provide the space for you to exercise true strategic autonomy, stripping away micromanagement so you can integrate marketing directly into the product, drive user acquisition and retention through intent detection, and evolve UMO into a trusted financial assistant end-to-end.

**You'll take ownership of:**

* **Growth & Decision Layer (The Core):**
  Build an intent detection and decisioning system based on user data. Integrate marketing directly into the product (product-led growth) to drive "one intent -> one action" logic, shaping the user's experience by correctly reacting to their state in the moment.
* **Data & MarTech Architecture:**
  Build our first-party data strategy, developing the CDP, data layer, event tracking, and data clean rooms while maintaining data quality, structure, and accessibility for automated decisioning.
* **Customer Lifecycle & Personalization:**
  Design the end-to-end customer journey, transitioning from traditional segments to individual scenarios powered by behavior, context, financial status, and life event triggers.
* **Go-to-Market & Growth Execution:**
  Develop GTM strategies for new products and markets while managing performance, partnership, and product-led acquisition channels focused on LTV, engagement, and value delivered.
* **Brand & Trust:**
  Shape UMO's positioning as an AI-native financial assistant and trusted decision layer, ensuring absolute communication consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* **Compliance & Data Governance:**
  Ensure strict compliance with GDPR, privacy rules, advertising standards, and consent management frameworks in close coordination with CISO, Risk, and Legal teams.
* **Analytics & Intelligence:**
  Build a real-time metrics system measuring intent detection accuracy, context conversions, LTV, retention, and value delivered.
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Lead Growth, Data, Marketing, and CRM/Lifecycle teams while partnering closely with Product, Tech, AI, Risk, and Compliance.

**About you:**

* **Executive Growth Leadership:**
  You have extensive commercial experience in a senior marketing or growth leadership capacity (at least 7+ years) within high-growth fintech, tech, or data-driven digital environments.
* **Data & AI-Native Architecture:**
  You feel at home building first-party data strategies, CDPs, and event-tracking frameworks, leveraging AI tooling and predictive models to turn raw data into actionable decision engines.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG) Depth:**
  You have proven experience driving acquisition, engagement, and retention directly through product workflows rather than relying solely on external ad campaigns.
* **Regulated Environment & Compliance:**
  You understand data protection principles, GDPR, advertising regulations, and consent governance, ensuring data is used transparently and in the user's best interest.
* **Autonomous Milestone Execution:**
  You manage complex growth goals comfortably, taking complete end-to-end problem ownership over market entry, LTV metrics, and product-led journeys.
* **Transparent & Supportive Leadership:**
  You communicate openly, foster cross-functional collaboration with product and tech teams, and prioritize an absolute zero-tolerance policy for rudeness or politics.
* **Linguistic Fluency:**
  You speak and write English fluently to comfortably lead global teams and align cross-functional executive tracks.

**Can get you a few bonus points:**

* **Fintech & Digital Asset Background:**
  Prior experience building growth systems or personalized financial products within fintech, neobanks, or regulated web3 platforms.
* **MarTech & AI Tooling Expertise:**
  Direct experience configuring advanced CDP platforms, custom LLM prompt setups, or AI-driven marketing automation engines.
* **Startup Agility:**
  Experience operating within zero-to-one or lean startup environments where market entry strategies evolve quickly.

**The UMO Standard**

* Mandate & Ownership: Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* Equity: A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* Location & Flexibility: Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

**Unit Leader - Client Acquisition**

**About the Role:**

YubiLoans UAE is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to lead the SME Loans Segment. This role is central to driving the growth of our SME marketplace by acquiring corporate borrowers and successfully onboarding them onto our platform. As the Team Leader, you will manage a team responsible for identifying, engaging, and facilitating the onboarding of SME borrowers, ensuring they can connect with the right lenders through our marketplace. You will be at the forefront of shaping the acquisition strategy, ensuring the smooth onboarding of borrowers, and building strong relationships with potential clients. This role requires a leader with a deep understanding of the SME lending landscape, excellent team management skills, and the ability to drive marketplace growth through strategic partnerships and efficient processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership & Team Management:**

* **Team Leadership**
  : Lead and inspire a team of SME loan acquisition specialists and onboarding managers, ensuring they meet loan origination targets and contribute to the growth of Yubiloans' SME borrower base across all SME loan variants including business loans, POS loans, asset backed loans, commercial vehicle and fleet finance, working capital loans, loan against property and capex loans.
* **Performance Management**
  : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for your team, tracking progress and providing coaching to improve team performance and overall contribution to business goals.
* **Coaching & Development**
  : Develop a high-performance culture, providing ongoing training and development to enhance the skill sets of your team members.

**Borrower Acquisition & Onboarding:**

* **Market Development**
  : Drive efforts to identify and target potential SME and corporate borrowers across the MENA region, focusing on those who would benefit from connecting with lenders through the Yubiloans marketplace.
* **Client Engagement**
  : Establish relationships with potential borrowers, understand their financing needs, and position Yubiloans as the optimal solution for connecting them with the right lending partners.
* **Onboarding Process**
  : Oversee the seamless onboarding of borrowers onto the Yubiloans platform, ensuring they are fully equipped to access financing options that best meet their needs.
* **Sales Strategy**
  : Develop and implement strategies to acquire a diverse set of borrowers, balancing volume with quality to maximize the overall growth and health of the marketplace.

**Partnership & Relationship Management:**

* **Lender Network Collaboration**
  : Collaborate closely with Yubiloans' lender partners to understand their requirements and ensure the borrowers you onboard are well-matched with appropriate lenders.
* **Strategic Partnerships**
  : Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate clients, industry associations, and other stakeholders to attract new borrowers to the platform.
* **Customer Service Excellence**
  : Ensure a high-quality onboarding experience for borrowers, guiding them through the platform and answering questions to ensure smooth adoption.

**Operational Excellence:**

* **Process Optimization**
  : Work closely with operations, product, and technology teams to continuously refine and streamline the borrower onboarding process for greater efficiency and scalability.
* **Market Insights & Trends**
  : Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes in the SME lending space to refine acquisition strategies and ensure compliance.
* **Data-Driven Decisions**
  : Utilize data and performance metrics to inform strategies and track the effectiveness of borrower acquisition and onboarding efforts. Identify opportunities for process improvements.

**Client and Stakeholder Interaction:**

* **Client Consultation**
  : Provide advisory support to borrowers, helping them understand the benefits of connecting with the right lenders through Yubiloans and ensuring they are informed and confident throughout the onboarding journey.
* **Cross-Sell & Upsell Opportunities**
  : Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell additional services or products to existing borrowers, enhancing their experience on the platform and increasing lifetime value.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* **Internal Coordination**
  : Collaborate with internal teams such as product, legal, compliance, marketing, and technology to ensure the smooth onboarding of borrowers and continuous improvements to the platform’s functionality and user experience.
* **Market Insights**
  : Provide feedback to the product and marketing teams to ensure that the platform features and promotional strategies align with market demands and borrower needs.

**Key Performance Metrics:**

* **Borrower Acquisition**
  : Achieve new borrower onboarding targets, ensuring a diverse and high-quality pool of SME and Corporate borrowers on the platform.
* **Onboarding Success**
  : Monitor and optimize the borrower onboarding process, ensuring timely and efficient onboarding experiences.
* **Team Performance**
  : Drive team performance, ensuring KPIs related to borrower engagement, conversion rates, and platform adoption are met.
* **Lender Match Success**
  : Ensure borrowers are successfully matched with the right lenders, contributing to successful loan transactions on the platform.
* **Customer Satisfaction**
  : Track borrower satisfaction and retention, ensuring a high-quality experience throughout the onboarding process.

**Requirements:**

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* **Experience**
  : 8-12 years of experience in the SME lending, fintech, or financial services sectors, with at least 3-5 years in a team management role focused on borrower acquisition, onboarding, or relationship management.
* **Leadership**
  : Proven ability to lead and inspire high-performing teams, with strong people management and coaching skills.
* **Business Development**
  : Experience in driving business development within the SME lending space, with a focus on building relationships with borrowers and lenders.
* **Market Knowledge**
  : Strong understanding of the SME lending landscape in the MENA region, including the needs of corporate borrowers and the dynamics of lending marketplaces.
* **Educational Background**
  : A Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* **Strategic Thinking**
  : Ability to develop and execute strategic plans to grow borrower acquisition and platform adoption.
* **Client-Centric**
  : A customer-first mindset, with the ability to build trust and strong relationships with SME borrowers and lender partners.
* **Communication**
  : Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with corporate borrowers, lenders, and internal teams.
* **Problem-Solving**
  : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address borrower challenges and optimize the onboarding experience.
* **Technologically Savvy**
  : Familiarity with digital lending platforms, SaaS solutions, and marketplace models. Comfort with using data and technology to drive decision-making.

jobs.description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**Leadership:**

* Demonstrated experience communicating technical architecture to executive and non-technical audiences
* Experience leading technical teams of 5–15 engineers
* Ability to write clear, structured technical documents: architecture decision records, design specifications, risk assessments

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with cross-chain interoperability protocols and multi-network connectivity patterns
* TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture certification
* Experience participating in or building for a central bank digital currency (CBDC) initiative
* Open-source contributions to major Web3 frameworks, Ethereum Improvement Proposals, or tokenization standards
* Familiarity with enterprise tokenization platform architectures and global payment network specifications

**What Makes an Exceptional Candidate:**

* You have designed a blockchain system that is actually running in production at a financial institution — not just a proof of concept
* You are as comfortable in a regulatory examination room explaining your architecture to an OSFI examiner as you are reviewing a pull request
* You have opinionated views on when blockchain is the right tool and when it isn't — and you're not afraid to say so
* You think about failure modes before you think about happy paths
* You understand that in financial infrastructure, the architecture you design today will be running for 15 years

**Why This Role:**

* Define the architecture that will shape CIBC's digital assets capability for the next decade
* Direct influence on CIBC's participation in global institutional blockchain networks and tokenized payment initiatives
* Work at the intersection of technology leadership, regulatory strategy, and financial innovation
* Build something that has never been built at a major Canadian bank before
* Executive visibility: this program is a strategic priority at the highest levels of the organization

**Compensation:**

Director-level compensation commensurate with the seniority and strategic importance of the role. Competitive with Toronto technology and financial services market. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. **Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Designation:** Accounts Coordinator  
**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Head/CA  
**Location:** Ghatkopar / Head Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Senior Accounts Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting day-to-day accounting and finance activities, ensuring accurate accounting records, timely reconciliations, statutory compliance, vendor/customer coordination and preparation of financial and MIS reports.

The role requires strong coordination with internal departments, vendors, customers, banks, auditors and external consultants to ensure smooth and timely completion of accounting activities.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Accounting Operations

* Handle day-to-day accounting transactions, including purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries.
* Verify invoices, vouchers and supporting documents before accounting.
* Maintain accurate ledgers and accounting records.
* Monitor Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Ensure proper accounting of expenses, provisions and accruals.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly and yearly closing of accounts.
* Support preparation and finalisation of financial statements.

B. Reconciliation & Control

* Prepare and review Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).
* Perform customer, vendor and general ledger reconciliations.
* Identify and resolve outstanding and unreconciled items.
* Reconcile GST input/output balances with books and available GST data.
* Monitor advances, outstanding receivables and payables.
* Ensure proper documentation and accounting controls.

C. GST & TDS Compliance

* Prepare data and working for GST returns and coordinate with consultants for timely filing.
* Verify GST applicability, input tax credit and tax-related entries.
* Prepare TDS workings and ensure correct deduction as applicable.
* Coordinate for timely TDS payment, returns and reconciliation.
* Maintain records related to GST, TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Assist in responding to statutory notices and queries, wherever required.

D. Vendor & Customer Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices, payments, outstanding balances and account statements.
* Coordinate with customers for outstanding payments and reconciliation.
* Obtain missing invoices, debit/credit notes and supporting documents.
* Resolve accounting discrepancies with respective departments and external parties.
* Maintain proper records of vendor and customer communications.

E. Banking & Payments

* Coordinate with banks for routine banking activities.
* Prepare payment-related documents and supporting schedules.
* Verify bank transactions and ensure timely accounting.
* Assist in NEFT/RTGS/cheque payment processes as per company approval procedures.
* Follow up on pending banking and payment-related matters.

F. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic Accounts MIS reports as required by management.
* Prepare ageing reports for receivables and payables.
* Prepare outstanding, collection and payment status reports.
* Provide financial data and analysis to the Accounts Manager / Finance Head.
* Maintain trackers for statutory payments, reconciliations and important accounting deadlines.

G. Audit & Compliance Support

* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Provide accounting records, ledgers, reconciliations and supporting documents for audits.
* Assist in preparation of audit schedules and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of financial and statutory records.

H. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase, Sales, Stores, HR, Administration and other departments for accounting-related requirements.
* Ensure timely receipt of documents required for accounting and compliance.
* Follow up with respective departments for pending documents and approvals.
* Support the Accounts Manager / Finance Head in special assignments and process improvements.

3. Required Qualification

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* CA Inter / CMA Inter will be an added advantage.

4. Experience

* **3–10 years of relevant experience** in Accounts & Finance.
* Experience in a manufacturing / trading / corporate environment will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong hands-on experience in Tally and statutory compliance will be preferred.

5. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
* Hands-on knowledge of **Tally ERP / Tally Prime** or similar accounting software.
* Good knowledge of **GST and TDS**.
* Strong knowledge of Bank, Vendor, Customer and Ledger Reconciliation.
* Good command of **MS Excel**, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS and basic financial reporting.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.
* Timely completion of bank, vendor and customer reconciliations.
* Timely submission of GST/TDS data and compliance workings.
* Reduction of outstanding unreconciled items.
* Timely preparation of MIS and management reports.
* Timely resolution of vendor/customer accounting discrepancies.
* Audit readiness and timely submission of audit documents.
* Compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls.

7. Behavioural Competencies

* Ownership and accountability
* Strong coordination and follow-up
* Integrity and confidentiality
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability
* Time management
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Director, Islamic Finance (GCB 3) you’ll help develop and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region, based in the UAE. Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. You’ll bring market awareness and practical judgement to help keep our propositions relevant and well governed.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Shape and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region
* Partner with relationship managers and business heads to identify and convert Islamic financing opportunities across GCC and wider MENAT
* Structure and execute Islamic finance transactions across bilateral and syndicated financing, structured finance and asset-backed transactions
* Draft and review Islamic term sheets, indicative proposals, transaction structures and approval papers
* Coordinate Shariah adviser engagement and governance forum approvals to resolve Shariah-related matters
* Oversee transaction progression through credit approval, Shariah approval, documentation, conditions precedent, closing and post-closing requirements
* Develop and launch new Islamic finance products across the CIB platform including due diligence, manuals, processes and client materials
* Strengthen risk, controls and conduct outcomes by identifying execution risks early and ensuring appropriate reviews and auditability

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial experience in Islamic finance gained within a bank, financial institution or relevant market participant
* Demonstrate deep GCC experience with proven exposure to the UAE market
* Show a track record of originating, structuring and executing Shariah-compliant financing transactions
* Evidence collaboration with relationship managers and coverage teams to progress opportunities from origination to execution
* Apply proven capability across bilateral financing, syndicated financing and structured finance
* Demonstrate experience drafting Islamic term sheets and reviewing transaction documentation with external legal counsel
* Apply strong working knowledge of AAOIFI Shariah standards and relevant UAE regulatory and Shariah governance requirements
* Show experience supporting or delivering new Islamic product launches including operational implementation with internal stakeholders

**Building Shariah-Compliant Growth**
If you want to work at the centre of Islamic finance origination, structuring and product expansion across MENAT, this role offers a rare mix of advisory depth and execution responsibility. You’ll help clients access Shariah-compliant solutions across corporate and investment banking needs while keeping standards of governance and control front and centre. The scope spans complex transactions, new product delivery and close partnership with coverage teams and control functions. If this matches the work you’ve done and the impact you want to have, we’d like to hear from you.

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness

* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. **Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. * **Test and secure:** Drive AI-generated test cases, test data and automated regression, with AI-assisted security and vulnerability scanning built into CI/CD (shift-left quality and DevSecOps).
* **Release and deploy:** Own CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, versioning, change approvals and deployment orchestration, including containerized deployments to Kubernetes across cloud and on-premises environments, with a high degree of automation.
* **Document and enable:** Use AI to keep technical documentation, release notes and knowledge bases current for Services, Support and implementation partners.

* Own the SDLC and PMLC for Lending, ensuring rigour, transparency and measurability, in alignment with the Enterprise PMO, Product Strategy and Architecture.
* Establish guardrails for the responsible use of AI agents, including human-in-the-loop review, model and prompt governance, data classification, IP and security controls, and auditability, in line with Finastra policies and regulatory requirements.

**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payment's ecosystem.

This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.

The position demands strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and a proven track record of recruiting, growing, and retaining technical talent. Directors are expected to drive consensus in cross-functional teams, forecast business trends, and translate insights into agile technology solutions. Exceptional communication and leadership skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and building credibility across regional and functional lines.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities:

* Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals.
* Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Manage the entire product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post-launch optimization.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to deliver technology solutions.
* Conduct market research, customer, and competitive analysis to guide product development.
* Drive consensus and influence decision-making in matrixed, global environments.
* Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.
* Forecast business trends and translate them into agile technology solutions.
* Structure and manage complex projects and processes with multiple stakeholders.

* 10 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD.

* Experience in defining product strategy.
* Experience in product design.
* Experience in customer discovery and the design of new products based on that discovery.
* Experience in product execution.
* Experience in defining and leading plans to achieve product goals.
* Experience working in Agile frameworks and matrixed organizations.
* Experience in process or core banking best practices.
* Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
* Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to forecast business trends.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 12 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Senior product management experience in Digital, Payments, and Financial Services.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRINGGROUP CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (GROUP CFO)

**Honey Makhija Group**

**Location:** Katni, Madhya Pradesh / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 15–25 Years Preferred  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Position:** Full-Time | Senior Leadership

About the Role

Honey Makhija Group is looking for an experienced, ambitious and strategically capable Group Chief Financial Officer to take complete ownership of the financial functions across the entire group and its subsidiaries.

The CFO will lead all aspects of corporate finance, institutional fundraising, banking, working capital, project finance, government grants and subsidies, accounting, taxation, audits, treasury, financial controls and corporate governance.

A key objective will be to transform the group into a professionally managed, institutionally funded and financially disciplined organisation, with the goal of preparing the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within the next three years.

The CFO will report directly to the Group Chairman.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Fundraising & Banking**

* Raise Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), Working Capital and Term Loan facilities.
* Arrange project finance, equipment finance and structured debt.
* Develop relationships with PSU banks, private banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Lead consortium banking arrangements and negotiate financing terms.
* Explore NCDs, corporate bonds, private credit and institutional funding.
* Manage loan renewals, enhancements, credit ratings and lender compliance.
* Develop and execute a group-wide fundraising strategy targeting ₹1,000+ crore in institutional funding over the medium term, subject to project viability and lender approvals.

**2. Government Grants & Subsidies**

* Identify eligible central and state government subsidy schemes.
* Apply for capital subsidies, interest subsidies and industrial incentives.
* Explore schemes for MSMEs, food processing, manufacturing, renewable energy, EV infrastructure and agro-industries.
* Coordinate with government departments, ministries, industrial development corporations and financial institutions.
* Manage applications, approvals, documentation and subsidy disbursements.

**3. Financial Planning & Management**

* Take complete ownership of group-level financial planning.
* Prepare annual budgets, financial projections and business-wise profitability reports.
* Manage cash flows, working capital and treasury.
* Optimise borrowing costs and capital allocation.
* Evaluate new projects, investments, acquisitions and expansion plans.
* Prepare detailed project reports (DPRs), financial models, IRR, NPV and DSCR calculations.

**4. Accounting, ERP & Financial Systems**

* Establish standardised accounting systems across all group companies.
* Implement ERP and centralised financial management systems.
* Develop financial SOPs, approval matrices and internal controls.
* Establish monthly MIS, consolidated financial reporting and business-wise dashboards.
* Introduce cost accounting, inventory controls and automated reconciliations.
* Build transparent and professionally managed finance operations.

**5. Audits, Taxation & Compliance**

* Lead statutory audits, internal audits and tax audits.
* Oversee GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances.
* Establish audit calendars and financial reporting deadlines.
* Ensure accurate financial statements and timely account finalisation.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Implement internal financial controls and close audit observations.

**6. IPO Readiness – Three-Year Mandate**

* Prepare the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within three years.
* Develop the IPO-readiness roadmap.
* Strengthen corporate governance and financial reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review corporate structures, shareholding and related-party transactions.
* Coordinate with merchant bankers, legal advisors, auditors and investment bankers.
* Prepare the organisation for financial due diligence and regulatory scrutiny.
* Evaluate listing structures, valuation and capital market opportunities.

**7. Treasury & Financial Risk Management**

* Manage group-wide liquidity and cash flow.
* Monitor debt obligations, interest costs and repayment schedules.
* Establish treasury management policies.
* Manage financial risks and optimise deployment of surplus funds.
* Ensure effective working capital management.

**8. Group-Level Financial Governance**

* Establish a centralised finance function across all group companies.
* Consolidate financial reporting.
* Monitor subsidiary performance and financial discipline.
* Build and lead professional finance, accounts, treasury and audit teams.
* Develop financial policies and reporting structures.
* Work directly with the Chairman on strategic financial decisions.

Business Exposure

The CFO will manage financial strategy across the diversified Honey Makhija Group, including:

* Rice milling, agro-processing and food industries.
* EV charging infrastructure.
* Solar and renewable energy.
* Biomass and alternative energy.
* Manufacturing and industrial projects.
* Technology, AI and software businesses.
* Logistics, hospitality and other ventures.

Candidate Requirements

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification mandatory.
* 15–25 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Previous CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director or senior corporate finance experience preferred.
* Strong experience in CC limits, term loans, project finance and institutional fundraising.
* Established relationships with banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Experience in consortium finance and structured debt.
* Knowledge of government grants, subsidies and incentive schemes.
* Strong expertise in accounting, taxation, audits and financial controls.
* Experience in ERP implementation and financial transformation.
* Exposure to IPO preparation, capital markets and corporate governance.
* Excellent negotiation, leadership and execution capabilities.

First 180-Day Expectations

* Complete financial assessment of all group companies.
* Review existing banking facilities, loans and liabilities.
* Develop a comprehensive group fundraising strategy.
* Initiate CC enhancement and term loan proposals.
* Identify and initiate eligible government subsidy applications.
* Implement centralised MIS and financial reporting.
* Establish internal audit and financial control systems.
* Prepare the three-year IPO-readiness roadmap.

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for someone who merely manages accounting, GST and taxation.

We are looking for a financial leader capable of building institutional relationships, raising substantial capital, structuring complex financing, obtaining government incentives, implementing professional financial systems and preparing a diversified corporate group for public-market participation.

The candidate must be execution-oriented, commercially aggressive, professionally disciplined and capable of working directly with the Group Chairman.

Application

Interested and eligible candidates are requested to share their updated CV / Resume via WhatsApp.

**WhatsApp: +91 83834 34626**

**Subject: Application – Group CFO | Honey Makhija Group**

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussions.

**Honey Makhija Group**  
Building businesses. Creating institutions.

Pay: ₹96,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and a fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing and tax advisory services. Our philosophy is simple: planning comes before execution, and client interests come first. We combine professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions and work towards their life goals.

Your Mandate

You will be accountable for building Fintoo’s Bengaluru advisory business across four dimensions: business growth, advisory excellence, client relationships and team leadership. You will lead from the front, personally engage with key prospects and clients, establish a predictable business pipeline and create a high-performance culture focused on ownership, ethical advice and measurable outcomes.

• Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.

• Drive holistic financial planning and long-term advisory relationships rather than transactional, product-led selling. • Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking and proactive client engagement, working with research, investment, product and technology teams to improve advice quality.

3. AUA Growth, Client Retention & Relationships

• Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention and deeper advisory engagement.

• Personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects where senior-level engagement can accelerate business outcomes.

4. Team Leadership & Organisation Building

• Lead an initial team of six professionals across relevant advisory, relationship management and business development responsibilities.

• Recruit, coach and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation and commercial acumen.

• Build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity and continuous learning.
