• Balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity and profitability.

• Build dashboards and repeatable processes that support scale without compromising advisory quality.

6. Technology & Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience and advisor productivity.

• Use digital tools, analytics, automation and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice more scalable and accessible.

• Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education and lead generation.

• Work with operations, finance and compliance teams to ensure efficient execution and robust governance.

• Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.

7. Governance, Ethics & Client Trust

• Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based and client-first advisory philosophy.

• Ensure activities comply with applicable SEBI requirements, internal policies and ethical standards. • Maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures and transparency.

• Ensure business targets never compromise the quality or integrity of financial advice. Key Performance Indicators

• Revenue & Profitability: Achievement of revenue targets, contribution margins and sustainable growth. • AUA Growth: Growth in Assets Under Advisory through suitable acquisition, retention and deeper engagement.

• Paid Customers: New paid customers and improved prospect-to-customer conversion.

• Client Retention: Renewals, relationship longevity, referrals and client engagement.

• Team Productivity: Revenue per professional, target achievement, pipeline quality and overall team performance.

• Business Development: Strength of referral networks, strategic partnerships and qualified pipeline.

• Advisory Quality: Financial plan quality, suitability, documentation, service standards and compliance.

• Operating Efficiency: Acquisition costs, servicing efficiency and progress towards agreed profitability targets.

What We Are LookingFor

• 8–12 years of relevant experience in wealth management, financial planning, investment advisory or a related BFSI business.

• A proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients and achieving revenue targets.

• Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation and relationship management.

jobs.title: Sr Applied Scientist - Semantics
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**   

AuxoAI is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to design and deploy structured knowledge systems that enable reliable, schema-grounded AI and agent reasoning. This role sits at the intersection of large language models, knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, and hybrid retrieval systems. The ideal candidate will build systems that transform unstructured data into structured knowledge representations, enforce semantic constraints, and enable hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning in production environments. You will play a key role in designing scalable semantic infrastructures that support advanced AI use cases such as GraphRAG pipelines, structured extraction, and agent reasoning workflows. You will work on problems where existing architectures may not be sufficient and will experiment with new approaches that combine machine learning, knowledge graphs, semantic constraints, and classical AI techniques to build reliable, production-grade systems. Location - Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Hybrid - 3 Days a week in Office)

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Design schema-guided information extraction systems using zero-shot and few-shot structured prompting, constrained decoding approaches such as JSON schema enforcement or grammar-based decoding, and function-calling or tool-driven extraction techniques.
* Develop recursive or multi-stage extraction pipelines capable of handling nested entities, hierarchical structures, and cross-document relationships.
* Build ontology-driven systems using frameworks such as LinkML, OWL, SHACL, or similar schema modeling tools, and implement knowledge representations using RDF triples or labeled property graphs.
* Design and optimize entity resolution algorithms using techniques such as blocking strategies, embedding similarity, and rule-based matching.
* Develop ontology alignment techniques and graph embedding models such as Node2Vec or TransE-style approaches where appropriate.
* Design hybrid retrieval architectures combining dense vector retrieval, sparse retrieval techniques, and graph traversal algorithms such as BFS, DFS, path ranking, and neighborhood expansion.
* Build validation systems that enforce schema conformance, detect semantic inconsistencies, and reduce hallucinated or invalid structured outputs.
* Integrate structured knowledge systems into GraphRAG pipelines, agent planning frameworks, and tool-selection workflows.
* Deliver production-grade semantic systems with clear targets for latency, scalability, reliability, and data integrity.

  
  
**Requirements**   

* 5+ years of experience building production AI or machine learning systems.
* Strong experience designing and implementing knowledge graphs or ontology-driven architectures.
* Hands-on experience implementing structured extraction techniques, including grammar-constrained decoding, JSON schema enforcement, or AST-style parsing approaches.
* Experience building entity resolution systems beyond simple embedding similarity methods.
* Experience working with graph query languages such as SPARQL or Cypher and optimizing graph query performance.
* Familiarity with RDF, OWL, or property graph data models and semantic data architectures.
* Strong Python engineering skills, with emphasis on data validation, schema integrity, and system reliability.
* Experience designing hybrid symbolic and neural AI systems.

  
  
**Nice to Have**   

* Experience implementing graph algorithms such as PageRank, community detection, or shortest-path algorithms for reasoning chains.
* Experience building graph-enhanced retrieval systems such as GraphRAG.
* Experience designing compositional semantic extraction pipelines.
* Experience implementing reasoning engines or rule-based inference systems.
* Experience benchmarking and evaluating structural extraction accuracy and consistency.

jobs.title: Officer, Virtual Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just right for you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* DBS India Consumer Banking Group including digibank (Retail Banking) and Treasures (Wealth Segment) serves over 2.6 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services.
* It is a business that focuses on quality customer acquisition through multiple acquisition channels, customer-centric value propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
* DBS has been at the forefront of adapting and incorporating rapid changes in technology to understand and serve customer needs better. Virtual Relationship Managers are a step in that direction.
* Thus Treasures Virtual Relationship Manager is a key role within the Consumer Banking Group Business that is responsible for engaging with clients across the geographies in India and Globally, greatly enhancing the client experience through the effective use of technology.
* A high level of customer-centricity, interpersonal relationships complemented by “multi-channel” approach to relationship management via online and digi app are critical to succeed in this role.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire clients through e-boarding of the provided leads and nurture the relationship for AUM build up in a steady manner.
* Establish the Virtual Relationship Channel as a major revenue contributor through effective engagement with clients via multiple communication channels
* Ensure right balance of the product mix and balance NTB (New to Bank NR customers) with increased penetration of existing customers to deepen the wallet share.
* Drive and deliver a radical improvement in customer satisfaction scores through timely engagement and redressal of client enquiries.
* Ensure highest levels of customer satisfaction. Interact with new customers to detail & explain all features & functions of products & assist in on boarding of new clients.
* Empower DBS IN clients embrace the value delivery channels to improve transaction efficiency and effectiveness

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Quality engagement with Emerging Affluent and Treasures clients to retain and developing sustainable relationships
* Ensure effective and efficient on-boarding, client coverage and client economics.
* Coordinate and drive timely investment and insurance portfolio reviews partnering with Investment / Insurance / Wealth specialists in Cluster locations.
* Establish relationships with the client’s basis opportunities identified by key acquiringchannels such as SME / CEP/IBG/ DBS Experience Centers or influencers for on-boarding the clients and ensure qualification as Treasures basis the stipulated criteria.
* Ensure service delivery by ensuring appropriate workflows and processes including digital on-boarding, upgrades, Scan / E-mail based wealth transactions, doorstep banking services, digital and remote account maintenance (Re-KYC / Risk Reviews) etc.
* Work closely with Cluster locations, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure that customer instructions are executed correctly and in a timely manner
* Improving customer experience by collating customer feedback, identifying areas to improve such as operational, administrative, processes and competitiveness of products and services
* Maintaining an awareness of relevant products and services available so as to provide the best solutions for clients as per their identified needs and aspirations
* Supporting process and product improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback on service and product offering and ensuring compliance with internal audit and regulatory requirements and quality assurance
* Adhere to DBS India and Group standards on code of conduct and controls in line with bank values and expectations

**Requirements:**

* Servicing high net worth clients at a financial institution / KPO
* While technical competence is not essential, ability to handle client requests via e-channels and versatility with digital tools would be beneficial.
* Good knowledge of wealth management products, both investment and insurance
* Customer oriented and able to capture customer financial needs
* Holder of relevant insurance, investment certification requirements (AMFI / IRDAI Composite license) would be an advantage
* Good command of spoken English and Hindi. Fluency in other regional languages (Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu etc.) would be an advantage.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline. Postgraduation in marketing or finance or banking would be desirable

**Core Competencies**

* Selling and team influencing skills to grow customer numbers and customer product uptake
* People Management
* Communication Skills
* Drive for Action
* Ability to work in an ambiguous environment
* Excellent understanding of the Bank’s Strategy and ability to interpret this and execute effectively to grow customer wallet share
* Proven track record in execution of sales or marketing strategy that resulted in business growth

Work Relationship
  
  

* Ensuring remote coverage and engagement of customers along with Branch teams for support.
* Close interaction with Channels / Segments and Clusters to ensure consistent delivery of service and business objectives.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviours are:
  
  

* Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

**Location:**
Pune-DBIL
  
  
**Job:**
Product Sales
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

jobs.title: Group Account Director
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Alchemist Marketing & Talent Solutions is seeking an accomplished, self-motivated, and results-driven Business Head with 12+ years of experience to lead client growth and Account & Team Management. We are looking for an ambitious, creative leader with an energized personality - someone who excels at building authentic client relationships, steering account strategies, and mentoring cross-functional teams with high energy and passion.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Full Ownership:**
  Strong background in business development, high-stakes client management, and full P&L/operations management.
* **Experience & Benchmark:**
  12+ years of progressive agency experience in account management and strategic leadership.
* **Core Competencies:**
  Outgoing, creative, and articulate people-person with strong team leadership capabilities, high self-motivation, and a clear hunger for continuous growth.
* **Agency Background:**
  Proven track record in top-tier advertising or marketing agencies managing large-scale brand accounts and complex campaign workflows.
* **Domain Expertise:**
  Deep familiarity with consumer journeys and strategic marketing nuances within the Luxury, Ultra-Luxury, and Real Estate sectors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Account Growth & Business Development:**
  Spearhead client acquisition and organic growth strategies, with a strong emphasis on Real Estate and Luxury/Ultra-Luxury portfolios. Lead strategic pitch presentations and build long-term, C-suite client partnerships.
* **Operational & Account Leadership:**
  Oversee day-to-day account operations, workflow optimization, resource planning, and account profitability to ensure high-quality delivery and operational excellence.
* **Integrated Campaign Strategy:**
  Champion mainline advertising architecture (70% focus across ATL, Brand Positioning, Mass Media, and OOH) while seamlessly integrating 360-degree digital and experiential initiatives.
* **Senior Stakeholder Management:**
  Serve as a core strategic advisor to senior client decision-makers, guiding brand strategy, leading executive reviews, and resolving escalations.
* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:**
  Guide, inspire, and retain a high-performing cross-functional team (70+ employees), across Account Management, Strategy, and Creative, fostering a vibrant, output-driven team culture.
* **Performance Management Expertise:**
  Strong background in establishing clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), conducting regular performance reviews, driving talent development, and managing retention strategies across multi-tiered teams.

jobs.title: Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth
jobs.description:
**Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office)

**Reporting To:**
COO / Managing Director

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-focused business leader who combines the mindset of a hunter with the maturity of a strategic account leader. This role will be responsible for driving strategic customer acquisition, expanding existing accounts, managing key customer relationships, leading large delivery teams, and owning the P&L of assigned business units.

The ideal candidate has progressed from individual contributor sales roles into leadership positions and has successfully acquired new customers, built and expanded strategic accounts, developed high-performing teams, and delivered measurable revenue outcomes within IT Services, Technology Services, BPO, Demand Generation, Marketing Services, or Digital Services organizations.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in startups and mid-sized organizations. Profiles from large organizations are not preferred.

This is a leadership position offering significant autonomy, influence, and growth opportunities. The individual will actively contribute to the company's business strategy, customer acquisition roadmap, and future expansion plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across assigned business units.

Identify, prospect, and convert high-value business opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

Develop and execute strategic sales plans to penetrate new markets and acquire key accounts.

Identify growth opportunities within existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and service expansion.

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders and decision-makers.

Develop account plans, revenue forecasts, and customer expansion roadmaps.

Drive customer retention, renewals, and long-term account profitability.

Own business unit P&L and profitability targets.

**2. Strategic Account Management**

Act as the primary relationship owner for strategic customer accounts.

Build strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across customer organizations.

Ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnership growth.

Lead quarterly and annual business reviews with customers.

Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and relationship risks.

Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and maximize account value.

**3. Operational Leadership**

Serve as the bridge between customers and internal execution teams.

Lead and mentor teams comprising Program Managers, Assistant Program Managers, Team Leads, and Business Development Specialists.

Ensure delivery excellence and achievement of customer SLAs, KPIs, and business outcomes.

Build scalable operational processes, governance models, and best practices.

Drive productivity, quality improvements, and operational efficiency initiatives.

Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**4. Business Strategy & Governance**

Conduct regular SWOT analysis of operations, customers, competitors, and market opportunities.

Present monthly and quarterly business reviews, revenue forecasts, strategic plans, and performance achievements.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital, and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes and accelerate business growth.

Monitor market trends and identify new business opportunities aligned with the company's service offerings.

Contribute actively to the company's strategic planning, revenue expansion, and future growth initiatives.

**Compensation**

**Salary will be no bar for the right candidate**
, based on relevant experience, leadership capabilities.

jobs.title: AVP/VP/Sr.VP Techno Marketing Professionals
jobs.description:
**Description**
**About WTW**
Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.
  
  
We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.
  
  
Together, we unlock potential.
  
  
**About The Team**
**The Role**
We are looking for an ambitious, driven and relationship-oriented insurance professional who understands that successful client management and business development go beyond winning business. The role requires a strong understanding of client risks, the ability to develop meaningful insurance solutions, and a focus on building sustainable long-term relationships.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine client retention, relationship management and business development, working with senior client stakeholders to strengthen existing relationships while identifying opportunities for growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Client Relationship & Retention: Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients, understand their evolving requirements and ensure a high level of client satisfaction and retention.
* Client Needs & Risk Assessment: Assess clients' insurance requirements by reviewing existing coverage, understanding risk exposures and business priorities, and identifying appropriate insurance and risk management solutions.
* Business Development: Drive new business acquisition and identify opportunities to expand the corporate client portfolio across large accounts and relevant industry specialties.
* Senior Stakeholder Management: Build and nurture trusted relationships with CXOs, CFOs and other key decision-makers, positioning WTW as a strategic risk adviser.
* Risk Advisory: Educate clients on risk management practices, insurance market developments and relevant industry trends, providing insights that support informed decision-making.
* Renewal Management: Lead and coordinate the renewal process, bringing together the appropriate internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute client-specific renewal strategies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with placement, servicing, sales and specialist teams to deliver tailored solutions and a seamless client experience.
* Client Service Excellence: Ensure client service teams have a clear understanding of client requirements, service delivery expectations and the relevant frameworks governing the services provided. Provide technical support to sales and servicing teams where required.
* Market Intelligence: Stay current with insurance industry trends, regulatory developments, market conditions, pricing and emerging products to identify solutions and opportunities that add value for clients.
* Pipeline & Growth Management: Develop and maintain a strong business pipeline and contribute to sustainable revenue and portfolio growth.
* Client Issue Management: Monitor client satisfaction, proactively identify concerns and coordinate resolution of issues while ensuring expectations remain aligned and mutually sustainable.
* Business Administration: Ensure timely booking and invoicing of business and coordinate effectively with relevant internal and external teams.

**Qualifications**

* Postgraduate qualification with 7+ years of relevant experience, preferably within corporate insurance broking, general insurance, financial institutions, or a client-facing Property & Casualty insurance environment.
* Strong working knowledge of the insurance business, client needs and major lines of insurance.
* Demonstrated experience in client servicing, relationship management, client retention and/or business development.
* Experience servicing or developing large corporate accounts and engaging with senior stakeholders would be preferred.
* Proven ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant insurance and risk advisory solutions.
* Strong business development, influencing, negotiation and relationship-management capabilities.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong client orientation with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
* Excellent communication, presentation, influencing and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Consultative approach with the ability to understand complex client risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with placement, servicing, sales, specialist and operational teams.
* Commercial mindset with a strong focus on client retention and sustainable business growth.
* Entrepreneurial approach with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Passion for delivering exceptional client outcomes and creating measurable value.

**The Application Process**
Stage 1: Online application and recruiter review
  
  
Stage 2: Live video interview with hiring manager and team
  
  
Stage 3: Offer and onboarding
  
  
**We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please emai**
l candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com.

.

The role will own practice revenue growth, pipeline creation, strategic deal shaping and differentiated BPS/BPO solutions. The leader will combine outsourcing and managed-services expertise with strong capabilities in Contact Centre/CX, Sales Operations and Technical Support, using process transformation, automation, GenAI and Agentic AI to deliver measurable client outcomes.

* Own growth strategy, pipeline development and revenue expansion for the Technology BPS practice.
* Identify account whitespace and create proactive propositions for priority clients and prospects.
* Partner with Sales and Account teams to originate, qualify and convert large BPS and transformation opportunities.

* Lead solution strategy for complex BPS/BPO, managed services and operations-transformation deals.

jobs.title: Professor Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
jobs.description:
**PROFESSOR COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING (CSE)**

**Specialization:** Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms & Graph Theory

**Department:** Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Head of the Department / Principal  
 **Position:** Professor

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To provide academic leadership and deliver quality teaching and research in Computer Science & Engineering, with specialization in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.

The Professor will be responsible for teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, guiding research scholars, mentoring faculty members, promoting research and innovation, and contributing to the academic and research development of the department.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
* Prepare course plans, lecture materials, assignments, tutorials and assessment methodologies.
* Teach machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation and predictive modelling.
* Explain data collection, preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization and analytical techniques.
* Teach algorithm design techniques, computational complexity, optimization and problem-solving methods.
* Explain graph structures, graph algorithms, network analysis and graph-based applications.
* Conduct laboratory sessions, programming assignments, technical demonstrations and project-based learning activities wherever applicable.
* Evaluate student performance and provide academic guidance and mentoring.
* Implement Outcome-Based Education (OBE), including Course Outcomes (COs), assessment and attainment analysis.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and the development of effective teaching and learning practices.

**B. Research & Development**

* Conduct research in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design, Graph Theory and related emerging technologies.
* Publish quality research papers in reputed peer-reviewed journals and international conferences.
* Apply for funded research projects, grants and consultancy opportunities from government agencies and industry.
* Guide Ph.D. research scholars, postgraduate dissertations and undergraduate research projects, subject to university recognition and eligibility.
* Encourage interdisciplinary research, innovation, patents and industry collaboration.
* Establish research collaborations with reputed academic institutions and research organizations.
* Contribute to the development of research laboratories and departmental research activities.

**C. Academic Leadership & Departmental Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior faculty members and support their teaching, research and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development, academic planning and continuous improvement.
* Participate in Board of Studies, academic committees and institutional development activities.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, conferences, technical events and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Support NBA, NAAC, AICTE and other accreditation and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to departmental academic administration, research planning and institutional development.
* Promote industry-academia collaboration and student skill development initiatives.

**3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**A. Machine Learning**

* Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Feature Engineering and Feature Selection
* Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
* Model Training, Validation, Testing and Evaluation
* Ensemble Learning Techniques
* Predictive Modelling and Performance Optimization
* Python and Machine Learning Libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

**B. Data Analytics**

* Data Collection, Cleaning and Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
* Data Visualization and Interpretation
* Python / R Programming
* SQL and Database Management
* Data Analytics Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
* Business Intelligence Tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent
* Predictive Analytics and Data-Driven Decision-Making

**C. Design and Analysis of Algorithms**

* Data Structures and Algorithm Design
* Time and Space Complexity Analysis
* Asymptotic Notations
* Sorting and Searching Algorithms
* Divide and Conquer Techniques
* Greedy Algorithms
* Dynamic Programming
* Backtracking and Branch and Bound
* Graph Algorithms
* NP-Completeness and Computational Complexity
* Algorithm Optimization and Performance Analysis

**D. Graph Theory**

* Graph Structures and Representations
* Directed and Undirected Graphs
* Graph Traversal Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
* Connectivity, Trees and Spanning Trees
* Shortest Path Algorithms
* Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms
* Graph Coloring and Matching
* Network Flow and Graph Optimization
* Graph-Based Modelling and Network Analysis
* Applications of Graph Theory in Computer Science

**4. REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

**Undergraduate Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Postgraduate Qualification**

* M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Doctoral Qualification**

* Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science or a relevant allied discipline.

**Preferred Teaching and Research Specializations**

* Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
* Data Analytics and Data Science
* Design and Analysis of Algorithms
* Graph Theory and Graph Algorithms
* Computational Complexity and Optimization
* Applied Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics

*Educational qualifications and eligibility shall be subject to applicable AICTE, UGC, Osmania University and institutional recruitment norms.*

**5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Teaching, research and professional experience as prescribed under applicable AICTE/UGC and university norms for appointment to the position of Professor.
* Proven teaching experience in undergraduate and postgraduate Computer Science & Engineering programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.
* Experience in guiding postgraduate dissertations and Ph.D. research scholars, as permitted under university regulations.
* Strong research publication record in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
* Experience in academic leadership, curriculum development and faculty mentoring.
* Experience in funded research projects, consultancy, industry collaboration and institutional development will be preferred.

**6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong knowledge of core Computer Science & Engineering subjects.
* Expertise in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design and Graph Theory.
* Strong programming and analytical skills using Python, R, SQL and relevant development tools.
* Ability to develop and demonstrate machine learning models and data analytics applications.
* Strong understanding of algorithm design, complexity analysis and graph-based problem-solving.
* Excellent teaching, communication, mentoring and academic leadership skills.
* Strong research, analytical and technical problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to guide research scholars and contribute to funded research and consultancy activities.
* Ability to independently handle all four identified subjects.
* Ability to mentor faculty members and contribute to departmental academic and research development.

**7. SELECTION PREFERENCE**

Preference will be given to candidates

jobs.title: Executive Director Client Coverage
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East and Pakistan. The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.

* Drive achievement of UAE Visa Government Solutions scorecard metrics and commercial objectives, with clear ownership of pipeline development, execution and business outcomes.
* Maintain close alignment with the UAE Country Manager to ensure Visa Government Solutions priorities and execution are fully aligned with country strategies and broader Visa objectives.

* collaborate with Product, Legal, Solutioning and Government Engagement to coordinate Visa’s approach to government clients and strengthen engagement with key decision makers and stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen Visa’s positioning as a leader in payments and a strategic resource for government entities across UAE.
* Lead and coordinate Visa Government Solutions input into RFPs, proposals and complex commercial opportunities, working across internal teams to ensure high quality responses and effective execution.
* Continuously assess the market and competitive landscape, identify new growth opportunities and recommend creative approaches to expand Visa Government Solutions business across UAE.

* Proven experience engaging senior public sector stakeholders and building trusted, long term relationships across complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements while strengthening existing relationships and building new partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives across cross functional teams, solve complex problems and drive engagements through to completion.
* Knowledge of public sector payments infrastructure and government payment flows is an advantage. Strong collaboration and influencing skills are essential to successfully mobilize cross functional teams and deliver results.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.

* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

jobs.title: Treasury  Programme Manager
jobs.description:
**Director, Treasury Program Management**

**Shift Timing : 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM**

**Location- India – Bangalore**

**Job Summary**

- We are seeking a Director, Treasury Program Management, to lead large treasury programs across the global organization.

- This role drives execution across treasury systems, bank connectivity, payments modernization, settlement workflows, controls, reporting, exception-based processing, automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and process improvement.

- The Director will lead programs across payments, capital markets, middle office workflows, credit facility administration, loan seasoning, investing, management reporting, and forecasting.

**What You’ll Do**

Program Delivery & Governance

- Lead treasury programs end-to-end: Manage planning, execution, implementation, adoption, and post-go-live stabilization while overseeing milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and issue management.

- Own program delivery & governance: Maintain program plans, stakeholder updates, and reporting while translating business objectives into workstreams, requirements, testing plans, controls, and implementation roadmaps.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders: Partner with Treasury, Capital Markets, Middle Office, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Technology, banks, vendors, and service providers.

- Drive automation & exception-based processing: Reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and expand automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and operational transparency.

- Improve payments, settlements & bank connectivity: Enhance payment initiation, approval workflows, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and bank connectivity including SWIFT and ISO 20022.

- Standardize treasury payment workflows: Streamline processes across regions, funds, entities, currencies, and banking partners while reducing breaks and manual intervention.

**What You’ll Bring**

Required Experience

**- 15+ years of experience in treasury, treasury operations, middle office, capital markets operations, finance transformation, program management, or related financial services roles.**

**- Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple stakeholders.**

**- Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls, reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.**

**- Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation, and change management.**

**Must-Have Technical / Tools Criteria**

**- Must-have technical skills for this role include reporting, visualization, workflow, automation, and testing capabilities across the treasury ecosystem, including automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, SWIFT payment format testing automation, and treasury platform testing automation.**

**- Hands-on experience using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL, Python, workflow tools, test automation frameworks, or low-code automation platforms to support treasury process improvement, reporting, and automation, with examples including Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, KNIME, dbt, Apache Airflow, pytest, Robot Framework, and Selenium-based testing approaches.**

- Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis, issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

**- Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based processing.**

- Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports, process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

**- Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank-specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury payment workflows.**

- Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls, interfaces, and related system integrations.

- Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test evidence management, and implementation readiness.

**- Ability to partner effectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations stakeholders without being a pure technology role.**

- Exposure to AI-enabled automation or agentic workflow capabilities in treasury, finance, or operations is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech, treasury operations, or global capability centers.**

**- Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals, ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.**

**- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement processes, and treasury controls.**

**- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.**

**- CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.**

* Review major feeds and sources including Salesforce, SIMCORP, Global Product Master, and GDH/LDH, as well as other product and custodian feeds

* Knowledge of VaR calculations and associated risk models
* Advanced capability in data and interface analysis, including data flows, source-to-target mappings, data quality issues, and reconciliation logic

jobs.title: Lead Program Manager, Finance Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Veeam's Finance Transformation Office (FTO) is looking for a highly organized and execution-focused Lead Program Manager to drive strategic Finance transformation initiatives across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and enjoys connecting Finance, Corporate Technology, and implementation partners to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

As a Lead Program Manager, you will own the day-to-day execution of one or more transformation programs, ensuring projects remain on track, risks are proactively managed, and executive stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, dependencies, and business value. You'll serve as the operational backbone of the program, helping Finance leaders successfully deliver large-scale initiatives that modernize systems, processes, and reporting capabilities.

This role reports into the Finance Transformation Office Governance & Process Architecture team and requires a combination of program management expertise, financial systems knowledge, strong executive communication, and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple organizations.

Working hours: 5 PM IST to 2 AM IST

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the execution of one or more Finance Transformation initiatives, driving timelines, milestones, deliverables, and cross-functional coordination.
* Build and maintain program governance, including executive status reporting, steering committee materials, RAID logs, and portfolio dashboards.
* Identify, track, and proactively manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies across Finance, Corporate Technology, and external implementation partners.
* Partner with Functional Transformation Leads across FP&A, Controllership, Treasury, Tax, and other Finance organizations to ensure business requirements remain aligned throughout delivery.
* Collaborate with Corporate Technology teams and System Integrators to support successful implementation of Finance systems, data platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Monitor program health, benefit realization, and strategic outcomes, ensuring initiatives deliver measurable business value beyond project completion.
* Support organizational change management activities by partnering on communication plans, training, adoption strategies, and stakeholder engagement.
* Facilitate governance meetings, executive reviews, decision-making sessions, and cross-functional workshops with senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement by standardizing governance processes, templates, reporting frameworks, and program management best practices across the Finance Transformation Office.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and transparency across all program stakeholders while maintaining focus on delivery excellence.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of program or project management experience delivering Finance Transformation, ERP, Enterprise Planning, or Data Platform initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Experience managing enterprise implementations involving platforms such as Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP, NetSuite, Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of project governance methodologies, including RAID management, RACI/DACI frameworks, executive reporting, and portfolio governance.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives while balancing competing priorities and executive expectations.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk management.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience presenting program updates and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience working collaboratively with Finance organizations, Corporate Technology teams, and third-party implementation partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and ambiguous requirements.

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience supporting Finance organizations through digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to SOX controls, audit readiness, or IPO environments.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Experience within SaaS, enterprise software, or high-growth technology companies.
* Understanding of Finance functions including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Treasury, Tax, and Financial Reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Designer - Electrical Substation BIM
jobs.description:
****Job Description******Overview**  

Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.

The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.

AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.

  
**Your role**  

*Key Responsibilities*

* Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
* Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
* Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
* Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
* Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.

*Ideal Candidate Profile*

* We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
* Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
* Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
* A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
* Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
* Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
* Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
* Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

 **About you**  

*Technical Competencies*

*Essential*

* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
* Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
* Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
* Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
* Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
* Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
* Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.

*Desirable*

* Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
* Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
* Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.

*Behavioural Competencies*

* Strong communication and report-writing skills.
* Team-oriented with leadership potential.
* Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
* Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
* Proactive in career development and team contribution.
* Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
* Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

**Rewards benefits**  

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage
* Medical insurance for you and your dependents
* Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions
* Opportunity for local and global internal transfers
* Company gratuity scheme
* Discretionary bonus program
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

jobs.description:
****Job Description******Overview**  

Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.

The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.

AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.

* Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
* Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.

* Develop and maintain engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
* Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
* Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.

* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.

*Ideal Candidate Profile*

* We are seeking an experienced Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with:
* Proven experience in 132kV to 400kV AIS/GIS Substation Protection Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
* Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.

* Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.

* Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
* Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.

jobs.title: Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead**

**Experience:** 1012+ Years  
 **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent  
 **Preferred Expertise:** SAP, ERP Architecture, ERP Migration, Process Re-engineering and System Integration

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP & ERP Transformation professional with deep end-to-end knowledge of SAP's technical and functional architecture, who can assess, rationalise and eventually lead the migration of the organisation's existing SAP ecosystem to an alternative ERP platform.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the existing SAP landscape across modules, mapping interdependencies between processes, identifying redundancies and recommending an appropriate future-state ERP architecture.

The role requires a strong combination of technical programming capabilities, functional SAP expertise, business process understanding and ERP migration experience. The individual should be capable of evaluating how a change in one module, process or configuration impacts other interconnected business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End SAP Architecture & Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing SAP landscape, including its modules, configurations, customisations, workflows and integrations.
* Demonstrate strong techno-functional knowledge across SAP modules such as:

+ SAP MM – Materials Management
+ SAP PP – Production Planning
+ SAP SD – Sales & Distribution
+ SAP FI/CO – Finance & Controlling
+ SAP QM – Quality Management
+ SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
+ SAP WM/EWM – Warehouse Management
+ SAP HCM – Human Capital Management

* Understand the interdependencies between modules and assess the downstream and upstream impact of system-level changes.
* Review existing custom developments, ABAP code, interfaces, reports and system configurations.

**2. ERP Migration & Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and migration strategy for transitioning from the existing SAP environment to an alternative ERP platform.
* Evaluate suitable ERP solutions such as Oracle ERP, ERPNext or other enterprise platforms based on business requirements.
* Develop a comprehensive migration roadmap covering data, processes, applications, integrations and infrastructure.
* Identify functionalities that can be migrated, redesigned, consolidated or eliminated.
* Ensure data integrity, business continuity and minimal operational disruption during migration.
* Lead migration planning, testing, validation, deployment and post-implementation stabilisation.

**3. Business Process Re-engineering**

* Map and document existing end-to-end business processes across departments.
* Identify redundant, overlapping, outdated or inefficient processes.
* Design, restructure, consolidate or eliminate processes wherever required.
* Develop future-state workflows aligned with business requirements and operational efficiency.
* Ensure that changes in one business process are evaluated for their impact on other interconnected functions.

**4. Technical & Development Expertise**

* Possess strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, ABAP programming, debugging and custom code development.
* Understand APIs, database architecture, data structures, integrations and middleware.
* Assess the feasibility of replicating or redesigning existing SAP functionalities in the new ERP environment.
* Work with technical teams to develop customised solutions, interfaces and automation wherever required.

**5. Stakeholder Management & ERP Governance**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Projects and other business functions.
* Conduct functional assessments and gather business requirements from stakeholders.
* Establish centralised control over ERP-related projects, changes and process improvements.
* Develop system documentation, process maps, impact assessments and migration governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants and internal IT teams.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–12+ years of relevant experience in SAP consulting, ERP architecture, ERP transformation or large-scale ERP migration.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering discipline preferred.
* Strong techno-functional expertise across multiple SAP modules.
* Hands-on experience with ABAP programming, debugging, system configuration and integration.
* Demonstrated experience in ERP migration, preferably from SAP to Oracle, ERPNext or other enterprise ERP platforms.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional business processes and system interdependencies.
* Experience in process mapping, process redesign and business process re-engineering.
* Ability to independently assess existing systems and recommend appropriate technology and process solutions.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

  

**Key Expectations from the Role**

The successful candidate should be able to:

1. Understand the existing SAP ecosystem end-to-end without depending entirely on external consultants.
2. Map all existing modules, processes, customisations and system interdependencies.
3. Identify what needs to be retained, modified, consolidated or discontinued.
4. Assess the impact of any proposed change across the entire ERP ecosystem.
5. Recommend the most suitable alternative ERP platform and migration approach.
6. Develop and execute a structured migration roadmap with minimal business disruption.
7. Establish a centralised ERP architecture and governance framework for the organisation.

  

**The ultimate objective is to move from a fragmented and heavily dependent SAP environment towards a streamlined, integrated and scalable ERP ecosystem.**

jobs.title: BI Lab Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.

This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.

In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.

The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.

Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Translate business needs into data-driven solutions**
  + Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
  + Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value
* **Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools**
  + Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
  + Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
  + Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity

* **Apply the appropriate analytical approach**
  + Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
  + Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).
* **Perform data transformation and analysis**
  + Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.
* **Design meaningful metrics and outputs**
  + Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
  + Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.
* **Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions**
  + Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
  + Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
  + Sometimes contribute to scaled products.
* **Operate flexibly between guidance and execution**
  + Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
  + Contribute hands-on development when needed in resource-constrained environments
* **Drive insight-led decision-making**
  + Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
  + Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration
* **Team Leadership**
  + Coach direct reports and dotted line analysts on ways to improve solution development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* 3-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Strong problem-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
* Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
* Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.
