Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

**About the Role**

**This role leads Sutherland's Process Mining / Process Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE) for healthcare payer and provider operations, using Celonis or any other technology as the core platform.**
The leader in this seat owns the practice end to end - governance, delivery playbooks, the flagship client engagement, and the scaling of process intelligence into a grounding layer for Sutherland's agentic AI portfolio (including the METTLE platform and Smart-branded product suite).

**This is a leadership role, not a maintenance role. The person in this seat will define how Sutherland deploys, sells, and delivers Celonis-based process intelligence across payer and provider accounts, working closely with vertical leadership, solution architects, and client delivery teams.**

**Hands-on experience deploying Celonis (or a comparable process mining platform) in a healthcare or healthcare-adjacent environment - direct implementation experience is required, not just familiarity with the category.**

**What You'll Own**

\*\*COE leadership \*\* Lead the Process Mining COE - governance model, delivery playbooks, data pipeline standards, and reusable accelerators for healthcare use cases.

\*\*Flagship pilot delivery\*\* Lead the first proof-of-concept engagement (claims adjudication cycle time, provider data management, or a comparable payer/provider process) from data connector design through insight delivery and executive readout.

\*\*Platform depth\*\* Serve as Sutherland's internal subject matter expert on the Process Intelligence Platform - object-centric process mining (OCPM), the Process Intelligence Graph, Context Model / Agent Toolkit (MCP-based), Data Core, and Orchestration Engine.

\*\*Healthcare use case design.\*\* Translate payer and provider operational pain points (claims, credentialing, enrollment, utilization management, contact center) into process mining use cases with clearly defined KPIs and ROI targets, defined before implementation begins.

\*\*Executive narrative and sponsorship.\*\* Partner with vertical and account leadership to secure executive sponsorship for each engagement and manage the governance and change-management challenges that come with process transparency (process ownership conflicts, cross-BU data access, political friction).

\*\*Integration with agentic AI roadmap.\*\* Position and build process mining as the grounding/context layer feeding Sutherland's broader agentic AI and automation offerings - not a standalone analytics exercise.

\*\*Presales support.\*\* Support RFP responses, orals presentations, and client workshops as the technical authority on process intelligence, working alongside solution architects and bid managers.

\*\*Team build.\*\* As the COE scales, define staffing needs and build out a small core delivery team (data engineers, process analysts) under this function.

**Qualifications**

10+ years in healthcare operations, consulting, or technology delivery, with deep familiarity with payer and/or provider workflows (claims, credentialing, provider data management, utilization management, RCM, or contact center operations).

**Hands-on experience deploying Celonis (or a comparable process mining platform) in a healthcare or healthcare-adjacent environment - direct implementation experience is required, not just familiarity with the category.**

Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts (Client Servicing)

**Experience:** 3+ Years

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** As per company standards

About the Role

Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts to join its Client Servicing vertical.

This is not a typical back-end accounting role. The selected candidate will work as a financial consultant for a portfolio of small to medium-sized corporate clients, including domestic and global businesses.

The role involves managing end-to-end financial activities for assigned clients, covering daily bookkeeping, monthly statutory compliances, payroll, financial reporting, book closure and annual finalisation.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting and taxation knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Handle daily bookkeeping and accounting of expenses on an accrual basis.
* Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorised.
* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification and GST compliance on bills.
* Prepare and maintain weekly vendor registers and coordinate timely payments.
* Raise domestic and export invoices.
* Reconcile invoices and customer collections to ensure proper cash flow management.
* Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, including intercompany accounts and other balance sheet accounts.

2. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

* Manage client bank accounts and cash flows.
* Prepare monthly fund request statements.
* Execute bank transfers and monitor daily liquidity.
* Perform monthly Bank Reconciliations (BRS) and foreign exchange reconciliations.
* Update and maintain fixed asset registers.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* Ensure all sub-ledgers are aligned with the General Ledger at weekly and monthly intervals.

3. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting (MIS)

* Manage month-end closing activities.
* Record depreciation, prepayments and accrual provisions.
* Prepare and finalise monthly Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports for assigned clients.
* Participate in monthly client calls.
* Present financial reports, budget variances and operational insights to client SPOCs.

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation

**GST and Indirect Taxation**

* Handle GST computations and remittances.
* Manage Input Tax Credit (ITC) adjustments.
* Apply for GST refunds and manage GST return filings.

**Direct Taxation**

* Prepare monthly TDS statements and manage timely remittances.
* Handle quarterly advance tax planning, computations and payments.
* File e-TDS returns.
* Provide proactive tax-related guidance and tax-saving strategies.

**Year-End Finalisation & Audit**

* Manage annual books of accounts closure.
* Prepare Schedule III financial statements, including notes and accounting policies.
* Coordinate statutory audits.
* Provide required explanations and documentation to auditors.
* Resolve audit queries and ensure smooth audit sign-off.

5. Comprehensive Payroll & Labour Law Management

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing for assigned clients.
* Calculate salaries, employee benefits and reimbursements accurately.
* Handle monthly statutory remittances and filings related to:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Shops & Establishments (S&E)
* Gratuity
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Ensure accurate salary TDS deductions and timely deposits.
* Manage Form 16 issuance and related payroll compliance.
* Provide guidance and support on applicable labour law requirements under central and state regulations.

6. Global Client Engagement & Strategic Communication

* Act as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for Indian entities of global subsidiaries.
* Interact confidently with Board Directors, senior leadership and global stakeholders.
* Explain Indian financial, taxation and regulatory frameworks in a clear and actionable manner.
* Respond proactively to parent-company queries relating to financial performance, risks and compliance.
* Maintain timely and accurate information flow between clients and internal teams.
* Build professional client relationships through clear communication and ownership of responsibilities.

Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Expertise

* Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience in a professional services environment, preferably a CA firm or consulting firm.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting practices and standards.
* Good knowledge of GST laws and Income Tax provisions.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as:
* Tally
* QuickBooks
* Zoho Books
* Experience with payroll software such as:
* GreytHR
* KEKA
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel is mandatory.
* Practical experience in accounting, taxation, payroll and statutory compliance.

Essential Skills

* Strong client-first mindset and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in interacting with global parent companies and local stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to assess tax implications of business decisions and provide sound professional opinions.
* Strong ownership, time management and organisational skills.
* Proactive approach towards client servicing and financial operations.

Why Join Floraison?

At Floraison, you will work in a high-growth business and strategic consulting environment where you are more than just an accountant—you are a strategic partner to clients.

The organisation values disciplined, self-motivated professionals who take proactive ownership of their work and contribute to delivering high-quality financial and consulting services.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.

Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas:

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
